hpo:HP:0001027.definizione: A skin texture that is unusually soft (and may feel silky), and has a malleable consistency resembling that of dough.

hpo:HP:0001028.definizione: A hemangioma is a benign tumor characterized by blood-filled spaces lined by benign endothelial cells. A hemangioma characterized by large endothelial spaces (caverns) is called a cavernous hemangioma (in contrast to a hemangioma with small endothelial spaces, which is called capillary hemangioma).

hpo:HP:0001029.definizione: Poikiloderma refers to a patch of skin with (1) reticulated hypopigmentation and hyperpigmentation, (2) wrinkling secondary to epidermal atrophy, and (3) telangiectasias.

hpo:HP:0001030.definizione: Skin that splits easily with minimal injury.

hpo:HP:0001032.definizione: Absence of the distal interphalangeal flexion creases of the fingers.

hpo:HP:0001034.definizione: A hyperpigmented circumscribed area of change in normal skin color without elevation or depression of any size.

hpo:HP:0001051.definizione: Seborrheic dermatitis is a form of eczema which is closely related to dandruff. It causes dry or greasy peeling of the scalp, eyebrows, and face, and sometimes trunk.

hpo:HP:0001056.definizione: Presence of multiple small cysts containing keratin (skin protein) and presenting as tiny pearly-white bumps just under the surface of the skin.

hpo:HP:0001058.definizione: A reduced ability to heal cutaneous wounds.

hpo:HP:0001059.definizione: Pterygia are 'winglike' triangular membranes occurring in the neck, eyes, knees, elbows, ankles or digits.

hpo:HP:0001060.definizione: Presence of a cutaneous membrane (flap) in the armpit.

hpo:HP:0001065.definizione: Thinned, erythematous, depressed bands of atrophic skin. Initially, striae appear as flattened and thinned, pinkish linear regions of the skin. Striae tend to enlarge in length and become reddish or purplish. Later, striae tend to appear as white, depressed bands that are parallel to the lines of skin tension. Striae distensae occur most often in areas that have been subject to distension such as…

hpo:HP:0001067.definizione: A benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor that generally appears as a soft, skin-colored papule or small subcutaneous nodule. Individuals with neurofibromatosis can have numerous neurofibromas.

hpo:HP:0001075.definizione: Scars that form a depression compared to the level of the surrounding skin because of damage to the collagen, fat or other tissues below the skin.

hpo:HP:0001090.definizione: Diffusely large eye (with megalocornea) without glaucoma.

hpo:HP:0001096.definizione: Inflammation of the cornea and conjunctiva.

hpo:HP:0001098.definizione: Any structural abnormality of the fundus of the eye.

hpo:HP:0001100.definizione: Heterochromia iridis is a difference in the color of the iris in the two eyes.

hpo:HP:0001103.definizione: A structural abnormality of the macula, a region that, in a clinical context, is typically used to describe the central part of the retina within the vascular arcades.

hpo:HP:0001131.definizione: The term corneal dystrophy embraces a heterogenous group of bilateral genetically determined non-inflammatory corneal diseases that are restricted to the cornea.

hpo:HP:0001132.definizione: Partial dislocation of the lens of the eye.

hpo:HP:0001133.definizione: An absolute or relative decrease in retinal sensitivity extending from edge (periphery) of the visual field in a concentric pattern. The visual field is the area that is perceived simultaneously by a fixating eye.

hpo:HP:0001134.definizione: A polar cataract that affects the anterior pole of the lens.

hpo:HP:0001137.definizione: Esotropia in which either eye may be used for fixation.

hpo:HP:0001140.definizione: A benign tumor typically found at the junction of the cornea and sclera (limbal epibullar dermoid).

hpo:HP:0001141.definizione: Severe reduction of the ability to see. On the 6m visual acuity scale, severe reduction is defined as less than 6/60 but at least 3/60. On the 20ft visual acuity scale, severe reduction is defined as less than 20/200 but at least 20/400. On the decimal visual acuity scale, severe reduction is defined as less than 0.1 but at least 0.05.

hpo:HP:0001153.definizione: The presence of a vaginal septum, thereby creating a vaginal duplication. The septum is longitudinal in the majority of cases.

hpo:HP:0001155.definizione: An abnormality affecting one or both hands.

hpo:HP:0001162.definizione: Supernumerary digits located at the ulnar side of the hand (that is, on the side with the fifth finger).

hpo:HP:0001169.definizione: For children from birth to 4 years of age the palm width is more than 2 SD above the mean; for children from 4 to 16 years of age the palm width is above the 95th centile; or, the width of the palm appears disproportionately wide for the length.

hpo:HP:0001171.definizione: A condition in which middle parts of the hand (fingers and metacarpals) are missing giving a cleft appearance. The severity is very variable ranging from slightly hypoplastic middle fingers over absent middle fingers as far as oligo- or monodactyl hands.

hpo:HP:0001172.definizione: An abnormal structure of the first digit of the hand.

hpo:HP:0001177.definizione: Supernumerary digits located at the radial side of the hand. Polydactyly (supernumerary digits) involving the thumb occurs in many distinct forms of high variability and severity. Ranging from fleshy nubbins over varying degrees of partial duplication/splitting to completely duplicated or even triplicated thumbs or preaxial (on the radial side of the hand) supernumerary digits.

hpo:HP:0001181.definizione: In the resting position, the tip of the thumb is on, or near, the palm, close to the base of the fourth or fifth finger.

hpo:HP:0001182.definizione: The gradual reduction in girth of the finger from proximal to distal.

hpo:HP:0001187.definizione: The ability of the finger joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.

hpo:HP:0001188.definizione: An abnormal hand posture in which the hands are clenched to fists. All digits held completely flexed at the metacarpophalangeal and interphalangeal joints. In prenatal sonography of the fetal clenched hand, the index finger overlaps a clenched fist formed by the other digits. The proximal interphalangeal articulation of the index finger is flexed and ulnarly deviated, and the thumb is adducted.

hpo:HP:0001191.definizione: An abnormality affecting the carpal bones of the wrist (scaphoid, lunate, triquetral, pisiform, trapezium, trapezoid, capitate, hamate).

hpo:HP:0001195.definizione: Single umbilical artery (SUA) is the absence of one of the two umbilical arteries surrounding the fetal bladder and in the fetal umbilical cord.

hpo:HP:0001199.definizione: A thumb with three phalanges in a single, proximo-distal axis. Thus, this term applies if the thumb has an accessory phalanx, leading to a digit like appearance of the thumb.

hpo:HP:0001212.definizione: A soft tissue prominence of the ventral aspects of the fingertips. The term "persistent fetal fingertip pads" is often used as a synonym, but should better not be used because it implies knowledge of history of the patient which often does not exist.

hpo:HP:0001216.definizione: Ossification of carpal bones occurs later than age-adjusted norms.

hpo:HP:0001233.definizione: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the second to the third fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.

hpo:HP:0001234.definizione: With the hand relaxed and the thumb in the plane of the palm, the axis of the thumb forms an angle of at least 90 degrees with the long axis of the hand.

hpo:HP:0001238.definizione: Fingers that are disproportionately narrow (reduced girth) for the hand/foot size or build of the individual.

hpo:HP:0001239.definizione: A chronic loss of wrist joint motion due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevent normal movement of the joints of the wrist.

hpo:HP:0001245.definizione: Underdevelopment of the thenar eminence with reduced palmar soft tissue mass surrounding the base of the thumb.

hpo:HP:0001249.definizione: The term intellectual disability or intellectual developmental disorder is used to describe significantly sub-average intellectual and adaptive functioning based on clinical assessment and as measured by individually administered, appropriately normed, standardized and validated tests of intellectual functioning and adaptive behavior, with onset during the developmental period from infancy…

hpo:HP:0001254.definizione: A state of fatigue, either physical or mental slowness and sluggishness, with difficulties in initiating or performing simple tasks. Distinguished from apathy which implies indifference and a lack of desire or interest in the task. A person with lethargy may have the desire, but not the energy to engage in personal or socially relevant tasks.

hpo:HP:0001256.definizione: Mild intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by mildly sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) the range of 50-69.

hpo:HP:0001258.definizione: Complete loss of the ability to move the lower limbs accompanied by spasticity of the lower limbs.

hpo:HP:0001263.definizione: A delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child, including motor skills, speech and language, cognitive skills, and social and emotional skills. This term should only be used to describe children younger than five years of age.

hpo:HP:0001265.definizione: Reduction of neurologic reflexes such as the knee-jerk reaction.

hpo:HP:0001268.definizione: Loss of previously present mental abilities, generally in adults.

hpo:HP:0001270.definizione: A type of Developmental delay characterized by a delay in acquiring motor skills.

hpo:HP:0001271.definizione: A generalized disorder of peripheral nerves.

hpo:HP:0001272.definizione: Cerebellar atrophy is defined as a cerebellum with initially normal structures, in a posterior fossa with normal size, which displays enlarged fissures (interfolial spaces) in comparison to the foliae secondary to loss of tissue. Cerebellar atrophy implies irreversible loss of tissue and result from an ongoing progressive disease until a final stage is reached or a single injury, e.g. an…

hpo:HP:0001278.definizione: A form of hypotension characterized by a sudden fall in blood pressure that occurs when a person assumes a standing position.

hpo:HP:0001283.definizione: Bulbar weakness (or bulbar palsy) refers to bilateral impairment of function of the lower cranial nerves IX, X, XI and XII, which occurs due to lower motor neuron lesion either at nuclear or fascicular level in the medulla or from bilateral lesions of the lower cranial nerves outside the brain-stem. Bulbar weakness is often associated with difficulty in chewing, weakness of the facial muscles,…

hpo:HP:0001288.definizione: The term gait disturbance can refer to any disruption of the ability to walk.

hpo:HP:0001290.definizione: Generalized muscular hypotonia (abnormally low muscle tone).

hpo:HP:0001302.definizione: Pachygyria is a malformation of cortical development with abnormally wide gyri with sulci 1,5-3 cm apart and abnormally thick cortex measuring more than 5 mm (radiological definition). See also neuropathological definitions for 2-, 3-, and 4-layered lissencephaly.

hpo:HP:0001308.definizione: Fasciculations or fibrillation affecting the tongue muscle.

hpo:HP:0001315.definizione: A reduction (hyporeflexia) or complete absence (areflexia) of the involuntary muscle contraction normally elicited by a reflex stimulus, such as tapping a deep tendon.

hpo:HP:0001317.definizione: Any structural abnormality of the cerebellum.

hpo:HP:0001319.definizione: Muscular hypotonia (abnormally low muscle tone) manifesting in the neonatal period.

hpo:HP:0001320.definizione: Underdevelopment of the vermis of cerebellum.

hpo:HP:0001321.definizione: Cerebellar hypoplasia is a descriptive term implying a cerebellum with a reduced volume, but a normal shape and is stable over time.

hpo:HP:0001331.definizione: Absence of the septum pellucidum (meaning translucent wall in Latin - SP), also known as the ventricle of Sylvius. The septum pellucidum is a thin, triangular double membrane separating the frontal horns of the right and left lateral ventricles of the brain. It extends between the anterior portion of the corpus callosum, and the body of the fornix and its width varies from 1.5 to 3.0 mm.

hpo:HP:0001338.definizione: A partial failure of the development of the corpus callosum.

hpo:HP:0001344.definizione: Complete lack of development of speech and language abilities.

hpo:HP:0001347.definizione: Hyperreflexia is the presence of hyperactive stretch reflexes of the muscles.

hpo:HP:0001348.definizione: Tendon reflexes that are noticeably more active than usual (conventionally denoted 3+ on clinical examination). Brisk reflexes may or may not indicate a neurological lesion. They are distinguished from hyperreflexia by the fact that hyerreflexia is characterized by hyperactive repeating (clonic) reflexes, which are considered to be always abnormal.

hpo:HP:0001350.definizione: Abnormal coordination of muscles involved in speech.

hpo:HP:0001355.definizione: Diffuse enlargement of the entire cerebral hemispheres leading to macrocephaly (with or without overlying cortical dysplasia).

hpo:HP:0001362.definizione: A localized defect in the bone of the skull resulting from abnormal embryological development. The defect is covered by normal skin. In some cases, skull x-rays have shown underlying lytic bone lesions which have closed before the age of one year.

hpo:HP:0001367.definizione: An abnormal structure or form of the joints, i.e., one or more of the articulations where two bones join.

hpo:HP:0001371.definizione: A flexion contracture is a bent (flexed) joint that cannot be straightened actively or passively. It is thus a chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevents normal movement of joints.

hpo:HP:0001376.definizione: A reduction in the freedom of movement of one or more joints.

hpo:HP:0001377.definizione: Limited ability to straighten the arm at the elbow joint.

hpo:HP:0001382.definizione: The capability that a joint (or a group of joints) has to move, passively and/or actively, beyond normal limits along physiological axes.

hpo:HP:0001387.definizione: Joint stiffness is a perceived sensation of tightness in a joint or joints when attempting to move them after a period of inactivity. Joint stiffness typically subsides over time.

hpo:HP:0001395.definizione: The presence of excessive fibrous connective tissue in the liver. Fibrosis is a reparative or reactive process.

hpo:HP:0001405.definizione: The presence of fibrosis affecting the interlobular stroma of liver.

hpo:HP:0001406.definizione: Impairment of bile flow due to obstruction in the small bile ducts within the liver.

hpo:HP:0001410.definizione: Reduced ability of the liver to perform its functions.

hpo:HP:0001413.definizione: A type of cirrhosis characterized by the presence of small regenerative nodules.

hpo:HP:0001414.definizione: A form of hepatic steatosis characterized by the presence of small, lipid-laden vesicles in the affected hepatocytes.

hpo:HP:0001476.nome: Ritardo nella chiusura della fontanella anteriore
hpo:HP:0001476.definizione: A delay in closure (ossification) of the anterior fontanelle, which generally undergoes closure around the 18th month of life.

hpo:HP:0001483.definizione: Repetitive pressing, poking, and/or rubbing in the eyes.

hpo:HP:0001498.definizione: Underdevelopment of one or more carpal bones.

hpo:HP:0001500.definizione: Increased width of a non-thumb digit of the hand.

hpo:HP:0001508.definizione: Failure to thrive (FTT) refers to a child whose physical growth is substantially below the norm.

hpo:HP:0001510.definizione: A deficiency or slowing down of growth pre- and postnatally.

hpo:HP:0001511.definizione: An abnormal restriction of fetal growth with fetal weight below the tenth percentile for gestational age.

hpo:HP:0001518.definizione: Smaller than normal size according to sex and gestational age related norms, defined as a weight below the 10th percentile for the gestational age.

hpo:HP:0001519.definizione: A tall and slim body build with increased arm span to height ratio (>1.05) and a reduced upper-to-lower segment ratio (<0.85), i.e., unusually long arms and legs. The extremities as well as the hands and feet are unusually slim.

hpo:HP:0001520.definizione: The term large for gestational age applies to babies whose birth weight lies above the 90th percentile for that gestational age.

hpo:HP:0001533.definizione: Asthenic habitus refers to a slender build with long limbs, an angular profile, and prominent muscles or bones.

hpo:HP:0001537.definizione: Protrusion of abdominal contents through a defect in the abdominal wall musculature around the umbilicus. Skin and subcutaneous tissue overlie the defect.

hpo:HP:0001539.definizione: A midline anterior incomplete closure of the abdominal wall in which there is herniation of the abdominal viscera into the base of the abdominal cord.

hpo:HP:0001540.definizione: A separation of the rectus abdominis muscle into right and left halves (which are normally joined at the midline at the linea alba).

hpo:HP:0001548.definizione: Excessive postnatal growth which may comprise increased weight, increased length, and/or increased head circumference.

hpo:HP:0001555.definizione: Lack of symmetry between the left and right halves of the thorax.

hpo:HP:0001558.definizione: An abnormal reduction in quantity or strength of fetal movements.

hpo:HP:0001572.definizione: Increased size of the teeth, which can be defined as a mesiodistal tooth diameter (width) more than 2 SD above mean for age. Alternatively, an apparently increased maximum width of the tooth.

hpo:HP:0001581.definizione: Infections of the skin that happen multiple times.

hpo:HP:0001582.definizione: Loose and sagging skin often associated with loss of skin elasticity.

hpo:HP:0001583.definizione: A form of nystagmus in which the eyeball makes rotary motions around the axis.

hpo:HP:0001591.definizione: The rib cage has the shape of a wide mouthed bell. That is, the superior portion of the rib cage is constricted, followed by a convex region, and the inferior portion of the rib cage expands again to have a large diameter.

hpo:HP:0001597.definizione: Abnormal structure or appearance of the nail.

hpo:HP:0001602.definizione: Stricture or narrowing of the larynx that may be associated with symptoms of respiratory difficulty depending on the degree of laryngeal narrowing.

hpo:HP:0001605.definizione: A loss of the ability to move the vocal folds.

hpo:HP:0001609.definizione: Hoarseness refers to a change in the pitch or quality of the voice, with the voice sounding weak, very breathy, scratchy, or husky.

hpo:HP:0001611.definizione: A type of speech characterized by the presence of an abnormally increased nasal airflow during speech associated with structural abnormality of the nasal passages.

hpo:HP:0001620.definizione: A persistent (minutes to hours) abnormal increase in the pitch (frequency) of the voice for the context or social situation or significantly different from baseline of the individual.

hpo:HP:0001622.definizione: The birth of a baby of less than 37 weeks of gestational age.

hpo:HP:0001623.definizione: A position of the fetus at delivery in which the fetus enters the birth canal with the buttocks or feet first.

hpo:HP:0001626.definizione: Any abnormality of the cardiovascular system.

hpo:HP:0001627.definizione: Any structural anomaly of the heart.

hpo:HP:0001629.definizione: A hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart. The defect is centered around the most superior aspect of the ventricular septum.

hpo:HP:0001631.definizione: Atrial septal defect (ASD) is a congenital abnormality of the interatrial septum that enables blood flow between the left and right atria via the interatrial septum.

hpo:HP:0001633.definizione: Any structural anomaly of the mitral valve.

hpo:HP:0001634.definizione: One or both of the leaflets (cusps) of the mitral valve bulges back into the left atrium upon contraction of the left ventricle.

hpo:HP:0001635.definizione: The presence of an abnormality of cardiac function that is responsible for the failure of the heart to pump blood at a rate that is commensurate with the needs of the tissues or a state in which abnormally elevated filling pressures are required for the heart to do so. Heart failure is frequently related to a defect in myocardial contraction.

hpo:HP:0001643.definizione: In utero, the ductus arteriosus (DA) serves to divert ventricular output away from the lungs and toward the placenta by connecting the main pulmonary artery to the descending aorta. A patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) in the first 3 days of life is a physiologic shunt in healthy term and preterm newborn infants, and normally is substantially closed within about 24 hours after bith and completely…

hpo:HP:0001644.definizione: Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is defined by the presence of left ventricular dilatation and left ventricular systolic dysfunction in the absence of abnormal loading conditions (hypertension, valve disease) or coronary artery disease sufficient to cause global systolic impairment. Right ventricular dilation and dysfunction may be present but are not necessary for the diagnosis.

hpo:HP:0001650.definizione: The presence of a stenosis (narrowing) of the aortic valve.

hpo:HP:0001653.definizione: An abnormality of the mitral valve characterized by insufficiency or incompetence of the mitral valve resulting in retrograde leaking of blood through the mitral valve upon ventricular contraction.

hpo:HP:0001655.definizione: Failure of the foramen ovale to seal postnatally, leaving a potential conduit between the left and right cardiac atria.

hpo:HP:0001657.definizione: Increased time between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).

hpo:HP:0001659.definizione: An insufficiency of the aortic valve, leading to regurgitation (backward flow) of blood from the aorta into the left ventricle.

hpo:HP:0001660.definizione: A single arterial trunk arises from the cardiac mass. The pulmonary arteries, aorta and coronary arteries arise from this single trunk with no evidence of another outflow tract.

hpo:HP:0001664.definizione: A type of ventricular tachycardia characterized by polymorphioc QRS complexes that change in amplitue and cycle length, and thus have the appearance of oscillating around the baseline in the EKG.

hpo:HP:0001667.definizione: In this case the right ventricle is more muscular than normal, causing a characteristic boot-shaped (coeur-en-sabot) appearance as seen on anterior- posterior chest x-rays. Right ventricular hypertrophy is commonly associated with any form of right ventricular outflow obstruction or pulmonary hypertension, which may in turn owe its origin to left-sided disease. The echocardiographic signs are…

hpo:HP:0001669.definizione: A complex congenital heart defect in which the aorta arises from the morphologic right ventricle and the pulmonary artery arises from the morphologic left ventricle.

hpo:HP:0001674.definizione: A congenital heart defect characterized by a specific combination of heart defects with a common atrioventricular valve, primum atrial septal defect and inlet ventricular septal defect.

hpo:HP:0001682.definizione: A fixed form of obstruction to blood flow across the left-ventricular outflow tract related to stenosis (narrowing) below the level of the aortic valve.

hpo:HP:0001684.definizione: A kind of atrial septum defect arising from an enlarged foramen ovale, inadequate growth of the septum secundum, or excessive absorption of the septum primum.

hpo:HP:0001685.definizione: Myocardial fibrosis is characterized by dysregulated collagen turnover (increased synthesis predominates over unchanged or decreased degradation) and excessive diffuse collagen accumulation in the interstitial and perivascular spaces as well as by phenotypically transformed fibroblasts, termed myofibroblasts.

hpo:HP:0001692.definizione: A type of supraventricular tachycardia in which the atria are the principal site of electrophysiologic disturbance.

hpo:HP:0001696.definizione: A left-right reversal (or mirror reflection) of the anatomical location of the major thoracic and abdominal organs.

hpo:HP:0001704.definizione: One or more of the leaflets (cusps) of the tricuspid valve bulges back into the right atrium upon contraction of the right ventricle.

hpo:HP:0001708.definizione: Reduced ability of the right ventricle to perform its function (to receive blood from the right atrium and to eject blood into the pulmonary artery), often leading to pitting peripheral edema, ascites, and hepatomegaly.

hpo:HP:0001709.definizione: Third-degree atrioventricular (AV) block (also referred to as complete heart block) is the complete dissociation of the atria and the ventricles. Third-degree AV block exists when more P waves than QRS complexes exist and no relationship (no conduction) exists between them.

hpo:HP:0001712.definizione: Enlargement or increased size of the heart left ventricle.

hpo:HP:0001719.definizione: Double outlet right ventricle (DORV) is a type of ventriculoarterial connection in which both great vessels arise entirely or predominantly from the right ventricle.

hpo:HP:0001737.definizione: A cyst of the pancreas that possess a lining of mucous epithelium.

hpo:HP:0001750.definizione: The presence of only one working lower chamber in the heart, usually with a virtual absence of the ventricular septum and usually present in conjunction with double inlet left or right ventricle.

hpo:HP:0001751.definizione: An abnormality of the functioning of the vestibular apparatus.

hpo:HP:0001760.definizione: An abnormality of the skeleton of foot.

hpo:HP:0001761.definizione: An increase in height of the medial longitudinal arch of the foot that does not flatten on weight bearing (i.e., a distinctly hollow form of the sole of the foot when it is bearing weight).

hpo:HP:0001762.definizione: Talipes equinovarus (also called clubfoot) typically has four main components: inversion and adduction of the forefoot; inversion of the heel and hindfoot; equinus (limitation of extension) of the ankle and subtalar joint; and internal rotation of the leg.

hpo:HP:0001763.definizione: A foot where the longitudinal arch of the foot is in contact with the ground or floor when the individual is standing; or, in a patient lying supine, a foot where the arch is in contact with the surface of a flat board pressed against the sole of the foot by the examiner with a pressure similar to that expected from weight bearing; or, the height of the arch is reduced.

hpo:HP:0001765.definizione: Hyperextension of the metatarsal-phalangeal joint with hyperflexion of the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joint.

hpo:HP:0001769.definizione: A foot for which the measured width is above the 95th centile for age; or, a foot that appears disproportionately wide for its length.

hpo:HP:0001770.definizione: Webbing or fusion of the toes, involving soft parts only or including bone structure. Bony fusions are referred to as "bony" Syndactyly if the fusion occurs in a radio-ulnar axis. Fusions of bones of the toes in a proximo-distal axis are referred to as "Symphalangism".

hpo:HP:0001771.definizione: A contracture of the Achilles tendon.

hpo:HP:0001773.definizione: A measured foot length that is more than 2 SD below the mean for a newborn of 27 - 41 weeks gestation, or foot that is less than the 3rd centile for individuals from birth to 16 years of age (objective). Alternatively, a foot that appears disproportionately short (subjective).

hpo:HP:0001786.definizione: A foot for which the measured width is below the 5th centile for age; or, a foot that appears disproportionately narrow for its length.

hpo:HP:0001788.definizione: Premature rupture of membranes (PROM) is a condition which occurs in pregnancy when the amniotic sac ruptures more than an hour before the onset of labor.

hpo:HP:0001790.definizione: A type of hydrops fetalis in which there is no identifiable circulating antibody to red blood cell antigens .

hpo:HP:0001791.definizione: Accumulation of fluid in the peritoneal cavity during the fetal period.

hpo:HP:0001792.definizione: A nail that is diminished in length and width, i.e., underdeveloped nail.

hpo:HP:0001795.definizione: When viewed on end (with the digit tip pointing toward the examiner's eye) the curve of the nail forms a tighter curve of convexity.

hpo:HP:0001807.definizione: Longitudinal, linear prominences in the nail plate.

hpo:HP:0001816.definizione: Nail that appears thin when viewed on end.

hpo:HP:0001830.definizione: Polydactyly of the foot most commonly refers to the presence of six toes on one foot. Postaxial polydactyly affects the lateral ray and the duplication may range from a well-formed articulated digit to a rudimentary digit.

hpo:HP:0001831.definizione: A toe that appears disproportionately short compared to the foot.

hpo:HP:0001836.definizione: Camptodactyly is a painless flexion contracture of the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joint that is usually gradually progressive. This term refers to camptodactyly of one or more toes.

hpo:HP:0001838.definizione: The presence of both a prominent heel and a convex contour of the sole.

hpo:HP:0001840.definizione: The metatarsals are deviated medially (tibially), that is, the bones in the front half of the foot bend or turn in toward the body.

hpo:HP:0001841.definizione: Duplication of all or part of the first ray.

hpo:HP:0001845.definizione: Describes a foot digit resting on the dorsal surface of an adjacent digit when the foot is at rest. Initially clawing may be dynamic and only noticeable on walking. Over time the plantar plate tears, subluxation occurs at the metatarsophalangeal joint (MTPJ), and the deformity becomes permanent.

hpo:HP:0001847.definizione: Increased length of the big toe.

hpo:HP:0001849.definizione: A developmental defect resulting in the presence of fewer than the normal number of toes.

hpo:HP:0001852.definizione: A widely spaced gap between the first toe (the great toe) and the second toe.

hpo:HP:0001863.definizione: Bending or curvature of a toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe).

hpo:HP:0001869.definizione: The presence of unusually deep creases on the skin of sole of foot.

hpo:HP:0001883.definizione: A deformity of foot and ankle that has different subtypes that are talipes equinovarus, talipes equinovalgus, talipes calcaneovarus and talipes calcaneovalgus.

hpo:HP:0001889.definizione: Anemia characterized by the presence of erythroblasts that are larger than normal (megaloblasts).

hpo:HP:0001892.definizione: An abnormal susceptibility to bleeding, often referred to as a bleeding diathesis. A bleeding diathesis may be related to vascular, platelet and coagulation defects.

hpo:HP:0001896.definizione: A reduced number of reticulocytes in the peripheral blood.

hpo:HP:0001897.definizione: A kind of anemia in which the volume of the red blood cells is normal.

hpo:HP:0001902.definizione: Giant platelets are larger than 7 micrometers and usually 10 to 20 micrometers. The term giant platelet is used when the platelet is larger than the size of the average red cell in the field. (Description adapted from College of American Pathologists, Hematology Manual, 1998).

hpo:HP:0001907.definizione: The formation of a blood clot inside a blood vessel that subsequently travels through the blood stream from the site where it formed to another location in the body, generally leading to vascular occlusion at the distant site.

hpo:HP:0001919.definizione: Sudden loss of renal function, as manifested by decreased urine production, and a rise in serum creatinine or blood urea nitrogen concentration (azotemia).

hpo:HP:0001920.definizione: The presence of stenosis of the renal artery.

hpo:HP:0001927.definizione: Acanthocytosis is a type of poikilocytosis characterized by the presence of spikes on the cell surface. The cells have an irregular shape resembling many-pointed stars.

hpo:HP:0001928.definizione: An abnormality of the process of blood coagulation. That is, altered ability or inability of the blood to clot.

hpo:HP:0001947.definizione: Acidosis owing to malfunction of the kidney tubules with accumulation of metabolic acids and hyperchloremia, potentially leading to complications including hypokalemia, hypercalcinuria, nephrolithiasis and nephrocalcinosis.

hpo:HP:0001952.definizione: Glucose intolerance (GI) can be defined as dysglycemia that comprises both prediabetes and diabetes. It includes the conditions of impaired fasting glucose (IFG) and impaired glucose tolerance (IGT) and diabetes mellitus (DM).

hpo:HP:0001956.definizione: Obesity located preferentially in the trunk of the body as opposed to the extremities.

hpo:HP:0001967.definizione: Thickening and scarring (sclerosis) of the mesangium (a structure in the glomerulus). The sclerosis affects a large portion of the mesangium across multiple glomeruli. Histologic features include an increase in the mesangial matrix, thickened glomerular basement membrane, tubular casts, and interstitial inflammation. Diffuse mesangial sclerosis presents with nephrotic syndrome at birth or within…

hpo:HP:0001970.definizione: A form of inflammation of the kidney affecting the interstitium of the kidneys surrounding the tubules.

hpo:HP:0001971.definizione: A malfunctioning of the spleen in which it prematurely destroys red blood cells.

hpo:HP:0001973.definizione: The presence of thrombocytopenia in combination with detection of antiplatelet antibodies.

hpo:HP:0001976.definizione: An abnormality of coagulation related to a decreased concentration of antithrombin-III.

hpo:HP:0001977.definizione: Venous or arterial thrombosis (formation of blood clots) of spontaneous nature and which cannot be fully explained by acquired risk (e.g. atherosclerosis).

hpo:HP:0001980.definizione: Abnormal increased number of megaloblasts in the bone marrow.

hpo:HP:0001981.definizione: The presence of an abnormal number of fragmented red blood cells (schistocytes) in the blood.

hpo:HP:0001988.definizione: Recurrent episodes of decreased concentration of glucose in the blood.

hpo:HP:0001992.definizione: Excretion of non-amino organic acids in urine.

hpo:HP:0001993.definizione: Acidosis resulting from accumulation of ketone bodies.

hpo:HP:0001999.definizione: An abnormal morphology (form) of the face or its components.

hpo:HP:0002000.definizione: Reduced distance from the anterior border of the naris to the subnasale.

hpo:HP:0002002.definizione: Accentuated, prominent philtral ridges giving rise to an exaggerated groove in the midline between the nasal base and upper vermillion border.

hpo:HP:0002007.definizione: Bilateral bulging of the lateral frontal bone prominences with relative sparing of the midline.

hpo:HP:0002011.nome: Anomalia morfologica del sistema nervoso centrale
hpo:HP:0002011.definizione: A structural abnormality of the central nervous system.

hpo:HP:0002020.definizione: A condition in which the stomach contents leak backwards from the stomach into the esophagus through the lower esophageal sphincter.

hpo:HP:0002028.definizione: The presence of chronic diarrhea, which is usually taken to mean diarrhea that has persisted for over 4 weeks.

hpo:HP:0002033.definizione: An inadequate sucking reflex, resulting in the difficult of newborns to be breast-fed.

hpo:HP:0002036.definizione: The presence of a hernia in which the upper part of the stomach, i.e., mainly the gastric cardia protrudes through the diaphragmatic esophageal hiatus.

hpo:HP:0002037.definizione: Inflammation, or an inflammatory state in the large intestine.

hpo:HP:0002040.definizione: Extreme dilation of the submucusoal veins in the lower portion of the esophagus.

hpo:HP:0002045.definizione: Reduced body temperature due to failed thermoregulation.

hpo:HP:0002046.definizione: The inability to maintain a comfortable body temperature in warm or hot weather.

hpo:HP:0002058.definizione: A facial appearance characteristic of myopathic conditions. The face appears expressionless with sunken cheeks, bilateral ptosis, and inability to elevate the corners of the mouth, due to muscle weakness.

hpo:HP:0002060.definizione: Any structural abnormality of the telencephalon, which is also known as the cerebrum.

hpo:HP:0002061.definizione: Spasticity (velocity-dependent increase in tonic stretch reflexes with increased muscle tone and hyperexcitable tendon reflexes) in the muscles of the lower limbs, hips, and pelvis.

hpo:HP:0002062.definizione: Any structural abnormality of the pyramidal tract, whose chief element, the corticospinal tract, is the only direct connection between the brain and the spinal cord. In addition to the corticospinal tract, the pyramidal system includes the corticobulbar, corticomesencephalic, and corticopontine tracts.

hpo:HP:0002063.definizione: Continuous involuntary sustained muscle contraction. When an affected muscle is passively stretched, the degree of resistance remains constant regardless of the rate at which the muscle is stretched. This feature helps to distinguish rigidity from muscle spasticity.

hpo:HP:0002064.definizione: Spasticity is manifested by increased stretch reflex which is intensified with movement velocity. This results in excessive and inappropriate muscle activation which can contribute to muscle hypertonia. Spastic gait is characterized by manifestations such as muscle hypertonia, stiff knee, and circumduction of the leg.

hpo:HP:0002066.definizione: A type of ataxia characterized by the impairment of the ability to coordinate the movements required for normal walking. Gait ataxia is characteirzed by a wide-based staggering gait with a tendency to fall.

hpo:HP:0002069.definizione: A bilateral tonic-clonic seizure is a seizure defined by a tonic (bilateral increased tone, lasting seconds to minutes) and then a clonic (bilateral sustained rhythmic jerking) phase.

hpo:HP:0002070.definizione: A kind of ataxia that affects movements of the extremities.

hpo:HP:0002071.definizione: A neurological condition related to lesions of the basal ganglia leading to typical abnormalities including akinesia (inability to initiate changes in activity and perform volitional movements rapidly and easily), muscular rigidity (continuous contraction of muscles with constant resistance to passive movement), chorea (widespread arrhythmic movements of a forcible, rapid, jerky, and restless…

hpo:HP:0002075.definizione: A type of ataxia characterized by the impairment of the ability to perform rapidly alternating movements, such as pronating and supinating his or her hand on the dorsum of the other hand as rapidly as possible.

hpo:HP:0002078.definizione: Truncal ataxia is a sign of ataxia characterized by instability of the trunk. It usually occurs during sitting.

hpo:HP:0002091.definizione: A functional defect characterized by reduced total lung capacity (TLC) not associated with abnormalities of expiratory airflow or airway resistance. Spirometrically, a restrictive defect is defined as FEV1 (forced expiratory volume in 1 second) and FVC (forced vital capacity) less than 80 per cent. Restrictive lung disease may be caused by alterations in lung parenchyma or because of a disease of…

hpo:HP:0002108.definizione: Pneumothorax occurring without traumatic injury to the chest or lung.

hpo:HP:0002119.definizione: An increase in size of the ventricular system of the brain.

hpo:HP:0002120.definizione: Atrophy of the cortex of the cerebrum.

hpo:HP:0002121.definizione: A generalized non-motor (absence) seizure is a type of a type of dialeptic seizure that is of electrographically generalized onset. It is a generalized seizure characterized by an interruption of activities, a blank stare, and usually the person will be unresponsive when spoken to. Any ictal motor phenomena are minor in comparison to these non-motor features.

hpo:HP:0002123.definizione: A generalized myoclonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by bilateral, sudden, brief (<100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal). Myoclonus is less regularly repetitive and less sustained than is clonus.

hpo:HP:0002126.definizione: Polymicrogyria is a congenital malformation of the cerebral cortex characterized by abnormal cortical layering (lamination) and an excessive number of small gyri (folds).

hpo:HP:0002131.definizione: Periodic spells of incoordination and imbalance, that is, episodes of ataxia typically lasting from 10 minutes to several hours or days.

hpo:HP:0002132.definizione: A cavity within the cerebral hemisphere, filled with cerebrospinal fluid, that communicates directly with the ventricular system.

hpo:HP:0002135.definizione: The presence of calcium deposition affecting one or more structures of the basal ganglia.

hpo:HP:0002136.definizione: An abnormal gait pattern in which persons stand and walk with their feet spaced widely apart. This is often a component of cerebellar ataxia.

hpo:HP:0002139.definizione: A defect of development of the brain characterized by congenital absence of the part of the brain that includes the olfactory bulbs, tracts, and other structures associated with the sense of smell.

hpo:HP:0002140.definizione: Acute ischemic stroke (AIS) is defined by the sudden loss of blood flow to an area of the brain with the resulting loss of neurologic function. It is caused by thrombosis or embolism that occludes a cerebral vessel supplying a specific area of the brain. During a vessel occlusion, there is a core area where damage to the brain is irreversible and an area of penumbra where the brain has lost…

hpo:HP:0002153.definizione: The concentration of potassium(1+) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0002154.definizione: An elevated concentration of glycine in the blood.

hpo:HP:0002160.definizione: The concentration of homocystine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0002162.definizione: Hair on the neck extends more inferiorly than usual.

hpo:HP:0002164.definizione: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the nail.

hpo:HP:0002167.nome: Anormalità del linguaggio o della vocalizzazione
hpo:HP:0002167.definizione: An abnormality in the sound (volume) or cadence (rate) of speech.

hpo:HP:0002172.definizione: A tendency to fall or the inability to keep oneself from falling; imbalance. The retropulsion test is widely regarded as the gold standard to evaluate postural instability, Use of the retropulsion test includes a rapid balance perturbation in the backward direction, and the number of balance correcting steps (or total absence thereof) is used to rate the degree of postural instability. Healthy…

hpo:HP:0002174.definizione: A type of tremors that is triggered by holding a limb in a fixed position.

hpo:HP:0002176.definizione: External mechanical compression of the spinal cord.

hpo:HP:0002185.definizione: Pathological protein aggregates formed by hyperphosphorylation of a microtubule-associated protein known as tau, causing it to aggregate in an insoluble form.

hpo:HP:0002187.definizione: Profound intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by profoundly sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) below 20.

hpo:HP:0002188.definizione: Delayed myelination in the central nervous system.

hpo:HP:0002190.definizione: A cyst occurring within the choroid plexus within a cerebral ventricle.

hpo:HP:0002191.definizione: Spasticity that increases in degree with time.

hpo:HP:0002193.definizione: Pseudobulbar affect (PBA) is characterized by uncontrolled crying or laughing which may be disproportionate or inappropriate to the social context. Thus, there is a disparity between the patient's emotional expression and his or her emotional experience.

hpo:HP:0002194.nome: Ritardo nello sviluppo della motricità lorda
hpo:HP:0002194.definizione: A type of motor delay characterized by a delay in acquiring the ability to control the large muscles of the body for walking, running, sitting, and crawling.

hpo:HP:0002197.definizione: A generalized-onset seizure is a type of seizure originating at some point within, and rapidly engaging, bilaterally distributed networks. The networks may include cortical and subcortical structures but not necessarily the entire cortex.

hpo:HP:0002198.definizione: An abnormal dilatation of the fourth cerebral ventricle.

hpo:HP:0002205.definizione: An increased susceptibility to respiratory infections as manifested by a history of recurrent respiratory infections.

hpo:HP:0002208.definizione: Hair shafts are rough in texture.

hpo:HP:0002209.definizione: Decreased number of hairs per unit area of skin of the scalp.

hpo:HP:0002213.definizione: Hair that is fine or thin to the touch.

hpo:HP:0002216.definizione: Development of gray hair at a younger than normal age.

hpo:HP:0002217.definizione: Hair whose growth is slower than normal.

hpo:HP:0002226.definizione: White color (lack of pigmentation) of the eyebrow.

hpo:HP:0002227.definizione: White color (lack of pigmentation) of the eyelashes.

hpo:HP:0002230.definizione: Abnormally increased hair growth over much of the entire body.

hpo:HP:0002236.definizione: Upward and/or sideward growth of anterior hair.

hpo:HP:0002243.definizione: Abnormal loss of protein from the digestive tract related to excessive leakage of plasma proteins into the lumen of the gastrointestinal tract.

hpo:HP:0002245.definizione: Meckel's diverticulum is a congenital diverticulum located in the distal ileum.

hpo:HP:0002251.definizione: An abnormality resulting from a lack of intestinal ganglion cells (i.e., an aganglionic section of bowel) that results in bowel obstruction with enlargement of the colon.

hpo:HP:0002253.definizione: The presence of multiple diverticula of the colon.

hpo:HP:0002254.definizione: Repeated episodes of diarrhea separated by periods without diarrhea.

hpo:HP:0002263.definizione: More pronounced paramedian peaks and median notch of the Cupid's bow.

hpo:HP:0002266.definizione: A focal clonic seizure is a type of focal motor seizure characterized by sustained rhythmic jerking, that is regularly repetitive.

hpo:HP:0002267.definizione: An exaggerated startle reaction in response to a sudden unexpected visual or acoustic stimulus, or a quick movement near the face.

hpo:HP:0002280.definizione: Increase in size of the cisterna magna, one of three principal openings in the subarachnoid space between the arachnoid and pia mater, located between the cerebellum and the dorsal surface of the medulla oblongata.

hpo:HP:0002282.definizione: Heterotopia or neuronal heterotopia are macroscopic clusters of misplaced neurons (gray matter), most often situated along the ventricular walls or within the subcortical white matter.

hpo:HP:0002283.definizione: Unlocalized atrophy of the brain with decreased total brain matter volume and increased ventricular size.

hpo:HP:0002286.definizione: A lesser degree of hair pigmentation than would otherwise be expected.

hpo:HP:0002299.definizione: Fragile, easily breakable hair, i.e., with reduced tensile strength.

hpo:HP:0002304.definizione: Inability to initiate changes in activity or movement and to perform ordinary volitional movements rapidly and easily.

hpo:HP:0002307.definizione: Drooling is the overflowing of saliva from the mouth.

hpo:HP:0002311.definizione: A deficit in coordination of muscle movements. Coordination is defined as the orchestrated movement of multiple body parts as required to accomplish intended actions, like walking.

hpo:HP:0002312.definizione: Lack of physical coordination resulting in an abnormal tendency to drop items or bump into objects.

hpo:HP:0002313.definizione: Partial loss of the ability to move the lower limbs accompanied by spasticity of the lower limbs.

hpo:HP:0002321.definizione: An abnormal sensation of spinning while the body is actually stationary.

hpo:HP:0002322.definizione: A resting tremor occurs when muscles are at rest and becomes less noticeable or disappears when the affected muscles are moved. Resting tremors are often slow and coarse.

hpo:HP:0002333.definizione: Loss of previously present motor (i.e., movement) abilities.

hpo:HP:0002342.definizione: Moderate intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by moderately sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) the range of 35-49.

hpo:HP:0002343.definizione: A form of hydrocephalus characterized by enlarged cerebral ventricles and normal cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) pressure upon lumbar puncture.

hpo:HP:0002345.definizione: A tremor present when the limbs are active, either when outstretched in a certain position or throughout a voluntary movement.

hpo:HP:0002346.definizione: An unintentional, oscillating to-and-fro muscle movement affecting head movement.

hpo:HP:0002349.definizione: A type of focal-onset seizure in which awareness is preserved. Awareness during a seizure is defined as the patient being fully aware of themself and their environment throughout the seizure, even if immobile.

hpo:HP:0002353.definizione: Abnormality observed by electroencephalogram (EEG), which is used to record of the brain's spontaneous electrical activity from multiple electrodes placed on the scalp.

hpo:HP:0002356.definizione: A focal dystonia of the fingers, hand, and/or forearm that appears when the affected person attempts to do a task that requires fine motor movements such as writing or playing a musical instrument.

hpo:HP:0002360.definizione: An abnormal pattern in the quality, quantity, or characteristics of sleep.

hpo:HP:0002361.definizione: Loss of previously present mental and motor abilities.

hpo:HP:0002362.definizione: A type of gait (walking) characterized by by dragging one's feet along or without lifting the feet fully from the ground.

hpo:HP:0002367.definizione: Visual perception in the absence of a visual stimulus.

hpo:HP:0002372.definizione: Lack of observable abnormal electroencephalographic (EEG) patterns in an individual with a history of seizures. About half of individuals with epilepsy show interictal epileptiform discharges upon the first investigation. The yield can be increased by repeated studies, sleep studies, or by ambulatory EEG recordings over 24 hours. Normal interictal EEG is a sign that can be useful in the…

hpo:HP:0002376.definizione: Loss of developmental skills, as manifested by loss of developmental milestones.

hpo:HP:0002378.definizione: An unintentional, oscillating to-and-fro muscle movement affecting the hand.

hpo:HP:0002383.definizione: A disorder of the brain caused by an infectious agent that presents with fever, headache, and an altered level of consciousness. There may also be focal or multifocal neurologic deficits, and focal or generalized seizure activity.

hpo:HP:0002384.definizione: Focal impaired awareness seizure (or focal seizure with impaired or lost awareness) is a type of focal-onset seizure characterized by some degree (which may be partial) of impairment of the person's awareness of themselves or their surroundings at any point during the seizure.

hpo:HP:0002389.definizione: If the two laminae of the septum pellucidum are not fused then a fluid-filled space or cavum is present. The cavum septum pellucidum is present at birth but usually obliterates by the age of 3 to 6 months. It is up to 1cm in width and the walls are parallel. It is an enclosed space and is not part of the ventricular system or connected with the subarachnoid space.

hpo:HP:0002392.nome: EEG con complessi di onde polisporiche
hpo:HP:0002392.definizione: The presence of complexes of repetitive spikes and waves in EEG.

hpo:HP:0002395.definizione: Increased intensity of the a reflex in the leg.

hpo:HP:0002396.definizione: A type of rigidity in which a muscle responds with cogwheellike jerks to the use of constant force in bending the limb (i.e., it gives way in little, repeated jerks when the muscle is passively stretched).

hpo:HP:0002403.definizione: The patient stands with the feet placed together and balance and is asked to close his or her eyes. A loss of balance upon eye closure is a positive Romberg sign and is interpreted as indicating a deficit in proprioception.

hpo:HP:0002406.definizione: A type of dysmetria involving the limbs.

hpo:HP:0002410.definizione: Stenosis of the cerebral aqueduct (also known as the mesencephalic duct, aqueductus mesencephali, or aqueduct of Sylvius), which connects the third cerebral ventricle in the diencephalon to the fourth ventricle, which is between the pons and cerebellum.

hpo:HP:0002411.definizione: Myokymia consists of involuntary, fine, continuous, undulating contractions that spread across the affected striated muscle.

hpo:HP:0002418.definizione: An abnormality of the midbrain, which has as its parts the tectum, cerebral peduncle, midbrain tegmentum and cerebral aqueduct.

hpo:HP:0002421.definizione: Difficulty to maintain correct position of the head while standing or sitting. Infant head lag is observed when the head seems to flop around or lags posteriorly behind the trunk. Several articles have maintained that head lag should be absent by age 3 to 4 months.

hpo:HP:0002423.definizione: Long-tract signs refer to symptoms that are attributable to the involvement of the long fiber tracts in the spinal cord, which connect the spinal cord to the brain and mediate spinal and motor functions. These include spasticity, hyperreflexia, and abnormal reflexes such as Babinski or Hoffman's sign. If possible, it is preferable to use the precise HPO terms for these abnormalities.

hpo:HP:0002425.definizione: A defect in the motor ability that enables speech.

hpo:HP:0002427.definizione: Impairment of expressive language and relative preservation of receptive language abilities. That is, the patient understands language (speech, writing) but cannot express it.

hpo:HP:0002435.definizione: Protrusion of the meninges through a defect of the skull or vertebral column.

hpo:HP:0002442.definizione: A specific learning disability involving mathematics and arithmetic.

hpo:HP:0002444.definizione: The presence of a hamartoma of the hypothalamus.

hpo:HP:0002451.definizione: A type of dystonia (abnormally increased muscular tone causing fixed abnormal postures) that affects muscles of the limbs.

hpo:HP:0002460.definizione: Reduced strength of the musculature of the distal extremities.

hpo:HP:0002474.definizione: A delay in the acquisition of the ability to use language to communicate needs, wishes, or thoughts.

hpo:HP:0002475.definizione: Protrusion of the meninges and portions of the spinal cord through a defect of the vertebral column.

hpo:HP:0002487.definizione: Motor hyperactivity with excessive movement of muscles of the body as a whole.

hpo:HP:0002490.definizione: Increased concentration of lactate in the cerebrospinal fluid.

hpo:HP:0002493.definizione: A functional anomaly of the upper motor neuron. The upper motor neurons are neurons of the primary motor cortex which project to the brainstem and spinal chord via the corticonuclear, corticobulbar and corticospinal (pyramidal) tracts. They are involved in control of voluntary movements. Dysfunction leads to weakness, impairment of fine motor movements, spasticity, hyperreflexia and abnormal…

hpo:HP:0002495.definizione: A decrease in the ability to perceive vibration. Clinically, this is usually tested with a tuning fork which vibrates at 128 Hz and is applied to bony prominences such as the malleoli at the ankles or the metacarpal-phalangeal joints. There is a slow decay of vibration from the tuning fork. The degree of vibratory sense loss can be crudely estimated by counting the number of seconds that the…

hpo:HP:0002500.nome: Morfologia anormale della sostanza bianca cerebrale
hpo:HP:0002500.definizione: An abnormality of the cerebral white matter.

hpo:HP:0002505.definizione: Inability to walk in a person who previous had the ability to walk.

hpo:HP:0002506.definizione: Diffuse unlocalised atrophy affecting the cerebrum.

hpo:HP:0002507.definizione: A type of holoprosencephaly in which the left and right frontal and parietal lobes are fused and the interhemispheric fissure is only present posteriorly.

hpo:HP:0002511.definizione: A degenerative disease of the brain characterized by the insidious onset of dementia. Impairment of memory, judgment, attention span, and problem solving skills are followed by severe apraxia and a global loss of cognitive abilities. The condition primarily occurs after age 60, and is marked pathologically by severe cortical atrophy and the triad of senile plaques, neurofibrillary tangles, and…

hpo:HP:0002514.definizione: The presence of calcium deposition within the cerebrum.

hpo:HP:0002515.definizione: Weakness of the hip girdle and upper thigh muscles, for instance in myopathies, leads to an instability of the pelvis on standing and walking. If the muscles extending the hip joint are affected, the posture in that joint becomes flexed and lumbar lordosis increases. The patients usually have difficulties standing up from a sitting position. Due to weakness in the gluteus medius muscle, the hip…

hpo:HP:0002516.definizione: An increase of the pressure inside the cranium (skull) and thereby in the brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid.

hpo:HP:0002518.nome: Morfologia anomala della sostanza bianca periventricolare
hpo:HP:0002518.definizione: A structural abnormality of the myelinated axons (white matter) located near the cerebral ventricles.

hpo:HP:0002522.definizione: Inability to elicit tendon reflexes in the lower limbs.

hpo:HP:0002530.definizione: A type of dystonia that affects the midline muscles, i.e., the chest, abdominal, and back muscles.

hpo:HP:0002536.definizione: An abnormality of the gyri (i.e., the ridges) of the cerebral cortex of the brain.

hpo:HP:0002538.definizione: Any structural abnormality of the cerebral cortex.

hpo:HP:0002544.definizione: A form of torticollis in which the head is drawn back, either due to a permanent contractures of neck extensor muscles, or to a spasmodic contracture.

hpo:HP:0002553.definizione: Increased height of the central portion of the eyebrow, forming a crescent, semicircular, or inverted U shape.

hpo:HP:0002558.definizione: Presence of more than two nipples.

hpo:HP:0002561.definizione: Congenital failure to develop, and absence of, the nipple.

hpo:HP:0002562.definizione: Placement of the nipples at a lower than normal location.

hpo:HP:0002575.definizione: An abnormal connection (fistula) between the esophagus and the trachea.

hpo:HP:0002579.definizione: Abnormal intestinal contractions, such as spasms and intestinal paralysis, related to the loss of the ability of the gut to coordinate muscular activity because of endogenous or exogenous causes.

hpo:HP:0002583.definizione: Colitis refers to an inflammation of the colon and is often used to describe an inflammation of the large intestine (colon, cecum and rectum). Colitides may be acute and self-limited or chronic, and broadly fit into the category of digestive diseases.

hpo:HP:0002599.definizione: A head tremor of moderate speed (3 to 4 Hz) in the anterior-posterior direction.

hpo:HP:0002600.definizione: Reduced intensity of muscle tendon reflexes in the lower limbs. Reflexes are elicited by stretching the tendon of a muscle, e.g., by tapping.

hpo:HP:0002607.definizione: Involuntary fecal soiling in adults and children who have usually already been toilet trained.

hpo:HP:0002616.definizione: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the aortic root.

hpo:HP:0002623.definizione: An overriding aorta is a congenital heart defect where the aorta is positioned directly over a ventricular septal defect, instead of over the left ventricle. The result is that the aorta receives some blood from the right ventricle, which reduces the amount of oxygen in the blood. It is one of the four conditions of the Tetralogy of Fallot. The aortic root can be displaced toward the front…

hpo:HP:0002647.definizione: Aortic dissection refers to a tear in the intimal layer of the aorta causing a separation between the intima and the medial layers of the aorta.

hpo:HP:0002652.definizione: A general term describing features characterized by abnormal development of bones and connective tissues.

hpo:HP:0002655.definizione: A disorder of bone growth affecting the vertebrae and the ends of the long bones (epiphyses).

hpo:HP:0002676.definizione: Trilobar skull configuration when viewed from the front or behind.

hpo:HP:0002677.definizione: An abnormal narrowing of the foramen magnum.

hpo:HP:0002680.nome: Sella turcica a forma di J
hpo:HP:0002680.definizione: A deformity of the sella turcica whereby the sella extends further anterior than normal such that the anterior clinoid process appears to overhang it, giving the appearance of the letter J on imaging of the skull.

hpo:HP:0002683.definizione: Abnormality of the morphology (structure) of the calvaria (skullcap), that is, of that part of the skull that is made up of the superior portions of the frontal bone, occipital bone, and parietal bones and covers the cranial cavity that contains the brain.

hpo:HP:0002684.definizione: The presence of an abnormally thick calvaria.

hpo:HP:0002690.definizione: An abnormal enlargement of the sella turcica.

hpo:HP:0002691.definizione: A developmental malformation of the occipital bone and upper end of the cervical spine, in which the latter appears to have pushed the floor of the occipital bone upward such that there is an abnormal flattening of the skull base.

hpo:HP:0002694.definizione: Increased bone density of the skull base without significant changes in bony contour.

hpo:HP:0002697.definizione: The presence of symmetrical and circular openings (foramina) in the parietal bone ranging in size from a few millimeters to several centimeters wide.

hpo:HP:0002705.definizione: The presence of a high and narrow palate.

hpo:HP:0002714.definizione: A morphological abnormality of the mouth in which the angle of the mouth is downturned. The oral commissures are positioned inferior to the midline labial fissure.

hpo:HP:0002718.definizione: Increased susceptibility to bacterial infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of bacterial infection.

hpo:HP:0002719.definizione: Increased susceptibility to infections as manifested by repeated bouts of infection.

hpo:HP:0002720.nome: Diminuzione del livello di IgA circolanti

hpo:HP:0002722.definizione: An increased susceptibility to abscess formation, as manifested by a medical history of recurrent abscesses.

hpo:HP:0002726.definizione: Increased susceptibility to Staphylococcus aureus infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Staphylococcus aureus infection.

hpo:HP:0002728.definizione: Recurrent or persistent superficial Candida infections of the skin, mucous membranes, and nails.

hpo:HP:0002745.definizione: A thickened white patch on the oral mucosa that cannot be rubbed off.

hpo:HP:0002750.definizione: A decreased rate of skeletal maturation. Delayed skeletal maturation can be diagnosed on the basis of an estimation of the bone age from radiographs of specific bones in the human body.

hpo:HP:0002751.definizione: An abnormal curvature of the spine in both a coronal (lateral) and sagittal (back-to-front) plane.

hpo:HP:0002753.definizione: Abnormal thinning of the cortical region of bones.

hpo:HP:0002757.definizione: The repeated occurrence of bone fractures (implying an abnormally increased tendency for fracture).

hpo:HP:0002761.definizione: Joint hypermobility (ability of a joint to move beyond its normal range of motion) affecting many or all joints of the body. In individuals with Joint hypermobility at multiple sites (usually five or more), the term generalized joint hypermobility is preferred.

hpo:HP:0002780.definizione: Weakness or softness of the cartilage in the walls of the bronchial tubes.

hpo:HP:0002783.nome: Infezioni ricorrenti del tratto respiratorio inferiore
hpo:HP:0002783.definizione: An increased susceptibility to lower respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent lower respiratory tract infections.

hpo:HP:0002786.definizione: Weakness of the cartilage in the trachea and the bronchi, resulting in a floppy (non-rigid) airway. Affected persons may have difficulties to maintain patency of the airways.

hpo:HP:0002788.nome: Infezioni ricorrenti del tratto respiratorio superiore
hpo:HP:0002788.definizione: An increased susceptibility to upper respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent upper respiratory tract infections (running ears - otitis, sinusitis, pharyngitis, tonsillitis).

hpo:HP:0002791.definizione: A reduction in the amount of air transported into the pulmonary alveoli by breathing, leading to hypercapnia (increase in the partial pressure of carbon dioxide).

hpo:HP:0002792.definizione: An abnormal reduction on the vital capacity, which is defined as the total lung capacity (volume of air in the lungs at maximal inflation) less the residual volume (i.e., volume of air in the lungs following maximal exhalation) of the lung.

hpo:HP:0002793.definizione: An anomaly of the rhythm or depth of breathing.

hpo:HP:0002795.definizione: Abnormal function of the respiratory system.

hpo:HP:0002816.definizione: An abnormally increased extension of the knee joint, so that the knee can bend backwards.

hpo:HP:0002827.definizione: Displacement of the femur from its normal location in the hip joint.

hpo:HP:0002837.definizione: An increased susceptibility to bronchitis as manifested by a history of recurrent bronchitis.

hpo:HP:0002841.definizione: Increased susceptibility to fungal infections as manifested by multiple episodes of fungal infection.

hpo:HP:0002850.definizione: An abnormally decreased level of immunoglobulin M (IgM) in blood.

hpo:HP:0002857.definizione: The legs angle inward, such that the knees are close together and the ankles far apart.

hpo:HP:0002858.definizione: The presence of a meningioma, i.e., a benign tumor originating from the dura mater or arachnoid mater.

hpo:HP:0002860.definizione: The presence of squamous cell carcinoma of the skin.

hpo:HP:0002863.definizione: Clonal hematopoietic stem cell disorders characterized by dysplasia (ineffective production) in one or more hematopoietic cell lineages, leading to anemia and cytopenia.

hpo:HP:0002865.definizione: The presence of a medullary carcinoma of the thyroid gland.

hpo:HP:0002867.definizione: An abnormality of the ilium, the largest and uppermost bone of the pelvis.

hpo:HP:0002870.definizione: Obstructive Sleep Apnea is a condition characterized by the obstruction of the airway and pauses in breathing during sleep, which occur multiple times throughout the night. It is related to the relaxation of muscle tone that typically happens during sleep, leading to a partial collapse of the soft tissues in the airway and causing airflow obstruction.

hpo:HP:0002871.definizione: Apnea resulting from depression of the respiratory centers in the medulla oblongata. There is a lack of respiratory effort rather than obstruction of airflow.

hpo:HP:0002882.definizione: Recurrent bouts of sudden, severe apnea that may be life-threatening.

hpo:HP:0002907.definizione: Microscopic hematuria detected by dipstick or microscopic examination of the urine.

hpo:HP:0002909.definizione: An increased concentration of all types of amino acid in the urine.

hpo:HP:0002910.nome: Elevata concentrazione di transaminasi epatiche circolanti
hpo:HP:0002910.definizione: Elevations of the levels of SGOT and SGPT in the serum. SGOT (serum glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase) and SGPT (serum glutamic pyruvic transaminase) are transaminases primarily found in the liver and heart and are released into the bloodstream as the result of liver or heart damage. SGOT and SGPT are used clinically mainly as markers of liver damage.

hpo:HP:0002913.definizione: Presence of myoglobin in the urine.

hpo:HP:0002921.definizione: An abnormality of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

hpo:HP:0002922.nome: Aumento della concentrazione proteica nel liquor
hpo:HP:0002922.definizione: Increased concentration of protein in the cerebrospinal fluid.

hpo:HP:0002923.definizione: The presence in the serum of an autoantibody directed against the Fc portion of IgG.

hpo:HP:0002933.definizione: Ventral hernia refers to a condition in which abdominal contents protrude through a weakened portion of the abdominal wall.

hpo:HP:0002936.definizione: An abnormal reduction in sensation in the distal portions of the extremities.

hpo:HP:0002937.definizione: Absence of one half of the vertebral body.

hpo:HP:0002938.definizione: An abnormal accentuation of the inward curvature of the spine in the lumbar region.

hpo:HP:0002942.definizione: Over curvature of the thoracic region, leading to a round back or if sever to a hump.

hpo:HP:0002947.definizione: Exaggerated convexity of the cervical vertebral column, causing the cervical spine to bow outwards and take on a rounded appearance.

hpo:HP:0002948.definizione: A developmental defect leading to the union of two adjacent vertebrae.

hpo:HP:0002949.definizione: A congenital anomaly characterized by a joining (fusion) of two or more cervical vertebral bodies with one another.

hpo:HP:0002951.definizione: Congenital absence of a part of the vermis of cerebellum.

hpo:HP:0002967.definizione: Abnormal positioning in which the elbows are turned out.

hpo:HP:0002970.definizione: A positional abnormality marked by outward bowing of the legs in which the knees stay wide apart when a person stands with the feet and ankles together.

hpo:HP:0002974.definizione: An abnormal osseous union (fusion) between the radius and the ulna.

hpo:HP:0002979.definizione: A bending or abnormal curvature affecting a long bone of the leg.

hpo:HP:0002982.definizione: A bending or abnormal curvature of the tibia.

hpo:HP:0002986.definizione: A bending or abnormal curvature of the radius.

hpo:HP:0002987.definizione: An elbow contracture that limits the ability of the elbow joint to be extended (straightened), meaning that the elbow is fixed in an flexed (bent) position.

hpo:HP:0002999.definizione: The kneecap normally is located within the groove termed trochlea on the distal femur and can slide up and down in it. Patellar dislocation occurs if the patella fully dislocates out of the groove.

hpo:HP:0003002.definizione: The presence of a carcinoma of the breast.

hpo:HP:0003006.definizione: Neuroblastoma is a solid tumor that originate in neural crest cells of the sympathetic nervous system. Most neuroblastomas originate in the abdomen, and most abdominal neuroblastomas originate in the adrenal gland. Neuroblastomas can also originate in the thorax, usually in the posterior mediastinum.

hpo:HP:0003010.definizione: Prolongation of the time taken for a standardized skin cut of fixed depth and length to stop bleeding.

hpo:HP:0003015.definizione: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of one or more long bones.

hpo:HP:0003016.definizione: Abnormal widening of the metaphyseal regions of long bones.

hpo:HP:0003021.definizione: Metaphyseal cupping refers to an inward bulging of the metaphyseal profile giving the metaphysis a cup-like appearance.

hpo:HP:0003025.definizione: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of the metaphyses.

hpo:HP:0003026.definizione: One or more abnormally short long bone.

hpo:HP:0003027.definizione: Shortening of the middle parts of the limbs (forearm and lower leg) in relation to the upper and terminal segments.

hpo:HP:0003031.definizione: Bending of the diaphysis (shaft) of the ulna.

hpo:HP:0003042.definizione: Dislocation of the distal humerus out of the elbow joint, where the radius, ulna, and humerus meet.

hpo:HP:0003044.definizione: Chronic reduction in active and passive mobility of the shoulder joint due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevents normal movement.

hpo:HP:0003048.definizione: Partial dislocation of the head of the radius.

hpo:HP:0003066.definizione: Reduced ability to extend (straighten) the knee joint.

hpo:HP:0003067.definizione: An anomaly related to partial closure, or failure of development of the ulnar side of the distal radial growth plate, which results in an arrest of epiphyseal growth of the medial and volar portions of the distal radius. This leads to shortening of the radius and relative overgrowth of the ulna.

hpo:HP:0003073.definizione: The concentration of albumin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003075.definizione: A decreased concentration of protein in the blood.

hpo:HP:0003083.definizione: A dislocation of the head of the radius from its socket in the elbow joint.

hpo:HP:0003090.definizione: Underdevelopment of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

hpo:HP:0003097.definizione: An abnormal shortening of the femur.

hpo:HP:0003100.definizione: Reduced diameter of a long bone.

hpo:HP:0003108.definizione: An increased concentration of glycine in the urine.

hpo:HP:0003109.definizione: An increased excretion of phosphates in the urine.

hpo:HP:0003112.nome: Concentrazione anormale di aminoacidi in circolo
hpo:HP:0003112.definizione: Any deviation from the normal concentration of amino acid in the blood circulation.

hpo:HP:0003113.definizione: The concentration of chloride in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003118.definizione: Overproduction of the hormone of cortisol by the adrenal cortex, resulting in a characteristic combination of clinical symptoms termed Cushing syndrome, with truncal obesity, a round, full face, striae atrophicae and acne, muscle weakness, and other features.

hpo:HP:0003121.definizione: A contracture (chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin) that prevent normal movement of one or more joints of the limbs.

hpo:HP:0003126.definizione: Excretion in urine of proteins of a size smaller than albumin (molecular weight 69 kD).

hpo:HP:0003127.definizione: An abnormally decreased calcium concentration in the urine.

hpo:HP:0003138.definizione: An increased amount of nitrogen in the form of urea in the blood.

hpo:HP:0003141.nome: Aumento della concentrazione di colesterolo LDL
hpo:HP:0003141.definizione: The concentration of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003146.definizione: An decreased concentration of cholesterol in the blood.

hpo:HP:0003149.definizione: An abnormally high level of uric acid in the urine.

hpo:HP:0003150.definizione: The concentration of glutaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003160.nome: Focalizzazione isoelettrica anormale della transferrina sierica
hpo:HP:0003160.definizione: Glycosylated transferrin concentrations can be measured in serum as a marker of N-linked glycosylation fidelity. In the traditional nomenclature for congenital disorders of glycosylation, absence of entire glycans was designated type I, and loss of one or more monosaccharides as type II. These terms are retained for historical reasons but for new annotations the precise glycosylation defect…

hpo:HP:0003165.nome: Elevato livello di ormone paratiroideo circolante
hpo:HP:0003165.definizione: An abnormal increased concentration of parathyroid hormone.

hpo:HP:0003166.definizione: Increased concentration of taurine in the urine.

hpo:HP:0003177.definizione: A shift from the normally round (convex) appearance of the iliac wing towards a square-like appearance.

hpo:HP:0003180.definizione: Flattening of the superior part of the acetabulum, which is a cup-shaped cavity at the base of the hipbone into which the ball-shaped head of the femur fits. The acetabular roof thereby appears horizontal rather than arched, as it normally does.

hpo:HP:0003183.definizione: Abnormally increased width of the pubic symphysis is the midline cartilaginous joint uniting the superior rami of the left and right pubic bones.

hpo:HP:0003184.definizione: Reduced ability to move the femur outward to the side.

hpo:HP:0003186.definizione: The presence of nipples that instead of pointing outward are retracted inwards.

hpo:HP:0003189.definizione: Distance from nasion to subnasale more than two standard deviations above the mean, or alternatively, an apparently increased length from the nasal root to the nasal base.

hpo:HP:0003191.definizione: The presence of a notch in the margin of the ala nasi.

hpo:HP:0003194.definizione: Decreased superior-inferior length of the nasal bridge, which is the saddle-shaped area that includes the nasal root and the lateral aspects of the nose.

hpo:HP:0003196.definizione: Distance from nasion to subnasale more than two standard deviations below the mean, or alternatively, an apparently decreased length from the nasal root to the nasal tip.

hpo:HP:0003200.nome: Fibre muscolari di colore rosso stracciato
hpo:HP:0003200.definizione: An abnormal appearance of muscle fibers observed on muscle biopsy. Ragged red fibers can be visualized with Gomori trichrome staining as irregular and intensely red subsarcolemmal zones, whereas the normal myofibrils are green. The margins of affect fibers appear red and ragged. The ragged-red is due to the accumulation of abnormal mitochondria below the plasma membrane of the muscle fiber,…

hpo:HP:0003202.definizione: The presence of skeletal muscular atrophy (which is also known as amyotrophy).

hpo:HP:0003203.definizione: Abnormal decrease of neutrophil oxidative burst, commonly measured through oxidation of dihydrorhodamine (DHR) using flow cytometry or through nitroblue tetrazolium test (NBT) using optical microscopy, upon stimulation with phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA), E. coli or other ligands.

hpo:HP:0003215.definizione: An increased concentration of dicarboxylic acid in the urine.

hpo:HP:0003217.definizione: The concentration of glutamine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003218.definizione: An increased concentration of orotic acid in the urine.

hpo:HP:0003221.nome: Rottura cromosomica indotta da agenti reticolanti
hpo:HP:0003221.definizione: Increased amount of chromosomal breaks in cultured blood lymphocytes or other cells induced by treatment with DNA cross-linking agents such as diepoxybutane and mitomycin C.

hpo:HP:0003228.definizione: The concentration of sodium in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003231.definizione: The concentration of tyrosine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003233.nome: Diminuzione della concentrazione di colesterolo HDL
hpo:HP:0003233.definizione: The concentration of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003235.definizione: An increased concentration of methionine in the blood.

hpo:HP:0003237.nome: Aumento del livello di IgG circolanti
