hpo:HP:0003237.definizione: An abnormally increased level of immunoglobulin G in blood.

hpo:HP:0003241.definizione: Underdevelopment of part or all of the external reproductive organs.

hpo:HP:0003256.definizione: An abnormality of the coagulation cascade, which is comprised of the contact activation pathway (also known as the intrinsic pathway) and the tissue factor pathway (also known as the extrinsic pathway) as well as cofactors and regulators.

hpo:HP:0003259.nome: Elevata concentrazione di creatinina in circolo
hpo:HP:0003259.definizione: An increased amount of creatinine in the blood.

hpo:HP:0003261.nome: Aumento del livello di IgA circolanti
hpo:HP:0003261.definizione: An abnormally increased level of immunoglobulin A in blood.

hpo:HP:0003262.definizione: The presence in serum of antibodies against smooth muscle.

hpo:HP:0003265.definizione: A type of hyperbilirubinemia with neonatal onset.

hpo:HP:0003273.definizione: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of the hip joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.

hpo:HP:0003298.definizione: The closed form of spina bifida with incomplete closure of a vertebral body with intact overlying skin.

hpo:HP:0003300.definizione: When viewed in lateral radiographs, vertebral bodies have a roughly rectangular configuration. This term applies if the vertebral body appears rounded or oval.

hpo:HP:0003301.definizione: An irregular surface of the vertebral end plates, which are normally relatively smooth.

hpo:HP:0003306.definizione: Reduced ability to move the vertebral column with a resulting limitation of neck and trunk flexion.

hpo:HP:0003307.definizione: Abnormally increased curvature (anterior concavity) of the lumbar or cervical spine.

hpo:HP:0003311.definizione: Developmental hypoplasia of the dens of the axis.

hpo:HP:0003316.definizione: A butterfly vertebra (sagittal cleft vertebra or anterior rachischisis) is a sagittal defect in the vertebral body caused by failure of fusion of the two lateral chondrification centers during embryogenesis. The name is based on the appearance of the two hemivertebrae emerging as butterfly wings from the central cleft on x-ray.

hpo:HP:0003319.definizione: Any abnormality of the cervical vertebral column.

hpo:HP:0003320.definizione: A partial dislocation of the atlantoaxial joints.

hpo:HP:0003324.definizione: Generalized weakness or decreased strength of the muscles, affecting both distal and proximal musculature.

hpo:HP:0003327.definizione: Reduced strength of the axial musculature (i.e., of the muscles of the head and neck, spine, and ribs).

hpo:HP:0003341.definizione: The formation of bullae (blisters) with cleavage in the lamina lucida layer of the skin.

hpo:HP:0003344.definizione: An abnormally increased level of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid in the urine.

hpo:HP:0003348.definizione: An increased concentration of alanine in the blood.

hpo:HP:0003349.nome: Bassa velocità di esterificazione del colesterolo
hpo:HP:0003349.definizione: A reduction in the rate of cholesterol esterification.

hpo:HP:0003355.definizione: An increased concentration of an amino acid in the urine.

hpo:HP:0003362.nome: Aumento della concentrazione di colesterolo VLDL
hpo:HP:0003362.definizione: The concentration of very-low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003363.definizione: A left-right reversal (or mirror reflection) of the anatomical location of the viscera of the abdomen.

hpo:HP:0003376.definizione: An abnormal gait pattern that arises from weakness of the pretibial and peroneal muscles due to a lower motor neuron lesion. Affected patients have footdrop and are unable to dorsiflex and evert the foot. The leg is lifted high on walking so that the toes clear the ground, and there may be a slapping noise when the foot strikes the ground again.

hpo:HP:0003390.definizione: An axonal neuropathy of peripheral sensory nerves.

hpo:HP:0003391.definizione: A phenomenon whereby patients are not able to stand up without the use of the hands owing to weakness of the proximal muscles of the lower limbs.

hpo:HP:0003393.definizione: Wasting of thenar muscles, which are located on palm of the hand at the base of the thumb.

hpo:HP:0003416.definizione: An abnormal narrowing of the spinal canal.

hpo:HP:0003417.definizione: Frontal schisis (cleft or cleavage) of vertebral bodies.

hpo:HP:0003419.definizione: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the lower back.

hpo:HP:0003422.definizione: An abnormality related to a defect of vertebral separation during development.

hpo:HP:0003429.definizione: Reduced amount of myelin in the central nervous system resulting from defective myelinogenesis.

hpo:HP:0003438.definizione: Absence of the Achilles reflex (also known as the ankle jerk reflex), which can normally be elicited by tapping the tendon is tapped while the foot is dorsiflexed.

hpo:HP:0003452.definizione: The concentration of iron cation in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003453.definizione: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against neutrophils.

hpo:HP:0003458.definizione: The presence of abnormal electromyographic patterns indicative of myopathy, such as small-short polyphasic motor unit potentials.

hpo:HP:0003468.definizione: An abnormality of one or more of the vertebrae.

hpo:HP:0003472.definizione: Hyperexcitability of the neuromuscular system related to abnormally low level of calcium in the blood, resulting in carpopedal or generalized spasms.

hpo:HP:0003473.definizione: A type of weakness that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

hpo:HP:0003474.definizione: An abnormality of the primary sensation that is mediated by peripheral nerves (pain, temperature, touch, vibration, joint position). The word hypoesthesia (or hypesthesia) refers to a reduction in cutaneous sensation to a specific type of testing.

hpo:HP:0003477.definizione: An abnormality characterized by disruption of the normal functioning of peripheral axons.

hpo:HP:0003484.definizione: Weakness of the muscles of the arms.

hpo:HP:0003493.definizione: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against nuclei or nuclear components.

hpo:HP:0003496.nome: Aumento del livello di IgM circolanti
hpo:HP:0003496.definizione: An abnormally increased level of immunoglobulin M in blood.

hpo:HP:0003502.definizione: A mild degree of short stature, more than -2 SD but not more than -3 SD from mean corrected for age and sex.

hpo:HP:0003508.definizione: A kind of short stature in which different regions of the body are shortened to a comparable extent.

hpo:HP:0003510.definizione: A severe degree of short stature, more than -4 SD from the mean corrected for age and sex.

hpo:HP:0003521.nome: Statura bassa sproporzionata rispetto al tronco
hpo:HP:0003521.definizione: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs.

hpo:HP:0003528.nome: Elevata concentrazione di calcitonina in circolo
hpo:HP:0003528.definizione: Concentration of calcitonin, a 32-amino acid polypeptide hormone that is produced primarily by the parafollicular cells of the thyroid, in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003535.definizione: An increased amount of 3-methylglutaconic acid in the urine.

hpo:HP:0003538.definizione: An increased level of iduronate-2-sulfatase activity in the blood.

hpo:HP:0003542.definizione: The concentration of pyruvate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0003546.definizione: A functional motor deficit where individuals whose responses to the challenges of exercise fail to achieve levels considered normal for their age and gender.

hpo:HP:0003547.nome: Debolezza dei muscoli del cingolo scapolare
hpo:HP:0003547.definizione: The shoulder, or pectoral, girdle is composed of the clavicles and the scapulae. Shoulder-girdle weakness refers to lack of strength of the muscles attaching to these bones, that is, lack of strength of the muscles around the shoulders.

hpo:HP:0003552.definizione: A condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm.

hpo:HP:0003555.definizione: Fiber splitting or branching is a common finding in human and rat skeletal muscle pathology. Fiber splitting refers to longitudinal halving of the complete fiber, while branching originates from a regenerating end of a necrotic fiber as invaginations of the sarcolemma. In fiber branching, one end of the fiber remains intact as a single entity, while the other end has several branches.

hpo:HP:0003565.definizione: An increased erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR). The ESR is a test that measures the distance that erythrocytes have fallen after one hour in a vertical column of anticoagulated blood under the influence of gravity. The ESR is a nonspecific finding. An elevation may indicate inflammation or may be caused by any condition that elevates fibrinogen.

hpo:HP:0003573.definizione: Increased concentration of total (conjugated and unconjugated) bilirubin in the blood.

hpo:HP:0003648.definizione: An increased concentration of lactic acid in the urine.

hpo:HP:0003651.definizione: The presence of foam cells, a type of macrophage that localizes to fatty deposits on blood vessel walls, where they ingest low-density lipoproteins and become laden with lipids, giving them a foamy appearance.

hpo:HP:0003687.nome: Fibre muscolari scheletriche a nucleazione centrale
hpo:HP:0003687.definizione: An abnormality in which the nuclei of sarcomeres take on an abnormally central localization (or in which this feature is found in an increased proportion of muscle cells).

hpo:HP:0003688.definizione: An abnormally reduced activity of the enzyme cytochrome C oxidase in muscle tissue.

hpo:HP:0003689.definizione: The presence of multiple deletions of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA).

hpo:HP:0003690.definizione: Reduced strength and weakness of the muscles of the arms and legs.

hpo:HP:0003691.definizione: Abnormal protrusion of the scapula away from the surface of the back.

hpo:HP:0003693.definizione: Muscular atrophy affecting muscles in the distal portions of the extremities.

hpo:HP:0003697.definizione: Muscular atrophy in the distribution of shoulder girdle and peroneal muscles.

hpo:HP:0003700.definizione: Generalized (diffuse, unlocalized) amyotrophy (muscle atrophy) affecting multiple muscles.

hpo:HP:0003701.definizione: A lack of strength of the proximal muscles.

hpo:HP:0003707.definizione: Enlargement of the muscles of the calf due to their replacement by connective tissue or fat.

hpo:HP:0003712.definizione: Abnormal increase in muscle size and mass not due to training.

hpo:HP:0003713.definizione: Abnormal cell death involving muscle fibers usually associated with break in, or absence of, muscle surface fiber membrane and resulting in irreversible damage to muscle fibers.

hpo:HP:0003720.definizione: Hypertrophy (increase in size) of muscle tissue in a generalized (not localized) distribution.

hpo:HP:0003722.definizione: Weakness of the muscles involved in neck flexion (sternocleidomastoid, longus capitus, longus colli, and scalenus anterior).

hpo:HP:0003724.nome: Atrofia dei muscoli del cingolo scapolare
hpo:HP:0003724.definizione: Amyotrophy affecting the muscles of the shoulder girdle.

hpo:HP:0003738.definizione: The occurrence of an unusually high amount of muscle pain following exercise.

hpo:HP:0003749.nome: Debolezza dei muscoli del cingolo pelvico
hpo:HP:0003749.definizione: Weakness of the muscles of the pelvic girdle (also known as the hip girdle), that is, lack of strength of the muscles around the pelvis.

hpo:HP:0003758.definizione: A reduced amount of fat tissue in the lowest layer of the integument. This feature can be appreciated by a reduced skinfold thickness.

hpo:HP:0003762.definizione: A malformation of the uterus in which the uterus is present as a paired organ as a result of the failure of fusion of the mullerian ducts during embryogenesis.

hpo:HP:0003765.definizione: A skin abnormality characterized by redness and irritation, with thick, red skin that displays flaky, silver-white patches (scales).

hpo:HP:0003774.definizione: A degree of kidney failure severe enough to require dialysis or kidney transplantation for survival characterized by a severe reduction in glomerular filtration rate and other manifestations including increased serum creatinine.

hpo:HP:0003777.definizione: Pili (from Latin pilus, hair) torti (from Latin tortus, twisted) refers to short and brittle hairs that appear flattened and twisted when viewed through a microscope.

hpo:HP:0003796.definizione: Irregularity of the iliac crest, which is the superior border of the wing of the ilium.

hpo:HP:0003798.definizione: Nemaline rods are abnormal bodies that can occur in skeletal muscle fibers. The rods can be observed on histological analysis of muscle biopsy tissue or upon electron microscopy, where they appear either as extensions of sarcomeric Z-lines, in random array without obvious attachment to Z-lines (often in areas devoid of sarcomeres) or in large clusters localized at the sarcolemma or…

hpo:HP:0003805.definizione: Presence of abnormal vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles) in the sarcolemma. On histological staining with hematoxylin and eosin, rimmed vacuoles are popcorn-like clear vacuoles with a densely blue rim. The vacuoles are often associated with cytoplasmic and occasionally intranuclear eosinophilic inclusions.

hpo:HP:0003834.definizione: A displacement or misalignment of the humerus with respect to the other bones of the should joint. Note that a subluxation is a partial dislocation.

hpo:HP:0003974.definizione: Missing radius bone associated with congenital failure of development.

hpo:HP:0003982.definizione: Missing ulna bone associated with congenital failure of development.

hpo:HP:0004060.definizione: A hand in which the fingers are of nearly equal length and deflected at the first interphalangeal joint, so as to give a forklike shape consisting of separation of the first and second as well as the third and fourth digits.

hpo:HP:0004209.definizione: Clinodactyly refers to a bending or curvature of the fifth finger in the radial direction (i.e., towards the 4th finger).

hpo:HP:0004220.definizione: Hypoplastic/small middle phalanx of the fifth finger.

hpo:HP:0004227.definizione: Hypoplastic/small distal phalanx of the fifth finger.

hpo:HP:0004232.definizione: The presence of more than the normal number of carpal bones.

hpo:HP:0004233.definizione: Ossification of carpal bones at an abnormally early age.

hpo:HP:0004283.definizione: For children from birth to 4 years of age, the palm width is more than 2 SD below the mean; for children from 4 to 16 years of age the palm width is below the 5th centile; or, the width of the palm appears disproportionately narrow for its length.

hpo:HP:0004294.definizione: A partial dislocation affecting some or all of the metacarpophalangeal joints.

hpo:HP:0004313.nome: Diminuzione del livello di anticorpi circolanti
hpo:HP:0004313.definizione: An abnormally decreased level of immunoglobulin in blood.

hpo:HP:0004315.nome: Diminuzione del livello di IgG circolanti
hpo:HP:0004315.definizione: An abnormally decreased level of immunoglobulin G (IgG) in blood.

hpo:HP:0004334.definizione: Partial or complete wasting (atrophy) of the skin.

hpo:HP:0004349.definizione: A reduction of bone mineral density, that is, of the amount of matter per cubic centimeter of bones.

hpo:HP:0004363.nome: Concentrazione anormale di calcio in circolo
hpo:HP:0004363.definizione: Any deviation from the normal concentration of calcium in the blood circulation.

hpo:HP:0004374.definizione: Loss of strength in the arm, leg, and sometimes face on one side of the body. Hemiplegia refers to a severe or complete loss of strength, whereas hemiparesis refers to a relatively mild loss of strength.

hpo:HP:0004379.nome: Anomalia del livello di fosfatasi alcalina
hpo:HP:0004379.definizione: An abnormality of alkaline phosphatase level.

hpo:HP:0004381.definizione: A pathological narrowing in the region above the aortic valve associated with restricted left ventricular outflow.

hpo:HP:0004383.definizione: A severe congenital heart defect characterized by underdevelopment of the left ventricle.

hpo:HP:0004384.definizione: Truncus arteriosus (single great artery leaving the base of the heart, giving rise to the coronary, pulmonary, and systemic arteries) with a short pulmonary trunk arises from the truncus arteriosus, giving rise to both pulmonary arteries.

hpo:HP:0004390.definizione: Polyp-like protrusions which are histologically hamartomas. These can occur throughout the gastrointestinal tract. Hamartomatous polyps are composed of the normal cellular elements of the gastrointestinal tract, but have a markedly distorted architecture.

hpo:HP:0004409.definizione: A decreased sensitivity to odorants (that is, a decreased ability to perceive odors).

hpo:HP:0004415.definizione: An abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches.

hpo:HP:0004417.definizione: Intermittent claudication is a symptom of peripheral arterial occlusive disease. After having walked over a distance which is individually characteristic, the patients experience pain or cramps in the calves, feet or thighs which typically subsides on standing still.

hpo:HP:0004419.definizione: Repeated episodes of inflammation of a vein associated with venous thrombosis (blood clot formation within the vein).

hpo:HP:0004421.definizione: Abnormal increase in systolic blood pressure.

hpo:HP:0004428.definizione: This is a description previously used to describe a facial form characterized by a short, upturned nose, wide mouth, widely spaced eyes, and full cheeks. Because of the imprecision in this definition it is preferable to describe these features precisely. This term is retained because it was often used in the past, but it should not be used for new annotations.

hpo:HP:0004429.definizione: Increased susceptibility to viral infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of viral infection.

hpo:HP:0004437.definizione: Excessive growth of the bones of cranium, i.e., of the skull.

hpo:HP:0004440.definizione: Premature closure of the coronal suture of skull.

hpo:HP:0004442.definizione: A kind of craniosynostosis affecting the sagittal suture.

hpo:HP:0004443.definizione: A kind of craniosynostosis affecting the lambdoidal suture.

hpo:HP:0004444.definizione: The presence of erythrocytes that are sphere-shaped.

hpo:HP:0004445.definizione: The presence of elliptical, cigar-shaped erythrocytes on peripheral blood smear.

hpo:HP:0004446.definizione: The presence of erythrocytes with a mouth-shaped (stoma) area of central pallor on peripheral blood smear.

hpo:HP:0004451.definizione: A rudimentary tag of ear tissue often containing a core of cartilage and located just in back of the auricle (outer part of the ear).

hpo:HP:0004467.definizione: Small indentation anterior to the insertion of the ear.

hpo:HP:0004474.definizione: The anterior fontanelle generally ossifies by around the 18th month of life. A persistent open anterior fontanelle is diagnosed if closure is delayed beyond this age.

hpo:HP:0004482.definizione: A relatively mild degree of macrocephaly in which the head circumference is not above two standard deviations from the mean, but appears dysproportionately large when other factors such as body stature are taken into account.

hpo:HP:0004485.definizione: Stagnation of head growth seen as flattening of the head circumference curve.

hpo:HP:0004502.definizione: Bilateral absence (atresia) of the posterior nasal aperture (choana).

hpo:HP:0004566.definizione: Bulbous appearance of the anterior vertebral bodies, such that the vertebral bodies have the greatest vertical height anteriorly as well as bulbous anterior superior-inferior contours.

hpo:HP:0004568.definizione: Anterior tongue-like protrusions of the vertebral bodies.

hpo:HP:0004570.definizione: Increased top to bottom height of vertebral bodies.

hpo:HP:0004592.definizione: A flattened vertebral body shape with reduced distance between the vertebral endplates affecting the thoracic spine.

hpo:HP:0004602.definizione: Fusion of cervical vertebrae at C2 and C3, caused by a failure in the normal segmentation or division of the cervical vertebrae during the early weeks of fetal development, leading to a short neck with a low hairline at the back of the head, and restricted mobility of the upper spine.

hpo:HP:0004617.definizione: Butterfly vertebrae have a cleft through the body of the vertebrae and a funnel shape at the ends.

hpo:HP:0004621.definizione: Increased size of the vertebral pedicle.

hpo:HP:0004673.definizione: A reduced degree of voluntary and involuntary facial movements involved in responded to others or expressing emotions.

hpo:HP:0004684.definizione: Outward turning of the heel, resulting in clubfoot with the person walking on the inner part of the foot.

hpo:HP:0004712.definizione: An abnormality of the normal developmental rotation of the kidney leading to an abnormal orientation of the kidney.

hpo:HP:0004719.definizione: An increase in amplitude of waves returned in ultrasonography of the kidney, which is generally displayed as increased brightness of the signal.

hpo:HP:0004722.definizione: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM), reflecting an increase in thickness (subjective estimate) of the basal lamina of the glomerulus of the kidney.

hpo:HP:0004727.definizione: A defect in the ability to concentrate the urine.

hpo:HP:0004732.definizione: A reduction in the ability of the kidneys to remove uric acid from the serum.

hpo:HP:0004736.definizione: A developmental anomaly in which the kidneys are fused and localized on the same side of the midline. This anomaly is thought to result from disruption of the normal embryologic migration of the kidneys.

hpo:HP:0004757.definizione: Episodes of atrial fibrillation that typically last for several hours up to one day and terminate spontaneously.

hpo:HP:0004758.nome: Tachicardia ventricolare polimorfa indotta dallo sforzo
hpo:HP:0004758.definizione: Polymorphic ventricular arrhythmias of varying morphologythat do not exist under resting conditions but appear only upon physical exercise or catecholamine administration.

hpo:HP:0004762.definizione: Underdevelopment or reduced size of the heart right ventricle, often due to a reduced number of cells.

hpo:HP:0004780.definizione: Excessive, increased hair growth located in the elbow region.

hpo:HP:0004823.definizione: A type of poikilocytosis characterized by the presence in the blood of erythrocytes of varying sizes and abnormal shapes.

hpo:HP:0004840.definizione: A type of anemia characterized by an abnormally low concentration of hemoglobin in the erythrocytes and lower than normal size of the erythrocytes.

hpo:HP:0004844.definizione: A type of hemolytic anemia in which the Coombs test is positive.

hpo:HP:0004855.definizione: An abnormality of coagulation related to a decreased concentration of vitamin K-dependent protein S. Protein S is a cofactor of protein C.

hpo:HP:0004887.nome: Insufficienza respiratoria che richiede ventilazione assistita
hpo:HP:0004887.definizione: A state of respiratory distress that requires a life saving intervention in the form of gaining airway access and instituting positive pressure ventilation.

hpo:HP:0004900.definizione: A severe form of lactic acidemia.

hpo:HP:0004904.definizione: The term Maturity-onset diabetes of the young (MODY) was initially used for patients diagnosed with fasting hyperglycemia that could be treated without insulin for more than two years, where the initial diagnosis was made at a young age (under 25 years). Thus, MODY combines characteristics of type 1 diabetes (young age at diagnosis) and type 2 diabetes (less insulin dependence than type 1…

hpo:HP:0004918.definizione: A form of metabolic acidosis with increased serum chloride levels.

hpo:HP:0004927.definizione: An abnormal widening of the diameter of the pulmonary artery.

hpo:HP:0004933.definizione: A separation of the layers within the wall of the ascending aorta. Tears in the intimal layer result in the propagation of dissection (proximally or distally) secondary to blood entering the intima-media space.

hpo:HP:0004935.definizione: A congenital anomaly with a narrowing or complete absence of the opening between the right ventricle and the pulmonary artery.

hpo:HP:0004937.definizione: An aneurysm (severe localized balloon-like outward bulging) in the pulmonary artery.

hpo:HP:0004938.definizione: Excessive bending, twisting, and winding of a cerebral artery.

hpo:HP:0004942.definizione: Aortic dilatation refers to a dimension that is greater than the 95th percentile for the normal person age, sex and body size. In contrast, an aneurysm is defined as a localized dilation of the aorta that is more than 150 percent of predicted (ratio of observed to expected diameter 1.5 or more). Aneurysm should be distinguished from ectasia, which represents a diffuse dilation of the aorta less…

hpo:HP:0004944.definizione: The presence of a localized dilatation or ballooning of a cerebral artery.

hpo:HP:0004959.definizione: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the descending thoracic aorta.

hpo:HP:0004969.definizione: Stenosis of a peripheral branch of the pulmonary artery.

hpo:HP:0004970.definizione: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the tubular part of the ascending aorta.

hpo:HP:0004977.definizione: Missing radius bone on both sides associated with congenital failure of development.

hpo:HP:0004987.definizione: Shortening of the middle parts of the leg in relation to the upper and terminal segments.

hpo:HP:0005019.definizione: Tubulation refers to the size and shape of tubular bones. In children and adolescents, the modeling process regulates normal bone growth. Final shaft (tube) diameter depends on appositional bone growth and the equilibrium between periosteal and endosteal bone resorption and formation. Undertubulation refers to a broad, widened form of the shafts (diaphyses) of long bones.

hpo:HP:0005033.definizione: Underdevelopment of the distal portion of the ulna.

hpo:HP:0005113.definizione: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the aortic arch.

hpo:HP:0005116.definizione: Abnormal tortuous (i.e., twisted) form of arteries.

hpo:HP:0005117.definizione: Abnormal increase in diastolic blood pressure.

hpo:HP:0005150.definizione: An impairment of the electrical continuity between the atria and ventricles.

hpo:HP:0005155.definizione: A ventricular escape rhythm occurs whenever higher-lever pacemakers in AV junction or sinus node fail to control ventricular activation. Escape rate is usually 20-40 bpm, often associated with broad QRS complexes (at least 120 ms).

hpo:HP:0005160.definizione: Total anomalous pulmonary venous return refers to a congenital malformation in which all four pulmonary veins do not connect normally to the left atrium, but instead drain abnormally to the right atrium.

hpo:HP:0005162.definizione: Inability of the left ventricle to perform its normal physiologic function. Failure is either due to an inability to contract the left ventricle or the inability to relax completely and fill with blood during diastole.

hpo:HP:0005164.definizione: A congenital malformation of the pulmonary valve characterized by leaflet deformation.

hpo:HP:0005176.definizione: A congenital malformation of the aortic valve characterized by leaflet deformation.

hpo:HP:0005177.definizione: Arteriosclerosis occurring at an age that is younger than usual.

hpo:HP:0005180.definizione: Failure of the tricuspid valve to close sufficiently upon contraction of the right ventricle, causing blood to regurgitate (flow backward) into the right atrium.

hpo:HP:0005182.definizione: The presence of a bicuspid pulmonary valve.

hpo:HP:0005184.definizione: A longer than normal interval (corrected for heart rate) between the Q and T waves in the heart's cycle. Prolonged QTc can cause premature action potentials during late phase depolarizations thereby leading to ventricular arrhythmias and ventricular fibrillations.

hpo:HP:0005197.definizione: A sensation of stiffness in the joints that occurs following waking up in the morning.

hpo:HP:0005208.definizione: Watery voluminous diarrhea resulting from an imbalance between ion and water secretion and absorption.

hpo:HP:0005214.definizione: Blockage or impairment of the normal flow of the contents of the intestine towards the anal canal.

hpo:HP:0005215.definizione: Increased susceptibility to Giardia lamblia infection of the intestine, as manifested by a medical history of multiple episodes of Giardia lamblia intestinal infection.

hpo:HP:0005216.definizione: An abnormal reduction in the ability to masticate (chew), i.e., in the ability to crush and ground food in preparation for swallowing.

hpo:HP:0005259.definizione: Increased range of shoulder movement related to aplasia or hypoplasia of the clavicles that results in the ability to approximate the shoulders in front of the chest.

hpo:HP:0005272.definizione: Exaggerated bulkiness of the crease or fold of skin running from the lateral margin of the nose, where nasal base meets the skin of the face, to a point just lateral to the corner of the mouth (cheilion, or commissure).

hpo:HP:0005273.definizione: Lack of the cartilage of the nasal septum.

hpo:HP:0005280.definizione: Posterior positioning of the nasal root in relation to the overall facial profile for age.

hpo:HP:0005294.definizione: A separation (dissection) of the layers of an artery.

hpo:HP:0005301.definizione: A rare congenital vascular anomaly that results when the left superior cardinal vein caudal to the innominate vein fails to regress.

hpo:HP:0005302.definizione: Abnormal tortuous (i.e., twisted) form of the carotid arteries.

hpo:HP:0005305.definizione: Formation of a blood clot (thrombus) inside a cerebral vein, causing the obstruction of blood flow.

hpo:HP:0005328.definizione: A degree of wrinkling of the facial skin that is more than expected for the age of the individual, leading to a prematurely aged appearance.

hpo:HP:0005338.definizione: Decreased density/number and/or decreased diameter of lateral eyebrow hairs.

hpo:HP:0005348.definizione: Inspiratory stridor is a high pitched sound upon inspiration that is generally related to laryngeal abnormalities.

hpo:HP:0005352.definizione: A primary immune deficiency that is characterized by defects or deficiencies of T-lymphocytes that causes specific susceptibility to intracellular micro-organisms.

hpo:HP:0005353.definizione: Increased susceptibility to herpesvirus, as manifested by recurrent episodes of herpesvirus.

hpo:HP:0005359.definizione: Absence of the thymus. This feature may be appreciated by the lack of a thymic shadow upon radiographic examination.

hpo:HP:0005374.definizione: An immunodeficiency characterized by defective cell-mediated immunity or humoral immunity.

hpo:HP:0005387.definizione: A group of phenotypically heterogeneous genetic disorders characterized by profound deficiencies of T- and B-cell function, which predispose the patients to both infectious and noninfectious complications.

hpo:HP:0005403.definizione: Abnormal decrease in the absolute number of T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, per microliter of blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells.

hpo:HP:0005404.nome: Aumento della conta delle cellule B
hpo:HP:0005404.definizione: The absolute number of B cells in the blood, per microlitre is above the upper limit of normal of the reference range for the appropriate sex and age-group.

hpo:HP:0005406.definizione: Increased susceptibility to bacterial infections of the skin, as manifested by recurrent episodes of infectious dermatitis.

hpo:HP:0005422.definizione: Lack of detectible CD8-positive T cells

hpo:HP:0005462.definizione: The presence of calcium deposition in the falx cerebri.

hpo:HP:0005469.definizione: Reduced convexity of the occiput (posterior part of skull).

hpo:HP:0005484.definizione: Head circumference which falls below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender because of insufficient head growth after birth.

hpo:HP:0005487.definizione: Vertical bony ridge positioned in the midline of the forehead.

hpo:HP:0005513.definizione: Increased megakaryocyte number, i.e., of platelet precursor cells, present in the bone marrow.

hpo:HP:0005518.definizione: Larger than normal size of erythrocytes.

hpo:HP:0005528.definizione: A reduced number of hematopoietic cells present in the bone marrow relative to marrow fat.

hpo:HP:0005537.nome: Diminuzione del volume medio delle piastrine
hpo:HP:0005537.definizione: Average platelet volume below the lower limit of the normal reference interval.

hpo:HP:0005560.definizione: Normal hemoglobin synthesis is characterized by production of equal amounts of alpha and beta globins. This term refers to a deviation from this pattern and is the main characteristic of the various forms of thalassemia.

hpo:HP:0005562.definizione: The presence of many cysts in the kidney.

hpo:HP:0005565.definizione: Reduced differentiation between renal cortex and medulla on diagnostic imaging.

hpo:HP:0005567.definizione: High urine magnesium in the presence of hypomagnesemia.

hpo:HP:0005580.definizione: A duplication of the renal pelvis.

hpo:HP:0005608.definizione: The presence of a bilobed gallbladder, related to a duplication of the gallbladder primordium.

hpo:HP:0005616.definizione: An abnormally increased rate of skeletal maturation. Accelerated skeletal maturation can be diagnosed on the basis of an estimation of the bone age from radiographs of specific bones in the human body.

hpo:HP:0005619.definizione: Hyperconvexity of the thoracolumbar spine producing a rounded or humped appearance.

hpo:HP:0005639.definizione: The ability of the joints of the hand to move beyond their normal range of motion.

hpo:HP:0005645.definizione: The presence of abnormal calcium deposition of the intervertebral disk.

hpo:HP:0005667.definizione: Separation of the odontoid process from the body of the axis.

hpo:HP:0005671.definizione: Deposition of calcium salts on both sides of the cerebrum.

hpo:HP:0005684.definizione: An inherited primary limb malformation disorder characterized by congenital contractures of two or more different body areas and without primary neurologic and/or muscle disease that affects limb function.

hpo:HP:0005773.definizione: Underdevelopment of both forearm bones, the ulna and the radius, resulting in a shortened forearm.

hpo:HP:0005815.definizione: The presence of more than 12 rib pairs.

hpo:HP:0005819.nome: Falange media corta di un dito
hpo:HP:0005819.definizione: Short (hypoplastic) middle phalanx of finger, affecting one or more fingers.

hpo:HP:0005855.definizione: The presence of bone fractures in the prenatal period that are diagnosed at birth or before.

hpo:HP:0005879.nome: Contratture congenite della flessione delle dita
hpo:HP:0005879.definizione: Multiple bent (flexed) finger joints that cannot be straightened actively or passively.

hpo:HP:0005906.nome: Ritardo nella pneumatizzazione del processo mastoideo
hpo:HP:0005906.definizione: An abnormally reduced degree of pneumatization (i.e., formation of air cells) in the mastoid process with respect to age-dependent norms.

hpo:HP:0005930.definizione: An anomaly of epiphysis, which is the expanded articular end of a long bone that developes from a secondary ossification center, and which during the period of growth is either entirely cartilaginous or is separated from the shaft by a cartilaginous disk.

hpo:HP:0005949.definizione: Recurrent episodes of apnea occurring during infancy.

hpo:HP:0005961.definizione: The concentration of arginine in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0005988.definizione: A congenital form of torticollis resulting from shortening of the sternocleidomastoid muscle and leading to a limited range of motion in both rotation and lateral bending.

hpo:HP:0005989.definizione: Excess skin around the neck, often lying in horizontal folds.

hpo:HP:0006009.definizione: Increased side-to-side width of one or more phalanges of the fingers or toes.

hpo:HP:0006042.definizione: Y-shaped metacarpals are the result of a partial fusion of two metacarpal bones, with the two arms of the Y pointing in the distal direction. Y-shaped metacarpals may be seen in combination with polydactyly.

hpo:HP:0006097.definizione: Fusion of the third (middle) and fourth (ring) finger, involving soft parts and including fusion of individual finger bones.

hpo:HP:0006101.definizione: Webbing or fusion of the fingers, involving soft parts only or including bone structure. Bony fusions are referred to as "bony" Syndactyly if the fusion occurs in a radio-ulnar axis. Fusions of bones of the fingers in a proximo-distal axis are referred to as "Symphalangism".

hpo:HP:0006121.definizione: A type of digital ulcer that manifests as an open sore on the surface of the skin at the tip of a finger or toe.

hpo:HP:0006156.definizione: Bending or curvature of a thumb towards the ulnar side (towards the ring finger).

hpo:HP:0006159.definizione: The presence of a supernumerary finger (not a thumb) involving the third or fourth metacarpal with associated osseous syndactyly.

hpo:HP:0006184.definizione: Poorly defined or shallow palmar creases.

hpo:HP:0006191.definizione: Excessively deep creases of the palm.

hpo:HP:0006236.definizione: Decreased width of the metacarpal bones (that is, reduced diameter).

hpo:HP:0006282.definizione: A generalized form of developmental hypoplasia of the dental enamel.

hpo:HP:0006285.definizione: A decreased amount of enamel mineralization. Hypomineralized enamel has a brown discoloration and brittle aspect.

hpo:HP:0006297.definizione: Developmental hypoplasia of the dental enamel.

hpo:HP:0006298.definizione: Prolonged bleeding post dental extraction sufficient to require medical intervention.

hpo:HP:0006323.definizione: Loss of the primary (also known as deciduous) teeth before the usual age.

hpo:HP:0006332.definizione: The presence of a supernumerary, i.e., extra, maxillary incisor, either the primary maxillary incisor or the permanent maxillary incisor.

hpo:HP:0006335.definizione: Persistence of the primary teeth beyond the age by which they normally are shed and replaced by the permanent teeth.

hpo:HP:0006346.definizione: An abnormality of morphology of the incisor tooth in which the tooth is shaped like a screwdriver blade, i.e., having a rhomboid shape.

hpo:HP:0006349.definizione: A congenital defect characterized by the absence of one or more permanent teeth, including oligodontia, hypodontia, and adontia of the of permanent teeth.

hpo:HP:0006380.definizione: A type of knee joint contracture in which the knee is in a fixed bent (flexed) configuration such that it cannot be straightened actively or passively.

hpo:HP:0006385.definizione: Shortening of the legs related to developmental hypoplasia of the bones of the leg.

hpo:HP:0006391.definizione: Overconstriction, or narrowness of the diaphysis and metaphysis of long bones.

hpo:HP:0006394.definizione: A limitation of the ability to place the forearm in a position such that the palm faces anteriorly (supination) and to place the forearm in a position such that the palm faces posteriorly (pronation).

hpo:HP:0006482.definizione: An abnormality of the morphology of the tooth.

hpo:HP:0006487.definizione: A bending or abnormal curvature of a long bone.

hpo:HP:0006517.definizione: Accumulation of amorphous PAS-positive material in the space between alveolar macrophages, sometimes as condensed form (oval bodies) are typically found in alveolar proteinosis.

hpo:HP:0006530.definizione: Abnormality of the lung parenchyma extending to the pulmonary interstitium and leading to diffuse pulmonary fibrosis.

hpo:HP:0006532.definizione: An increased susceptibility to pneumonia as manifested by a history of recurrent episodes of pneumonia.

hpo:HP:0006538.definizione: An increased susceptibility to bronchopulmonary infections as manifested by a history of recurrent bronchopulmonary infections.

hpo:HP:0006554.definizione: Hepatic failure refers to the inability of the liver to perform its normal synthetic and metabolic functions, which can result in coagulopathy and alteration in the mental status of a previously healthy individual. Hepatic failure is defined as acute if there is onset of encephalopathy within 8 weeks of the onset of symptoms in a patient with a previously healthy liver.

hpo:HP:0006559.definizione: The presence of abnormal calcium deposition in the liver.

hpo:HP:0006568.definizione: An increase in the amount of glycogen stored in hepatocytes compared to normal.

hpo:HP:0006579.definizione: Neonatal jaundice refers to a yellowing of the skin and other tissues of a newborn infant as a result of increased concentrations of bilirubin in the blood. Neonatal jaundice affects over half of all newborns to some extent in the first week of life. Prolonged neonatal jaundice is said to be present if the jaundice persists for longer than 14 days in term infants and 21 days in preterm infants.

hpo:HP:0006610.definizione: A larger than usual distance between the left and right nipple.

hpo:HP:0006660.definizione: Absence of the clavicles as a developmental defect.

hpo:HP:0006682.definizione: Premature ventricular contractions (PVC) or ventricular extrasystoles are premature contractions of the heart that arise in response to an impulse in the ventricles rather than the normal impulse from the sinoatrial (SA) node.

hpo:HP:0006687.definizione: Abnormal tortuous (i.e., twisted) form of the aorta.

hpo:HP:0006695.definizione: A defect of the atrioventricular septum of the heart.

hpo:HP:0006770.definizione: A subtype of renal cell carcinoma thought to originate from mature renal tubular cells in the proximal tubule of the nehpron.

hpo:HP:0006772.definizione: A benign renal neoplasm composed of fat, vascular, and smooth muscle elements.

hpo:HP:0006808.definizione: Reduced amount of myelin in the nervous system resulting from defective myelinogenesis in the white matter of the central nervous system.

hpo:HP:0006813.definizione: A type of focal clonic seizure characterized by sustained rhythmic jerking rapidly involves one side of the body at seizure onset.

hpo:HP:0006817.definizione: Absence or underdevelopment of the vermis of cerebellum.

hpo:HP:0006821.definizione: A type of polymicrogyria with a gradient of severity (anterior more severe than posterior) extending from frontal poles posteriorly to precentral gyrus and inferiorly to frontal operculum.

hpo:HP:0006829.definizione: A severe degree of muscular hypotonia characterized by markedly reduced muscle tone.

hpo:HP:0006855.definizione: Wasting (atrophy) of the vermis of cerebellum.

hpo:HP:0006870.definizione: A type of holoprosencephaly in which most of the right and left cerebral hemispheres and lateral ventricles are separated but the most rostral aspect of the telencephalon, the frontal lobes, are fused, especially ventrally.

hpo:HP:0006879.definizione: Atrophy affecting the pons and the cerebellum.

hpo:HP:0006886.nome: Riduzione della sensazione di vibrazione distale
hpo:HP:0006886.definizione: A decrease in the ability to perceive vibration in the distal portions of the limbs.

hpo:HP:0006889.definizione: Borderline intellectual disability is defined as an intelligence quotient (IQ) in the range of 70-85.

hpo:HP:0006892.definizione: Atrophy (wasting, decrease in size of cells or tissue) affecting the frontotemporal cerebrum.

hpo:HP:0006937.definizione: A reduced sense of touch (tactile sensation) on the skin of the distal limbs. This is usually tested with a wisp of cotton or a fine camel's hair brush, by asking patients to say 'now' each time they feel the stimulus.

hpo:HP:0006944.definizione: A complete loss of the ability to perceive vibration.

hpo:HP:0006958.definizione: An abnormality of the auditory evoked potentials, which are used to trace the signal generated by a sound, from the cochlear nerve, through the lateral lemniscus, to the medial geniculate nucleus, and to the cortex.

hpo:HP:0006959.definizione: Proximal spinal muscular atrophy, i.e., muscular weakness and atrophy related to loss of the motor neurons of the spinal cord and brainstem.

hpo:HP:0006979.definizione: Any abnormality of an individual's circadian rhythm that affects the timing of sleeping and being awake is referred to as a sleep-wake disorder.

hpo:HP:0006988.definizione: A type of holoprosencephaly characterized by the presence of a single ventricle and no separation of the cerebral hemisphere. The single midline ventricle is often greatly enlarged.

hpo:HP:0006989.definizione: Dysplasia and dysgenesis of the corpus callosum are nonspecific descriptions that imply defective development of the corpus callosum. The term dysplasia is applied when the morphology of the corpus callosum is altered as a congenital trait. For instance, the corpus callosum may be hump-shaped, kinked, or a striped corpus callosum that lacks an anatomically distinct genu and splenium.

hpo:HP:0006999.definizione: Focal proliferation of glial cells in the basal ganglia.

hpo:HP:0007002.definizione: Progressive impairment of function of motor axons with muscle weakness, atrophy, and cramps. The deficits are length-dependent, meaning that muscles innervated by the longest nerves are affected first, so that for instance the arms are affected at a later age than the onset of deficits involving the lower leg.

hpo:HP:0007010.definizione: An abnormality of the ability (skills) to perform a precise movement of small muscles with the intent to perform a specific act. Fine motor skills are required to mediate movements of the wrists, hands, fingers, feet, and toes.

hpo:HP:0007015.definizione: An abnormality of the ability (skills) to perform a precise movement of large muscles with the intent to perform a specific act. Gross motor skills are required to mediate movements of the arms, legs, and other large body parts.

hpo:HP:0007033.definizione: Cerebellar dysplasia (abnormal growth or development) is defined by abnormal cerebellar foliation, white matter arborization, and gray-white matter junction. Cerebellar dysplasia is a neuroimaging finding that describes abnormalities of both the cerebellar cortex and white matter and is associated with variable neurodevelopmental outcome. Dysplasia may globally involve the cerebellum or affect…

hpo:HP:0007064.definizione: Progressive loss of previously present language abilities.

hpo:HP:0007067.definizione: Peripheral sensory neuropathy affecting primarily distal sensation.

hpo:HP:0007068.definizione: Underdevelopment of the inferior portion of the vermis of cerebellum.

hpo:HP:0007074.definizione: Increased vertical dimension of the corpus callosum. This feature can be visualized by sagittal sections on magnetic resonance tomography imaging of the brain.

hpo:HP:0007076.definizione: Muscular rigidity (continuous contraction of muscles with constant resistance to passive movement).

hpo:HP:0007082.definizione: An increase in size of the third ventricle.

hpo:HP:0007089.definizione: Fasciculations affecting the tongue muscle and the musculature of the face.

hpo:HP:0007099.nome: Malformazione di Chiari di tipo I
hpo:HP:0007099.definizione: Arnold-Chiari type I malformation refers to a relatively mild degree of herniation of the posteroinferior region of the cerebellum (the cerebellar tonsils) into the cervical canal with little or no displacement of the fourth ventricle. It is characterized by one or both pointed (not rounded) cerebellar tonsils that project 5 mm below the foramen magnum, measured by a line drawn from the basion to…

hpo:HP:0007105.definizione: Encephalopathy with onset in the infantile period.

hpo:HP:0007108.definizione: Demyelinating neuropathy is characterized by slow nerve conduction velocities with reduced amplitudes of sensory/motor nerve conduction and prolonged distal latencies.

hpo:HP:0007126.definizione: Amyotrophy (muscular atrophy) affecting the proximal musculature.

hpo:HP:0007166.definizione: Episodic bouts of involuntary movements with dystonic, choreic, ballistic movements, or a combination thereof. There is no loss of consciousness during the attacks.

hpo:HP:0007181.definizione: Atrophy of the interosseus muscles (including the palmar interossei that lie on the anterior aspect of the metacarpals, the dorsal interosseus muscles of the hand, which lie between the intercarpals, the plantar interosseus muscles, which lie underneath the metatarsal bones, and the dorsal interossei, which are located between the metatarsal bones.

hpo:HP:0007188.definizione: Facial diplegia (that is, bilateral facial palsy) with congenital onset.

hpo:HP:0007209.definizione: Complete loss of ability to move facial muscles innervated by the facial nerve (i.e., the seventh cranial nerve).

hpo:HP:0007210.definizione: Muscular atrophy affecting the lower limb.

hpo:HP:0007229.definizione: The presence of calcium deposition in the cerebral white matter surrounding the cerebral ventricles.

hpo:HP:0007240.definizione: A type of gait ataxia displaying progression of clinical severity.

hpo:HP:0007256.definizione: Functional neurological abnormalities related to dysfunction of the pyramidal tract.

hpo:HP:0007266.definizione: Defective structure and function of myelin sheaths of the white matter of the brain.

hpo:HP:0007267.definizione: An abnormality characterized by chronic impairment of the normal functioning of the axons.

hpo:HP:0007270.definizione: An atypical absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by interruption of ongoing activities and reduced responsiveness. In comparison to a typical absence seizure, changes in tone may be more pronounced, onset and/or cessation may be less abrupt, and the duration of the ictus and post-ictal recovery may be longer. Although not always available, an EEG…

hpo:HP:0007281.definizione: A cessation of the development of a child in the areas of motor skills, speech and language, cognitive skills, and social and/or emotional skills.

hpo:HP:0007301.definizione: Oral-motor apraxia is the inability to volitionally sequence oral movements of the speech structure for nonspeech tasks in the absence of neuromuscular deficits such as paralysis or muscle weakness. Oral-motor apraxia is diagnosed when, despite intact sensory motor function an individual is unable to use these effector systems under voluntary control.

hpo:HP:0007302.definizione: Bipolar disorder is an illness of mood characterized by alternating episodes of elevated and depressed moods, which are interspersed with euthymic periods.

hpo:HP:0007305.definizione: A loss of myelin from nerve fibers in the central nervous system.

hpo:HP:0007325.definizione: A type of dystonia that affects all or most of the body.

hpo:HP:0007328.definizione: Reduced ability to perceive painful stimuli.

hpo:HP:0007332.definizione: Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face.

hpo:HP:0007333.definizione: Underdevelopment of the frontal lobe of the cerebrum.

hpo:HP:0007338.definizione: A saccade that overshoots the target with the dynamic saccade.

hpo:HP:0007340.definizione: Weakness of the muscles of the legs.

hpo:HP:0007350.definizione: Increased intensity of the a reflex in the arm.

hpo:HP:0007351.definizione: A type of tremors that is triggered by holding an arm in a fixed position.

hpo:HP:0007359.definizione: A focal-onset seizure is a type of seizure originating within networks limited to one hemisphere. They may be discretely localized or more widely distributed, and may originate in subcortical structures.

hpo:HP:0007369.definizione: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the cerebrum, also known as the telencephalon, the largest and most highly developed part of the human brain.

hpo:HP:0007370.definizione: Absence or underdevelopment of the corpus callosum.

hpo:HP:0007371.definizione: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the corpus callosum.

hpo:HP:0007376.definizione: An abnormality of the choroid plexus, which is the area in the cerebral ventricles in which cerebrospinal fluid is produced by modified ependymal cells.

hpo:HP:0007377.definizione: An abnormality of somatosensory evoked potentials (SSEP), i.e., of the electrical signals of sensation going from the body to the brain in response to a defined stimulus. Recording electrodes are placed over the scalp, spine, and peripheral nerves proximal to the stimulation site. Clinical studies generally use electrical stimulation of peripheral nerves to elicit potentials. SSEP testing…

hpo:HP:0007380.definizione: Telangiectases (small dilated blood vessels) located near the surface of the skin of the face.

hpo:HP:0007385.nome: Aplasia cutis congenita del cuoio capelluto
hpo:HP:0007385.definizione: A developmental defect resulting in the congenital absence of skin on the scalp.

hpo:HP:0007401.definizione: A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and neurosensory retinal cells in the macula.

hpo:HP:0007410.definizione: An abnormally increased perspiration on palms and soles.

hpo:HP:0007413.definizione: Naevus flammeus localized in the skin of the forehead.

hpo:HP:0007417.definizione: Cutaneous lesion that develops as a dry, scaly, red patch that evolves to an indurated and hyperpigmented plaque with adherent scale. Scarring may result in central white patches (loss of pigmentation) and skin atrophy.

hpo:HP:0007420.definizione: Spontaneous development of hematomas (hematoma) or bruises without significant trauma.

hpo:HP:0007429.definizione: The presence of two to five cafe-au-lait macules.

hpo:HP:0007430.definizione: Generalized abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin, or in one or more cavities of the body.

hpo:HP:0007443.definizione: Absence of melanin pigment in various areas, which is found at birth and is permanent. The lesions are known as leucoderma and are often found on the face, trunk, or limbs.

hpo:HP:0007460.definizione: The spontaneous detachment of a digit (finger or toe) from the body due to long standing pathology.

hpo:HP:0007479.definizione: The term collodion baby applies to newborns who appear to have an extra layer of skin (known as a collodion membrane) that has a collodion-like quality. It is a descriptive term, not a specific diagnosis or disorder (as such, it is a syndrome). Affected babies are born in a collodion membrane, a shiny waxy outer layer to the skin. This is shed 10-14 days after birth, revealing the main symptom of…

hpo:HP:0007502.definizione: A skin condition characterized by excessive development of keratin in hair follicles, resulting in rough, cone-shaped, elevated papules resulting from closure of hair follicles with a white plug of sebum.

hpo:HP:0007514.definizione: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on the back of the hands.

hpo:HP:0007556.definizione: Hyperkeratosis affecting the sole of the foot.

hpo:HP:0007565.definizione: The presence of six or more cafe-au-lait spots.

hpo:HP:0007588.definizione: Increased pigmentation of the skin with a netlike (reticular) pattern.

hpo:HP:0007598.definizione: The distal and proximal transverse palmar creases are merged into a single transverse palmar crease on both hands.

hpo:HP:0007616.definizione: Naevus flammeus localized in the skin of the neck. This is one of the most common birthmarks and present in approximately 25% of all newborns.

hpo:HP:0007641.definizione: A form of colorblindness in which only two of the three fundamental colors can be distinguished due to a lack of one of the retinal cone pigments.

hpo:HP:0007646.definizione: Lack of eyelashes on the lower lid.

hpo:HP:0007678.definizione: Narrowing of a tear duct (lacrimal duct).

hpo:HP:0007720.definizione: Cornea plana is an abnormally flat shape of the cornea such that the normal protrusion of the cornea from the sclera is missing. The reduced corneal curvature can lead to hyperopia, and a hazy corneal limbus and arcus lipoides may develop at an early age.

hpo:HP:0007722.definizione: A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE).

hpo:HP:0007730.definizione: An abnormal reduction in the amount of pigmentation of the iris.

hpo:HP:0007737.nome: Pigmentazione a spicole ossee della retina
hpo:HP:0007737.definizione: Pigment migration into the retina in a bone-spicule configuration (resembling the nucleated cells within the lacuna of bone).

hpo:HP:0007754.definizione: Macular dystrophy is a nonspecific term for retinal degeneration, generally confined to the macula, usually presumed of genetic origin.

hpo:HP:0007763.definizione: Localized, irregular dilatation of small tortuous intraretinal blood vessels.

hpo:HP:0007765.definizione: Increased depth of the anterior chamber, i.e., the anteroposterior distance between the cornea and the iris is increased.

hpo:HP:0007766.definizione: Underdevelopment of the optic disc, that is of the optic nerve head, where ganglion cell axons exit the eye to form the optic nerve.

hpo:HP:0007772.definizione: An impairment of the ability to track objects with the ocular smooth pursuit system, a class of rather slow eye movements that minimizes retinal target motion.

hpo:HP:0007787.definizione: A type of cataract affecting the posterior pole of lens immediately adjacent to ('beneath') the Lens capsule.

hpo:HP:0007800.nome: Aumentata lunghezza assiale del bulbo oculare
hpo:HP:0007800.definizione: Abnormal largeness of the eye with an axial length > 2.5 standard deviations from population mean.

hpo:HP:0007814.definizione: Mottling (spots or blotches of different shades) of the retinal pigment epithelium, i.e., localized or generalized fundus pigment granularity associated with processes at the level of the retinal pigment epithelium.

hpo:HP:0007819.definizione: Presenile cataract is a kind of cataract that occurs in early adulthood, that is, at an age that is younger than usual.

hpo:HP:0007843.definizione: Narrowing of the retinal blood vessels, both arterioles and venules.

hpo:HP:0007859.definizione: Horizontal nystagmus dating from or present at birth.

hpo:HP:0007874.definizione: A shape created by an acute downward arching of the upper eyelid and upward arching of the lower eyelid, toward the medial canthus, which gives the outline of the palpebral fissures the configuration of an almond. Thus, the maximum distance between the fissures is offset from, and medial to, the center point.

hpo:HP:0007885.definizione: An abnormally slow velocity of horizontal saccadic eye movements.

hpo:HP:0007894.definizione: Generalized or focal reduced pigmentation of the fundus, evaluated in the context of skin and hair color. Fundoscopy may reveal a low level pigment.

hpo:HP:0007902.definizione: Bleeding within the vitreous compartment of the eye.

hpo:HP:0007906.definizione: Intraocular pressure that is 2 standard deviations above the population mean.

hpo:HP:0007928.nome: Potenziali evocati visivi da flash anomali
hpo:HP:0007928.definizione: Anomaly of the visual evoked potentials elicited by a flash stimulus, generally a flash of light subtending an angle of at least 20 degrees of the visual field and presented in a dimly lit room.

hpo:HP:0007933.definizione: Regional increase in the width (height) of the lateral eyebrow.

hpo:HP:0007968.definizione: Persistence of the hyaloid artery, which is the embryonic artery that runs from the optic disc to the posterior lens capsule may persist; the site of attachment may form an opacity. The hyaloid artery is a branch of the ophthalmic artery, and usually regresses completely before birth. This features results from a failure of regression of the hyaloid vessel, which supplies the primary vitreous…

hpo:HP:0007973.definizione: Abnormal growth and differentiation, structure and appearance of the retina present from birth.

hpo:HP:0007979.definizione: Horizontal nystagmus made apparent by looking to the right or to the left.

hpo:HP:0007994.definizione: Loss of peripheral vision with retention of central vision, resulting in a constricted circular tunnel-like field of vision.

hpo:HP:0008043.definizione: Focal decreased retinal arteriolar diameters, which may decrease blood flow and slow oxygen delivery to regions of the retina.

hpo:HP:0008066.definizione: The presence of one or more bullae on the skin, defined as fluid-filled blisters more than 5 mm in diameter with thin walls.

hpo:HP:0008079.definizione: A developmental abnormality characterized by the absence of the fifth metatarsal bone.

hpo:HP:0008080.definizione: Medial deviation of the great toe owing to a deformity of the great toe joint causing the hallux to deviate medially.

hpo:HP:0008081.definizione: An outward (valgus) deviation of the calcaneus relative to the longitudinal axis of the lower leg at the talocalcaneal (subtalar) joint, such that the heel is everted.

hpo:HP:0008094.definizione: An overall widening of the spaces between the digits.

hpo:HP:0008112.definizione: A type of contracture in which the plantar flexion muscles are contracted.

hpo:HP:0008151.definizione: Increased time to coagulation in the prothrombin time test, which is a measure of the extrinsic pathway of coagulation. The results of the prothrombin time test are often expressed in terms of the International normalized ratio (INR), which is calculated as a ratio of the patient's prothrombin time (PT) to a control PT standardized for the potency of the thromboplastin reagent developed by the…

hpo:HP:0008155.definizione: Excessive amounts of mucopolysaccharide in the urine.

hpo:HP:0008163.nome: Diminuzione del livello di cortisolo circolante
hpo:HP:0008163.definizione: Abnormally reduced concentration of cortisol in the blood.

hpo:HP:0008166.definizione: Abnormally decreased rate of beta-galactosidase activity. Beta-galactosidase activity can be measured in leukocyte, fibroblast, or plasma.

hpo:HP:0008185.definizione: The onset of puberty before the age of 9 years in boys.

hpo:HP:0008191.definizione: The congenital absence of the thyroid gland.

hpo:HP:0008200.definizione: A type of hyperparathyroidism caused by a primary abnormality of the parathyroid glands (e.g., adenoma, carcinoma, hyperplasia). Primary hyperparathyroidism is associated with hyercalcemia.

hpo:HP:0008202.definizione: A reduced level of prolactin in the blood circulation. Prolactin is a protein hormone that is secreted by lactotrophs in the anterior pituitary and that stimulates mammary gland development and milk production.

hpo:HP:0008207.definizione: Insufficient production of steroid hormones (primarily cortisol) by the adrenal glands as a result of a primary defect in the glands themselves.

hpo:HP:0008209.definizione: Amenorrhea due to loss of ovarian function before the age of 40. Primary ovarian insuficiency (POI) is a state of female hypergonadotropic hypogonadism. It can manifest as primary amenorrhea with onset before menarche or secondary amenorrhea.

hpo:HP:0008214.definizione: A reduction below normal concentration of estradiol in the circulation.

hpo:HP:0008282.definizione: An increased amount of unconjugated (indirect) bilurubin in the blood.

hpo:HP:0008330.nome: Ridotta attività del fattore von Willebrand
hpo:HP:0008330.definizione: Decreased activity of von Willebrand factor. Von Willebrand factor mediates the adhesion of platelets to the collagen exposed on endothelial cell surfaces.

hpo:HP:0008341.definizione: A type of renal tubular acidosis characterized by a failure of acid secretion by the alpha intercalated cells of the cortical collecting duct of the distal nephron. The urine cannot be acidified below a pH of 5.3, associated with acidemia and hypokalemia.

hpo:HP:0008348.definizione: A reduction in immunoglobulin levels of the IgG2 subclass in the blood circulation.

hpo:HP:0008360.definizione: A neonatal decreased concentration of proteins in the blood.

hpo:HP:0008386.definizione: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the nail.

hpo:HP:0008419.definizione: The presence of degenerative changes of intervertebral disk.

hpo:HP:0008430.definizione: Anterior tongue-like protrusions of the vertebral bodies of the lumbar spine.

hpo:HP:0008439.definizione: Absence of one half of the vertebral body in the lumbar spine.

hpo:HP:0008441.definizione: The presence of one or more herniated nucleus pulposus of intervertebral disk.

hpo:HP:0008445.definizione: An abnormal narrowing of the cervical spinal canal.

hpo:HP:0008450.definizione: A reduction of the distance between vertebral pedicles, which are the two short, thick processes, which project backward, one on either side, from the upper part of the vertebral body, at the junction of its posterior and lateral surfaces.

hpo:HP:0008454.definizione: Over curvature of the lumbar region.

hpo:HP:0008456.definizione: A partial dislocation of the intervertebral joint between the second and third cervical vertebrae.

hpo:HP:0008499.definizione: A severe form of hypermetropia with over +5.00 diopters.

hpo:HP:0008504.definizione: The presence of a moderate form of sensorineural hearing impairment.

hpo:HP:0008513.definizione: A bilateral type of conductive hearing impairment.

hpo:HP:0008527.definizione: A type of hearing impairment caused by an abnormal functionality of the cochlear nerve with congenital onset.

hpo:HP:0008542.definizione: A type of hearing impairment affecting primarily the low frequencies of sound (125 Hz to 1000 Hz).

hpo:HP:0008589.definizione: Underdevelopment of the helix, i.e., of the outer rim of the pinna.

hpo:HP:0008619.definizione: A form of sensorineural hearing impairment that affects both ears.

hpo:HP:0008672.definizione: The presence of calcium- and oxalate-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.

hpo:HP:0008676.definizione: A developmental disturbance with extreme ureteral dilatation.

hpo:HP:0008677.definizione: Nephrotic syndrome with onset within the first three months of life.

hpo:HP:0008689.definizione: Absence of both testes from the scrotum owing to failure of the testis or testes to descend through the inguinal canal to the scrotum.

hpo:HP:0008722.definizione: The presence of a diverticulum (sac or pouch) in the wall of the urethra.

hpo:HP:0008734.definizione: Reduced volume of the testicle (the male gonad).

hpo:HP:0008751.definizione: Presence of a gap in the posterior laryngotracheal wall with a continuity between the larynx and the esophagus.

hpo:HP:0008763.definizione: Lack of intentional participation in interactions with another person.

hpo:HP:0008770.definizione: The presence of one or more obsessive-compulsive personality traits. Obsessions refer to persistent intrusive thoughts, and compulsions to intrusive behaviors, which the affected person experiences as involuntary, senseless, or repugnant.

hpo:HP:0008788.definizione: Delayed maturation and calcification of the pubic bone.

hpo:HP:0008807.definizione: A smaller than normal acetabulum that has insufficient femoral head coverage leading to abnormal hip joint contact pressures, instability and pain.

hpo:HP:0008820.definizione: Lack of ossification of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.

hpo:HP:0008824.definizione: Underdevelopment of the body of ilium.

hpo:HP:0008846.definizione: Intrauterine growth retardation that is 4 or more standard deviations below average, corrected for sex and gestational age.

hpo:HP:0008850.definizione: Severely slow or limited growth after birth, being four standard deviations or more below age- and sex-related norms.

hpo:HP:0008872.nome: Difficoltà di alimentazione nella prima infanzia
hpo:HP:0008872.definizione: Impaired feeding performance of an infant as manifested by difficulties such as weak and ineffective sucking, brief bursts of sucking, and falling asleep during sucking. There may be difficulties with chewing or maintaining attention.

hpo:HP:0008873.definizione: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short limbs but an average-sized trunk.

hpo:HP:0008887.definizione: A reduction in the amount of adipose tissue (fat) compared with the amount previously present in an individual.

hpo:HP:0008897.definizione: Slow or limited growth after birth.

hpo:HP:0008905.definizione: Disproportionate shortening of the proximal segment of limbs (i.e. the femur and humerus).

hpo:HP:0008915.definizione: Truncal obesity with onset during childhood, defined as between 2 and 10 years of age.

hpo:HP:0008935.definizione: Muscular hypotonia (abnormally low muscle tone) manifesting in the neonatal period and affecting the entire musculature.

hpo:HP:0008936.definizione: Muscular hypotonia (abnormally low muscle tone) affecting the musculature of the trunk.

hpo:HP:0008944.definizione: Muscular atrophy of distal leg muscles.

hpo:HP:0008947.definizione: Floppiness/hypotonia is defined as reduced resistance to passive movement of joints. Physical examination of floppy/hypotonic infants shows head lag, lack of shoulder and elbow muscle contraction on traction response, inability to tighten the shoulder girdle muscles (or slipping through) when held under the axillae, scarf sign (when the arm is pulled to the opposite side, the arm wraps around the…

hpo:HP:0008948.definizione: Muscular atrophy affecting proximally located muscles of the arms.

hpo:HP:0008954.nome: Atrofia dei muscoli intrinseci della mano
hpo:HP:0008954.definizione: Atrophy of the intrinsic muscle groups of the hand, comprising the thenar and hypothenar muscles; the interossei muscles; and the lumbrical muscles.

hpo:HP:0008956.definizione: Muscular atrophy affecting proximally located muscles of the legs, i.e., of the thigh.

hpo:HP:0008959.definizione: Reduced strength of the distal musculature of the arms.

hpo:HP:0008968.definizione: Muscle hypertrophy primarily affecting the legs.

hpo:HP:0008981.definizione: Muscle hypertrophy affecting the calf muscles.

hpo:HP:0008994.nome: Debolezza muscolare prossimale degli arti inferiori
hpo:HP:0008994.definizione: A lack of strength of the proximal muscles of the legs.

hpo:HP:0008997.nome: Debolezza muscolare prossimale degli arti superiori
hpo:HP:0008997.definizione: A lack of strength of the proximal muscles of the arms.

hpo:HP:0009027.definizione: Weakness of the muscles responsible for dorsiflexion of the foot, that is, of the movement of the toes towards the shin. The foot dorsiflexors include the tibialis anterior, the extensor hallucis longus, the extensor digitorum longus, and the peroneus tertius muscles.

hpo:HP:0009049.definizione: Atrophy of the peroneous muscles, peroneus longus (also known as Fibularis longus), Peroneus brevis (also known as fibularis brevis, and Peroneus tertius (also known as fibularis tertius).

hpo:HP:0009053.nome: Debolezza muscolare degli arti inferiori distali
hpo:HP:0009053.definizione: Reduced strength of the distal musculature of the legs.

hpo:HP:0009064.definizione: Generalized degenerative changes of the fat tissue.

hpo:HP:0009072.definizione: Decreased intensity of the Achilles reflex (also known as the ankle jerk reflex), which can be elicited by tapping the tendon is tapped while the foot is dorsiflexed.

hpo:HP:0009073.definizione: Lack of strength of the proximal muscles that becomes progressively more severe.

hpo:HP:0009085.definizione: Increased width of the alveolar ridges.

hpo:HP:0009088.definizione: Impairment in the physical production of speech sounds.

hpo:HP:0009098.definizione: Chronic accumulation and overgrowth of the fungus Candida albicans on the mucous membranes of the mouth, generally manifested as associated with creamy white lesions on the tongue or inner cheeks, occasionally spreading to the gums, tonsils, palate or oropharynx.

hpo:HP:0009099.definizione: Cleft palate of the midline of the palate.

hpo:HP:0009110.definizione: A congenital failure of muscular development of part or all of one or both hemidiaphragms, resulting in superior displacement of abdominal viscera and altered lung development.

hpo:HP:0009129.definizione: Muscular atrophy involving the muscles of the upper limbs.

hpo:HP:0009130.definizione: Muscular atrophy involving the muscles of the hand.

hpo:HP:0009237.definizione: Hypoplasia (congenital reduction in size) of the fifth finger, also known as the little finger.

hpo:HP:0009380.definizione: A developmental defect resulting in the presence of fewer than the normal number of fingers (i.e., aplasia of one or more fingers).

hpo:HP:0009381.definizione: Abnormally short finger associated with developmental hypoplasia.

hpo:HP:0009473.definizione: Contractures of one ore more joints of the hands meaning chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.

hpo:HP:0009486.definizione: An abnormal position of the hand in which the wrist is bent toward the radius (i.e., toward the thumb).

hpo:HP:0009487.definizione: Divergence of the longitudinal axis of the hand at the wrist in a posterior (ulnar) direction (i.e., towards the little finger).

hpo:HP:0009536.definizione: Hypoplasia of the second finger, also known as the index finger.

hpo:HP:0009577.definizione: Hypoplasia (congenital reduction in size) of the middle phalanx of the second finger, also known as the index finger.

hpo:HP:0009592.definizione: Astrocytoma is a neoplasm of the central nervous system derived from astrocytes. Astrocytes are a type of glial cell, and thus astrocytoma is a subtype of glioma.

hpo:HP:0009594.definizione: A hamartoma (a benign, focal malformation consisting of a disorganized mixture of cells and tissues) of the retina.

hpo:HP:0009622.definizione: Insertion of thumb at a more distal location than normal.

hpo:HP:0009638.definizione: Hypoplastic (short) proximal phalanx of the thumb. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.

hpo:HP:0009656.definizione: Congenital fusion (ankylosis) of the interphalangeal joint of the thumb.

hpo:HP:0009702.definizione: Synostosis (bony fusion) involving one or more bones of the carpus (scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum, trapezium, trapezoid, capitate, hamate, pisiform).

hpo:HP:0009716.definizione: Small nodular masses which originate in the subependymal region of the lateral ventricles and protrude into the ventricular cavity. They may represent subependymal hamartomas of tuberous sclerosis.

hpo:HP:0009717.definizione: Cortical tubers in the brain are hamartomatous lesions typically located at the gray-white matter interface, commonly in the frontal and parietal lobes. Cortical tubers are composed of abnormal glial and neural cells, and the size, number, and location vary among patients.

hpo:HP:0009719.definizione: Hypomelanotic macules ("ash leaf spots") are white or lighter patches of skin that may appear anywhere on the body and are caused by a lack of melanin. White ash leaf-shaped macules are considered to be characteristic of tuberous sclerosis.

hpo:HP:0009721.definizione: A plaque representing a connective-tissue nevus. Connective tissue naevi are uncommon skin lesions that occur when the deeper layers of the skin do not develop correctly or the components of these layers occur in the wrong proportion. Shagreen patches are oval-shaped and nevoid, skin-colored or occasionally pigmented, smooth or crinkled. The word shagreen refers to a type of roughened untanned…

hpo:HP:0009722.definizione: The presence of small depressions in the dental enamel.

hpo:HP:0009729.definizione: A benign tumor of cardiac striated muscle.

hpo:HP:0009732.definizione: A neurofibroma in which Schwann cells proliferate inside the nerve sheath, producing an irregularly thickened, distorted, tortuous structure.

hpo:HP:0009733.definizione: The presence of a glioma, which is a neoplasm of the central nervous system originating from a glial cell (astrocytes or oligodendrocytes).

hpo:HP:0009734.definizione: A glioma originating in the optic nerve or optic chiasm.

hpo:HP:0009735.definizione: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the spine.

hpo:HP:0009746.definizione: Abnormally increased thickness of the nasal septum.

hpo:HP:0009747.definizione: Abnormally increased hair growth in the lumbosacral region.

hpo:HP:0009748.definizione: Increased volume of the earlobe, that is, abnormally prominent ear lobules.

hpo:HP:0009751.definizione: Absence of the pectoralis major muscle.

hpo:HP:0009765.definizione: Columella extending inferior to the level of the nasal base, when viewed from the side.

hpo:HP:0009771.nome: Difetti osteolitici delle falangi della mano
hpo:HP:0009771.definizione: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the phalanges of the hand.

hpo:HP:0009777.definizione: Absent thumb, i.e., the absence of both phalanges of a thumb and the associated soft tissues.

hpo:HP:0009778.definizione: Hypoplasia (congenital reduction in size) of the thumb.

hpo:HP:0009781.definizione: A zone of darker pigmentation around the central part of the iris with a roughly cloverleaf or flower shape.

hpo:HP:0009789.definizione: The presence of an abscess located around the anus.

hpo:HP:0009791.definizione: Presence of a bifid sacral bone.

hpo:HP:0009794.definizione: Congenital developmental defect arising from the primitive branchial apparatus.

hpo:HP:0009803.definizione: Short (hypoplastic) phalanx of finger, affecting one or more phalanges.

hpo:HP:0009804.definizione: The absence of one or more teeth from the normal series by a failure to develop

hpo:HP:0009812.nome: Amelia che coinvolge gli arti superiori
hpo:HP:0009812.definizione: Amelia of one or both upper limbs.

hpo:HP:0009813.definizione: Missing or malformed long bones of the upper limbs with the distal parts (the hands) connected to the variably shortened or even absent upper extremity, leading to a flipper-like appearance, as opposed to other forms of limb malformations were either the whole limb is missing (such as amelia), or the distal part of a limb is absent (peromelia).

hpo:HP:0009824.definizione: Arm shortening because of underdevelopment of one or more bones of the upper extremity.

hpo:HP:0009826.definizione: Limb shortening because of underdevelopment of one or more bones of the extremities.

hpo:HP:0009878.nome: Atassia cerebellare associata ad andatura quadrupedica
hpo:HP:0009878.definizione: The presence of cerebellar signs and symptoms such as lack of balance associated with quadrupedal gait (locomotion on all four extremities with a 'bear-like' gait with the legs held straight).

hpo:HP:0009879.definizione: An abnormality of the cerebral cortex with fewer gyri but with normal cortical thickness. This pattern is usually often associated with congenital microcephaly.
