hpo:HP:0009882.definizione: Short distance from the end of the finger to the most distal interphalangeal crease or the distal interphalangeal joint flexion point. That is, hypoplasia of one or more of the distal phalanx of finger.

hpo:HP:0009884.definizione: A reduction in diameter of the distal phalanx of finger towards the distal end.

hpo:HP:0009890.definizione: Distance between the hairline (trichion) and the glabella (the most prominent point on the frontal bone above the root of the nose), in the midline, more than two SD above the mean. Alternatively, an apparently increased distance between the hairline and the glabella.

hpo:HP:0009891.definizione: Flatness of the supraorbital portion of the frontal bones.

hpo:HP:0009894.definizione: Increased thickness of the external ear.

hpo:HP:0009901.definizione: Distortion of the course of the normal folds of the ear and the appearance of supernumerary crura and folds.

hpo:HP:0009902.definizione: A notched form of the helix of the ear. That is, a defect in the continuity of the helix, which may occur at any point along its length.

hpo:HP:0009905.definizione: Decreased thickness of the helix of the ear.

hpo:HP:0009907.definizione: Attachment of the lobe to the side of the face at the lowest point of the lobe without curving upward.

hpo:HP:0009908.definizione: Sharply demarcated, typically linear and approximately horizontal, indentations in the outer surface of the ear lobe.

hpo:HP:0009909.definizione: An abnormal orientation of the earlobes such that they point out- and upward. That is, the lateral surface of ear lobe faces superiorly.

hpo:HP:0009921.definizione: A condition associated with a limitation of the horizontal ocular movement with retraction of the globe and narrowing of the palpebral fissure on adduction

hpo:HP:0009928.definizione: Increase in bulk of the ala nasi.

hpo:HP:0009933.definizione: Slender, slit-like aperture of the nostril.

hpo:HP:0009942.definizione: Complete or partial duplication of the phalanges of the thumb. Depending on the severity, the appearance on x-ray can vary from a notched phalanx (the duplicated bone is almost completely fused with the phalanx), a partially fused appearance of the two bones (bifid), two separate bones appearing side to side, or completely duplicated phalanges. In contrast to the phalanges of the digits 2-5…

hpo:HP:0009944.nome: Duplicazione parziale della falange del pollice
hpo:HP:0009944.definizione: A partial duplication, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance, affecting one or more of the phalanges of the thumb. As opposed to a complete duplication there is still a variable degree of fusion between the duplicated bones.

hpo:HP:0010034.definizione: A developmental defect characterized by reduced length of the first metacarpal (long bone) of the hand.

hpo:HP:0010035.definizione: Absent first metacarpal (long bone) of the hand.

hpo:HP:0010049.definizione: Diminished length of one or more metacarpal bones in relation to the others of the same hand or to the contralateral metacarpal.

hpo:HP:0010055.definizione: Visible increase in width of the hallux without an increase in the dorso-ventral dimension.

hpo:HP:0010107.definizione: Underdevelopment (hypoplasia) of the proximal phalanx of big toe.

hpo:HP:0010112.definizione: The presence of a supernumerary toe (not a hallux) involving the third or fourth metatarsal with associated osseous syndactyly.

hpo:HP:0010282.definizione: Height of the vermilion of the medial part of the lower lip more than 2 SD below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently reduced height of the vermilion of the lower lip in the frontal view (subjective).

hpo:HP:0010297.definizione: Tongue with a median apical indentation or fork.

hpo:HP:0010300.definizione: A persistent (minutes to hours) abnormal decrease in the pitch of the voice for the context or social situation or significantly different from the baseline of the individual.

hpo:HP:0010307.definizione: Stridor is a high pitched sound resulting from turbulent air flow in the upper airway.

hpo:HP:0010316.nome: Anomalia di Ebstein della valvola tricuspide
hpo:HP:0010316.definizione: Ebstein's anomaly refers to an abnormally placed and deformed tricuspid valve characterized by apical displacement of the septal and posterior tricuspid valve leaflets, leading to atrialization of the right ventricle with a variable degree of malformation and displacement of the anterior leaflet.

hpo:HP:0010445.definizione: An ostium primum atrial septal defect is located in the most anterior and inferior aspect of the atrial septum. The ostium primum refers to an anterior and inferior opening (ostium) within the septum primum, which divides the rudimentary atrium during fetal development. The ostium primum is normally sealed by fusion of the superior and inferior endocardial cushions around 5 weeks' gestation.…

hpo:HP:0010446.definizione: A narrowing of the orifice of the tricuspid valve of the heart.

hpo:HP:0010465.definizione: The onset of puberty before the age of 8 years in girls.

hpo:HP:0010471.definizione: Increased urinary excretion of oligosaccharides (low molecular weight carbohydrate chains composed of at least three monosaccharide subunits), derived from a partial degradation of glycoproteins.

hpo:HP:0010485.definizione: The ability of the elbow joint to move beyond its normal range of motion.

hpo:HP:0010487.definizione: Reduced muscle mass on the ulnar side of the palm, that is, reduction in size of the hypothenar eminence.

hpo:HP:0010489.definizione: The absence of the major creases of the palm (distal transverse crease, proximal transverse crease, or thenar crease).

hpo:HP:0010499.definizione: The kneecap normally is located within the groove termed trochlea on the distal femur and can slide up and down in it. Patellar subluxation refers to an unstable kneecap that does not slide centrally within its groove, i.e., a partial dislocation of the patella.

hpo:HP:0010515.definizione: Absence or underdevelopment of the thymus.

hpo:HP:0010524.definizione: Alteration or impairment in the processing or interpretation of sensory information can lead to abnormal perceptions or experiences.

hpo:HP:0010544.definizione: Vertical nystagmus may present with either up-beating or down-beating eye movements or both. When present in the straight-ahead position of gaze it is referred to as upbeat nystagmus or downbeat nystagmus.

hpo:HP:0010546.definizione: Fine, rapid twitching of individual muscle fibers with little or no movement of the muscle as a whole as ascertained by electromyography (EMG). If a motor neuron or its axon is destroyed, the muscle fibers it innervates undergo denervation atrophy. This leads to hypersensitivity of individual muscle fibers to acetyl choline so that they may contract spontaneously. Isolated activity of individual…

hpo:HP:0010553.definizione: An acute dystonic reaction with blepharospasm, periorbital twitches, and protracted fixed staring episodes. There may be a maximal upward deviation of the eyes in the sustained fashion. Oculogyric crisis can be triggered by a number of factors including neuroleptic medications.

hpo:HP:0010554.definizione: A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints, or a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two fingers that lies significantly distal to the flexion crease that overlies the metacarpophalangeal joint of the adjacent fingers.

hpo:HP:0010559.definizione: An abnormal vertical orientation of the clivus (which normally forms a kind of slope from the sella turcica down to the region of the foramen magnum).

hpo:HP:0010564.definizione: A midline anterior-posterior cleft of the epiglottis that involves at least two-thirds of the epiglottic leaf. It is a useful feature for clinical diagnosis because it appears to be very rare in syndromes other than Pallister-Hall-Syndrome and is also rare as an isolated malformation.

hpo:HP:0010567.definizione: Y-shaped metatarsals are the result of a partial fusion of two metatarsal bones, with the two arms of the Y pointing in the distal direction. Y-shaped metatarsals may be seen in combination with polydactyly.

hpo:HP:0010575.definizione: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the femoral head.

hpo:HP:0010576.definizione: A cystic lesion originating within the brain.

hpo:HP:0010579.definizione: Cone-shaped epiphyses (also known as coned epiphyses) are epiphyses that invaginate into cupped metaphyses. That is, the epiphysis has a cone-shaped distal extension resulting from increased growth of the central portion of the epiphysis relative to its periphery.

hpo:HP:0010582.definizione: An alteration of the normally smooth contour of the epiphysis leading to an irregular appearance.

hpo:HP:0010605.definizione: A chronic epithelioid cell granulomatous inflammation of the meibomian gland caused by inflammation of a blocked meibomian gland. A chalazion or meibomian cyst appears as a painless tuberous swelling in the upper lid without loss of eyelashes.

hpo:HP:0010615.definizione: Angiofibroma consist of many often dilated vessels.

hpo:HP:0010621.nome: Sindattilia cutanea delle dita dei piedi
hpo:HP:0010621.definizione: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between adjacent foot digits that involves at least half of the proximodistal length of one of the two involved digits; or, a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits of the foot that does not meet the prior objective criteria.

hpo:HP:0010627.definizione: Underdevelopment of the anterior pituitary gland.

hpo:HP:0010631.definizione: Any abnormality of the epiphyses of the feet.

hpo:HP:0010639.nome: Fosfatasi alcalina elevata di origine ossea
hpo:HP:0010639.definizione: An abnormally increased level of bone isoforms of alkaline phosphatase, tissue-nonspecific isozyme in the blood.

hpo:HP:0010646.definizione: An abnormal lack of stability of the cervical spine.

hpo:HP:0010648.definizione: An abnormally increased ability of the skin to permit light to pass through (translucency) such that subcutaneous structures such as veins display an increased degree of visibility.

hpo:HP:0010669.definizione: Underdevelopment of the zygomatic bone. That is, a reduction in size of the zygomatic bone, including the zygomatic process of the temporal bone of the skull, which forms part of the zygomatic arch.

hpo:HP:0010701.definizione: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of immunoglobulins in blood.

hpo:HP:0010702.nome: Aumento del livello di anticorpi circolanti
hpo:HP:0010702.definizione: An increased level of gamma globulin (immunoglobulin) in the blood.

hpo:HP:0010704.definizione: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the thumb to the index finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.

hpo:HP:0010720.definizione: An abnormality of the distribution of hair growth.

hpo:HP:0010721.definizione: An abnormal hair whorl (that is, a patch of hair growing in the opposite direction of the rest of the hair).

hpo:HP:0010722.definizione: An asymmetriy, i.e., difference in size, shape or position between the left and right ear.

hpo:HP:0010729.definizione: Pallor of the perifoveal macula of the retina with appearance of a small circular reddish choroid shape as seen through the fovea centralis due to relative transparency of the macula.

hpo:HP:0010743.definizione: Diminished length of a metatarsal bone, with resultant proximal displacement of the associated toe.

hpo:HP:0010747.definizione: An abnormal distribution of eyebrow hair growth in the medial direction.

hpo:HP:0010749.definizione: Blepharochalasis is characterized by recurrent, non-painful, nonerythematous episodes of eyelid edema. It has been divided into hypertrophic and atrophic forms. In the hypertrophic form recurrent edema results in orbital fat herniation through a weakened orbital septum. Most patients who have blepharochalasis present in an atrophic condition with atrophy of redundant eyelid skin and superior…

hpo:HP:0010750.definizione: Loss of elasticity of the upper and lower eyelids causing the skin to sag and bulge.

hpo:HP:0010751.definizione: A persistent midline depression of the skin over the fat pad of the chin.

hpo:HP:0010757.definizione: Absence of the premaxilla, which is the embryonic structure that forms the anterior part of the maxilla.

hpo:HP:0010760.definizione: Aplasia of a toe. That is, absence of all phalanges of a non-hallux digit of the foot and the associated soft tissues.

hpo:HP:0010763.definizione: Insertion of the posterior columella below the nasal base.

hpo:HP:0010765.definizione: Abnormal thickening of the skin localized to the palm of the hand.

hpo:HP:0010772.definizione: A developmental defect characterized by abnormal connection of one or more pulmonary veins to the superior or inferior vena cava, the right atrium, or the coronary sinus, resulting in a left-to-right shunt of oxygenated blood.

hpo:HP:0010773.definizione: A form of anomalous pulmonary venous return in which not all pulmonary veins drain abnormally. Partial anomalous pulmonary venous return frequently involves one or both of the veins from one lung.

hpo:HP:0010794.definizione: Reduced ability affecting mainly visuospatial cognition which may be tested using pattern construction (for example by Differential Ability Scales, which test a person's strengths and weaknesses across a range of intellectual abilities).

hpo:HP:0010800.definizione: Lack of paramedian peaks and median notch of the upper lip vermilion.

hpo:HP:0010803.definizione: Inner aspect of the upper lip vermilion (normally apposing the teeth) visible in a frontal view, i.e., the presence of an everted upper lip.

hpo:HP:0010804.definizione: Triangular appearance of the oral aperture with the apex in the midpoint of the upper vermilion and the lower vermilion forming the base.

hpo:HP:0010807.definizione: Visible space between the dental arches in occlusion.

hpo:HP:0010808.definizione: Tongue extending beyond the alveolar ridges or teeth at rest.

hpo:HP:0010809.definizione: Increased width of the uvula (subjective finding).

hpo:HP:0010818.definizione: A generalized tonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, often with neck stiffening without a subsequent clonic phase. The tonic activity can be a sustained abnormal posture, either in extension or flexion, sometimes accompanied by tremor of the extremities.

hpo:HP:0010821.definizione: Focal emotional seizure with laughing (gelastic) is characterized by bursts of laughter or giggling, usually without appropriate related emotion of happiness, and described as 'mirthless'.

hpo:HP:0010830.definizione: A reduced sense of touch (tactile sensation). This is usually tested with a wisp of cotton or a fine camel's hair brush, by asking patients to say 'now' each time they feel the stimulus.

hpo:HP:0010831.definizione: A loss or impairment of the sensation of the relative position of parts of the body and joint position.

hpo:HP:0010836.nome: Concentrazione anormale di rame in circolo
hpo:HP:0010836.definizione: Any deviation from the normal concentration of copper cation in the blood circulation.

hpo:HP:0010841.definizione: An abnormality in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG) and being identified at multiple locations (foci).

hpo:HP:0010843.definizione: Focal (localized) slow activity reflects focal dysfunction, not diffuse dysfunction (i.e., encephalopathy).

hpo:HP:0010844.definizione: Multifocal slowing of cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

hpo:HP:0010845.definizione: Diffuse slowing of cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

hpo:HP:0010851.definizione: The burst suppression pattern in electroencephalography refers to a characteristic periodic pattern of low voltage (<10 microvolts) suppressed background and a relatively shorter pattern of higher amplitude slow, sharp, and spiking complexes.

hpo:HP:0010862.nome: Ritardo nello sviluppo della motricità fine
hpo:HP:0010862.definizione: A type of motor delay characterized by a delay in acquiring the ability to control the fingers and hands.

hpo:HP:0010863.definizione: A delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others.

hpo:HP:0010864.definizione: Severe intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by severely sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) the range of 20-34.

hpo:HP:0010872.definizione: An inversion of the T-wave (which is normally positive).

hpo:HP:0010875.definizione: A diagnostic reflex elicited by stimulation of the skin over the surface of the lateral malleolus of the foot. The Chaddock refelx is present if there is extension of one or more or all of the toes with or without fanning of them when the external inframalleolar skin is stimulated. The Chaddock sign, similar to the Babinski sign, is taken to be an indication of disease of the spinocortical…

hpo:HP:0010877.definizione: A type of strabismus in which the fixating eye is always the same one, while the other eye is constantly deviated. Monocular strabismus is to be distinguished from alternating strabismus, in which either of the eyes 'squints' at different times.

hpo:HP:0010878.definizione: The presence during the prenatal period of a cystic mass with multiple septa with multiple, asymmetric, thin-walled cysts near the posterior aspect of the neck. Fetal cystic hygroma can be defined as nuchal translucency with or without septations measuring greater than 3.0 mm. Increased NT refers to a measurement above the 95th centile, and the term is used irrespective of whether the collection…

hpo:HP:0010880.definizione: Nuchal translucency is the sonographic appearance of subcutaneous accumulation of liquid in the back of the fetal neck in the first trimester of pregnancy (11-14 gestational weeks of pregnancy).

hpo:HP:0010881.definizione: An abnormality of the umbilical cord, which is the cord connecting the developing embryo or fetus to the placenta.

hpo:HP:0010882.definizione: A congenital disorder of the pulmonary valve in which the orifice of the valve fails to develop.

hpo:HP:0010884.definizione: Shortening of the extremities affecting primarily the distal parts of the limbs (hands and feet) in relation to the other segments of the limbs.

hpo:HP:0010910.definizione: The concentration of valine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0010911.definizione: The concentration of leucine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0010913.definizione: The concentration of isoleucine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0010931.nome: Concentrazione anormale di sodio nel sangue
hpo:HP:0010931.definizione: Any deviation from the normal concentration of sodium in the blood circulation.

hpo:HP:0010938.nome: Anomalia della morfologia del naso esterno
hpo:HP:0010938.definizione: An abnormality of the external nose.

hpo:HP:0010943.definizione: Echogenic bowel is defined as fetal bowel with homogenous areas of echogenicity that are equal to or greater than that of surrounding bone.

hpo:HP:0010945.definizione: Mild pyelectasis is defined as a hypoechoic spherical or elliptical space within the renal pelvis that measures at least 5mm and not more than 10 mm. The measurement is taken on a transverse section through the fetal renal pelvis using the maximum anterior-to-posterior measurement.

hpo:HP:0010946.definizione: The presence of dilatation of the renal pelvis.

hpo:HP:0010953.definizione: A form of hydrocephalus in which the flow of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) within the cerebral ventricular system or in the outlets of the CSF to the arachnoid space is obstructed.

hpo:HP:0010975.definizione: The absolute number of B cells in the blood, per microlitre is outside the limits of normal of the reference range for the appropriate sex and age-group.

hpo:HP:0010976.definizione: The absolute number of B cells in the blood, per microlitre is below the lower limit of normal of the reference range for the appropriate sex and age-group.

hpo:HP:0010993.definizione: An abnormality of the cerebral subcortex.

hpo:HP:0011001.definizione: An abnormal increase of bone mineral density, that is, of the amount of matter per cubic centimeter of bones which is often referred to as osteosclerosis. Osteosclerosis can be detected on radiological examination as an increased whiteness (density) of affected bones.

hpo:HP:0011003.definizione: A severe form of myopia with greater than -6.00 diopters.

hpo:HP:0011015.nome: Concentrazione anomala di glucosio nel sangue
hpo:HP:0011015.definizione: An abnormality of the concentration of glucose in the blood.

hpo:HP:0011024.definizione: An abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract.

hpo:HP:0011037.definizione: A decreased rate of urine production.

hpo:HP:0011039.definizione: An abnormality of the helix. The helix is the outer rim of the ear that extends from the insertion of the ear on the scalp (root) to the termination of the cartilage at the earlobe.

hpo:HP:0011042.nome: Concentrazione anormale di potassio nel sangue
hpo:HP:0011042.definizione: Any deviation from the normal concentration of potassium(1+) in the blood circulation.

hpo:HP:0011069.definizione: The presence of one or more teeth additional to the normal number.

hpo:HP:0011081.definizione: Increased size of the incisor tooth.

hpo:HP:0011087.definizione: Talon cusp is an accessory cusp located near the cingulum (the portion of the lingual or palatal aspect of the tooth that forms a convex protuberance at the cervical third of the anatomic crown).

hpo:HP:0011092.definizione: Mulberry molars are irregular teeth generally affecting the first molars and are characterized by a grossly deformed crown imitating, as the name implies, the surface of a mulberry.

hpo:HP:0011094.definizione: Maxillary teeth cover the mandibular teeth when biting to an increased degree. The feature is defined as a vertical overlap of the maxillary incisors over the mandibular incisors that exceeds 2 mm.

hpo:HP:0011096.definizione: A loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers of the peripheral nervous system.

hpo:HP:0011097.definizione: A sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that is usually more sustained than a myoclonic movement but not as sustained as a tonic seizure. Limited forms may occur: Grimacing, head nodding, or subtle eye movements. Epileptic spasms frequently occur in clusters. Infantile spasms are the best known form, but spasms can occur at all ages

hpo:HP:0011098.definizione: A type of apraxia that is characterized by difficulty or inability to execute speech movements because of problems with coordination and motor problems, leading to incorrect articulation. An increase of errors with increasing word and phrase length may occur.

hpo:HP:0011099.definizione: Unilateral paresis (weakness) with spasticity of the affected muscles and increased tendon reflexes.

hpo:HP:0011107.definizione: Recurrent episodes of ulceration of the oral mucosa, typically presenting as painful, sharply circumscribed fibrin-covered mucosal defects with a hyperemic border.

hpo:HP:0011110.definizione: Inflammation of the tonsils that has occurred repeatedly. The definition of recurrent may vary somewhat, but the criteria used recently as a measure of severity were five or more episodes of true tonsillitis per year, symptoms recurring for at least a year, and episodes that are disabling and that prevent normal functioning. In some cases recurrent tonsillitis may be related to…

hpo:HP:0011120.definizione: Nasal ridge curving posteriorly to an imaginary line that connects the nasal root and tip.

hpo:HP:0011129.definizione: A bilateral form of fetal pyelectasis.

hpo:HP:0011132.definizione: A furuncle (boil) is a skin infection involving an entire hair follicle and nearby skin tissue. Chronic furunculosis refers to recurrent episodes of furuncles, often caused by recurrent staphylococcus infection.

hpo:HP:0011147.definizione: A typical absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by its sudden onset, interruption of ongoing activities, a blank stare, possibly a brief upward deviation of the eyes. Usually the patient will be unresponsive when spoken to. Duration is a few seconds to half a minute with very rapid recovery. Although not always available, an EEG would usually show 3 Hz…

hpo:HP:0011153.definizione: A type of focal-onset seizure characterized by a motor sign as its initial semiological manifestation.

hpo:HP:0011154.definizione: An autonomic seizure is a type of focal non-motor seizure characterized by alteration of autonomic nervous system function as the initial semiological feature.

hpo:HP:0011166.definizione: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sudden, brief (<100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction(s) of muscles(s) or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal). Myoclonus is less regularly repetitive and less sustained than is clonus.

hpo:HP:0011167.definizione: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sustained increase in muscle contraction, lasting a few seconds to minutes.

hpo:HP:0011168.definizione: Focal seizure with eyelid myoclonia, not eyelid myoclonias in the context of absence seizures.

hpo:HP:0011169.definizione: Generalized clonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by sustained bilateral jerking, either symmetric or asymmetric, that is regularly repetitive and involves the same muscle groups.

hpo:HP:0011170.definizione: A generalized myoclonic-atonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by a myoclonic jerk followed by an atonic motor component.

hpo:HP:0011171.definizione: A short generalized seizure, of a duration of <15 min, not recurring within 24 h, occurring during a febrile episode not caused by an acute disease of the nervous system intracranial infection or severe metabolic disturbance.

hpo:HP:0011172.definizione: A febrile seizure that has any of the following features: focal semiology (or associated with post-ictal neurologic abnormalities beyond drowsiness, such as a Todd's paresis), prolonged seizure beyond 15 minutes, or recurring (occurring more than once) in a 24 hour period.

hpo:HP:0011173.nome: Crisi di arresto del comportamento focale
hpo:HP:0011173.definizione: A type of focal non-motor seizure characterized by an arrest or pause of activities, freezing, or immobilization as the predominant semiological feature throughout the seizure.

hpo:HP:0011174.definizione: A focal seizure characterized at onset by predominantly proximal limb or axial muscles producing irregular sequential ballistic movements, such as pedaling, pelvic thrusting, thrashing, rocking movements.

hpo:HP:0011175.definizione: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sustained, forced conjugate ocular, cephalic, and/or truncal rotation or lateral deviation from the midline as the initial semiological manifestation.

hpo:HP:0011179.definizione: EEG dominated by diffuse beta-waves (>13 Hz).

hpo:HP:0011182.definizione: Epileptiform activity refers to distinctive EEG waves or complexes distinguished from background activity found in in a proportion of human subjects with epilepsy, but which can also be found in subjects without seizures. Interictal epileptiform activity refers to such activity that occurs in the absence of a clinical or subclinical seizure.

hpo:HP:0011185.definizione: EEG discharges recorded in particular areas of a localized (focal) abnormality in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).

hpo:HP:0011188.nome: Scariche EEG focali con generalizzazione secondaria
hpo:HP:0011188.definizione: Focal EEG discharges that secondarily spread to both hemispheres and can then be recorded over the entire scalp.

hpo:HP:0011189.definizione: Epileptiform discharges being identified at multiple locations in both hemispheres.

hpo:HP:0011191.definizione: Epileptiform discharges being identified at multiple locations in one hemisphere.

hpo:HP:0011193.definizione: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec.

hpo:HP:0011195.nome: EEG con onde lente acute focali
hpo:HP:0011195.definizione: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

hpo:HP:0011196.definizione: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

hpo:HP:0011197.nome: EEG con onde di picco focali
hpo:HP:0011197.definizione: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

hpo:HP:0011198.definizione: EEG discharges recorded on the entire scalp typically seen in persons with epilepsy.

hpo:HP:0011199.nome: EEG con onde lente acute generalizzate
hpo:HP:0011199.definizione: EEG with generalized sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

hpo:HP:0011204.definizione: EEG showing diffuse slowing without interruption.

hpo:HP:0011205.definizione: Non-continuous diffuse slowing of electroencephalographic patterns.

hpo:HP:0011210.definizione: Slowing in occipital areas of the scalp EEG.

hpo:HP:0011220.definizione: Forward prominence of the entire forehead, due to protrusion of the frontal bone.

hpo:HP:0011225.definizione: Redundant eyelid skin pressing the eyelashes against the cornea and/or conjunctiva.

hpo:HP:0011228.definizione: An eyebrow that extends straight across the brow, without curve.

hpo:HP:0011229.definizione: Regional increase in the width (height) of the eyebrow.

hpo:HP:0011230.definizione: An eyebrow that extends laterally beyond the orbital rim rather than turning gently downward at that location.

hpo:HP:0011231.definizione: Eyelashes that draw the attention of the viewer due to increased density and/or length and/or curl without meeting the criteria of trichomegaly.

hpo:HP:0011240.definizione: Increased protrusion of the antihelical ridge, proximal to its bifurcation, relative to the prominence of the helix.

hpo:HP:0011261.definizione: Small expansion of the helical fold at the junction of the superior and descending portions of the helix.

hpo:HP:0011265.definizione: Discontinuity in the convexity of the inferior margin of the lobe.

hpo:HP:0011271.definizione: Increase posterolateral protrusion of the tragus.

hpo:HP:0011272.definizione: Decreased posterolateral protrusion of the tragus.

hpo:HP:0011274.definizione: Increased susceptibility to mycobacterial infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of mycobacterial infection.

hpo:HP:0011288.nome: EEG con onde lente acute parietali
hpo:HP:0011288.definizione: EEG with sharp slow waves in the parietal region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

hpo:HP:0011289.nome: EEG con onde lente acute temporali
hpo:HP:0011289.definizione: EEG with sharp slow waves in the temporal region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

hpo:HP:0011290.nome: EEG con onde lente frontali acute
hpo:HP:0011290.definizione: EEG with sharp slow waves in the frontal region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

hpo:HP:0011291.nome: EEG con onde lente acute centrali
hpo:HP:0011291.definizione: EEG with sharp slow waves in the central region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.

hpo:HP:0011292.definizione: EEG with sharp waves in the occipital region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

hpo:HP:0011293.definizione: EEG with sharp waves in the central region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

hpo:HP:0011294.definizione: EEG with sharp waves in the frontal region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

hpo:HP:0011295.definizione: EEG with sharp waves in the parietal region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

hpo:HP:0011296.definizione: EEG with sharp waves in the temporal region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.

hpo:HP:0011300.definizione: Increased width of the distal segment of a finger.

hpo:HP:0011304.definizione: Increased thumb width without increased dorso-ventral dimension.

hpo:HP:0011318.definizione: Synostosis affecting the right and the left coronal suture.

hpo:HP:0011323.definizione: Incomplete fusion of the chin, resulting from a developmental defect and manifesting as a midline cleft or fissure of the chin.

hpo:HP:0011327.definizione: Asymmetry of the posterior part of the skull.

hpo:HP:0011330.definizione: Premature fusion of the metopic suture.

hpo:HP:0011341.definizione: Increased width of the upper lip.

hpo:HP:0011342.definizione: A mild delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

hpo:HP:0011343.definizione: A moderate delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

hpo:HP:0011344.definizione: A severe delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

hpo:HP:0011354.definizione: An abnormality of the skin that is not localized to any one particular region.

hpo:HP:0011355.definizione: A lesion of the skin that is located in a specific region rather than being generalized.

hpo:HP:0011359.definizione: Hair that lacks the luster (shine or gleam) of normal hair.

hpo:HP:0011386.definizione: Reduction in diameter of the internal auditory canal.

hpo:HP:0011387.definizione: Increased size of the vestibular aqueduct.

hpo:HP:0011400.definizione: An abnormality of myelination of nerves in the central nervous system.

hpo:HP:0011408.definizione: Intrauterine growth retardation that is at least 3 standard deviations (SD) below average, but not as low as 4 SD, corrected for sex and gestational age.

hpo:HP:0011412.definizione: Delivery of newborn by means of a ventouse, a vacuum device used to assist the delivery of a baby when the second stage of labor has not progressed adequately.

hpo:HP:0011413.definizione: Shoulder dystocia occurs when the fetal anterior shoulder impacts against the maternal symphysis following delivery of the vertex.

hpo:HP:0011422.nome: Concentrazione anormale di cloruro nel sangue
hpo:HP:0011422.definizione: Any deviation from the normal concentration of chloride in the blood circulation.

hpo:HP:0011427.definizione: The cisterna magna is measured on a transaxial view of the fetal head angled 15 degrees caudal to the canthomeatal line. The anterior/posterior diameter is taken between the inferior/posterior surface of the vermis of the cerebellum to the inner surface of the cranium. An enlarged cisternal magna is defined by an anterior/posterior diameter of 10 mm or more (PMID:16100637).

hpo:HP:0011448.definizione: Clonus is an involuntary tendon reflex that causes repeated flexion and extension of the foot. Ankle clonus is tested by rapidly flexing the foot upward.

hpo:HP:0011449.definizione: Clonus is an involuntary tendon reflex that causes repeated flexion and extension of the foot. Knee clonus can be tested by rapidly pushing the patella towards the toes.

hpo:HP:0011451.definizione: Head circumference below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender at birth.

hpo:HP:0011471.definizione: Feeding problem necessitating gastrostomy tube feeding.

hpo:HP:0011473.definizione: The enteric villi are atrophic or absent.

hpo:HP:0011487.definizione: A increased anteroposterior thickness of the cornea.

hpo:HP:0011505.definizione: Cystoid thickening of the retina that takes place due to accumulation of extracellular fluid in the macula as a nonspecific response to blood-retinal barrier breakdown. Histological studies show that radially orientated cystoid spaces consisting of ophthalmoscopically clear fluid are often clinically detectable in the macula area.

hpo:HP:0011509.definizione: Increased amount of pigmentation in the macula.

hpo:HP:0011553.definizione: Connection of the right atrium to the left ventricle and of the left atrium to the right ventricle in a biventricular heart.

hpo:HP:0011560.definizione: A congenital defect with failure to open of the mitral valve orifice.

hpo:HP:0011565.definizione: Complete absence of the interatrial septum with common atrioventricular valve and two atrioventricular connections.

hpo:HP:0011577.definizione: A specific combination of heart defects including a primum atrial septal defect and cleft anterior mitral valve leaflet. There is not an inlet ventricular septal defect present. There are two valve annuluses and two valve orifices.

hpo:HP:0011611.definizione: Non-continuity of the arch of aorta with an atretic point or absent segment.

hpo:HP:0011613.nome: Arco aortico interrotto di tipo B
hpo:HP:0011613.definizione: Non-continuity of the aortic arch with an atretic point or absent segment between the left carotid and subclavian arteries.

hpo:HP:0011623.definizione: The trabecular septum is the largest part of the interventricular septum. It extends from the membranous septum to the apex and superiorly to the infundibular septum. A defect in the trabecular septum is called muscular VSD if the defect is completely rimmed by muscle.

hpo:HP:0011636.definizione: Isolated abnormalities of the coronary artery origins. This may be in associated with other structural heart malformations but not the patterns of complex structural heart malformations which result in abnormal course of the coronary arteries.

hpo:HP:0011641.definizione: A congenital malformation with abnormal connection between one of the coronary arteries and a heart chamber or another blood vessel.

hpo:HP:0011645.definizione: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation of one of the anatomic dilations of the ascending aorta, which occurs just above the aortic valve.

hpo:HP:0011662.definizione: Failure to develop of the tricuspid valve and thus lack of the normal connection between the right atrium and the right ventricle.

hpo:HP:0011682.definizione: A ventricular septal defect that is confluent with and involves the membranous septum and is bordered by an atrioventricular valve, not including the type 3 VSDs.

hpo:HP:0011705.definizione: Delay of conduction through the atrioventricular node, which is manifested as prolongation of the PR interval in the electrocardiogram (EKG). All atrial impulses reach the ventricles.

hpo:HP:0011706.definizione: An intermittent atrioventricular block with failure of some atrial impulses to conduct to the ventricles, i.e., some but not all atrial impulses are conducted through the atrioventricular node and trigger ventricular contraction.

hpo:HP:0011707.definizione: Progressive PR interval prolongation with the subsequent occurrence of a single nonconducted P wave that results in a pause. The pause that follows the nonconducted impulse is less than fully compensatory (less than the sum of two normal sinus intervals).

hpo:HP:0011709.definizione: Atrioventricular (AV) dissociation is present if the atria and the ventricles are under the control of two separate pacemakers. AV dissociation can occur in the absence of a primary AV conduction disturbance.

hpo:HP:0011711.definizione: Conduction block in the anterior division of the left bundle branch of the bundle of His.

hpo:HP:0011713.nome: Blocco di branca del fascio sinistro
hpo:HP:0011713.definizione: A conduction block of the left branch of the bundle of His. This manifests as a generalized disturbance of QRS morphology on EKG.

hpo:HP:0011734.definizione: A form of adrenal insufficiency related to a lack of ACTH, which leads to a decrease in the production of cortisol by the adrenal glands. Aldosterone production is not usually affected.

hpo:HP:0011748.definizione: A reduced ability to secrete adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), a hormone that stimulates the adrenal cortex to secrete of glucocorticoids such as cortisol.

hpo:HP:0011800.definizione: Posterior positions and/or vertical shortening of the infraorbital and perialar regions, or increased concavity of the face and/or reduced nasolabial angle.

hpo:HP:0011802.definizione: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the tongue.

hpo:HP:0011803.definizione: Visually assessable vertical indentation, cleft, or depression of the nasal bridge, ridge and tip.

hpo:HP:0011808.definizione: Decreased intensity of the patellar reflex (also known as the knee jerk reflex).

hpo:HP:0011814.nome: Aumento del livello urinario di ipoxantina
hpo:HP:0011814.definizione: The concentration of hypoxanthine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0011819.definizione: A cleft of the muscular (soft) portion of the palate that is covered by mucous membrane. Soft-palate submucous clefts are characterized by a midline deficiency or lack of muscle tissue.

hpo:HP:0011822.definizione: Increased width of the midpoint of the mandible (mental protuberance) and overlying soft tissue.

hpo:HP:0011829.definizione: Distance between the philtral ridges, measured just above the vermilion border, more than 2 standard deviations below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently decreased distance between the ridges of the philtrum.

hpo:HP:0011839.definizione: Abnormal increase or decrease of absolute number (either count per volume or proportion of total lymphocytes) of T cells or of a subset of T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells.

hpo:HP:0011849.definizione: Any anomaly in the formation of bone or of a bony substance, or the conversion of fibrous tissue or of cartilage into bone or a bony substance.

hpo:HP:0011873.definizione: Abnormal number of platelets per volume of blood. In a healthy adult, a normal platelet count is between 150,000 and 450,000 per microliter of blood.

hpo:HP:0011877.nome: Aumento del volume medio delle piastrine
hpo:HP:0011877.definizione: Average platelet volume above the upper limit of the normal reference interval.

hpo:HP:0011893.definizione: Number of leukocytes per volume of blood beyond normal limits.

hpo:HP:0011898.definizione: An abnormality of the level of activity of circulating fibrinogen.

hpo:HP:0011900.definizione: Decreased concentration of fibrinogen in the blood.

hpo:HP:0011904.definizione: Hemoglobin F (HbF) contains two globin alpha chains and two globin gamma chains. It is the main form of hemoglobin in the fetus during the last seven months of intrauterine development and in the half year of postnatal life. In adults it normally makes up less than one percent of all hemoglobin. This term refers to an increase in HbF above this limit. In beta thalassemia major, it may represent…

hpo:HP:0011919.definizione: Accumulation of pus in the pleural cavity.

hpo:HP:0011927.definizione: One or more digit that appears disproportionately short compared to the hand/foot, whereby either the entire digit or a specific phalanx is shortened.

hpo:HP:0011935.definizione: Decreased concentration of urate in the urine.

hpo:HP:0011939.definizione: A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between fingers 3 and 4.

hpo:HP:0011940.definizione: An abnormality of the shape of the thoracic vertebra T12 such that it is wedge-shaped (narrow towards the front).

hpo:HP:0011944.definizione: A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) that affects blood vessels that are smaller than arteries, i.e., arterioles, venules, and capilllaries.

hpo:HP:0011947.definizione: An infection of the upper or lower respiratory tract.

hpo:HP:0011951.definizione: Pneumonia due to the aspiration (breathing in) of food, liquid, or gastric contents into the upper respiratory tract.

hpo:HP:0011952.definizione: An acute episode of pneumonia due to the aspiration (breathing in) of food, liquid, or gastric contents into the upper respiratory tract.

hpo:HP:0011954.definizione: Diffuse benign transformation of the hepatic parenchyma into small regenerative nodules with minimal or no fibrosis.

hpo:HP:0011966.definizione: The concentration of citrulline in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0011968.definizione: Impaired ability to eat related to problems gathering food and getting ready to suck, chew, or swallow it.

hpo:HP:0011969.nome: Elevati livelli di ormone luteinizzante circolante
hpo:HP:0011969.definizione: An elevated concentration of luteinizing hormone in the blood.

hpo:HP:0011985.definizione: Clay colored stools lacking bile pigment.

hpo:HP:0011987.definizione: Formation of abnormal bony tissue within muscle tissue.

hpo:HP:0011995.definizione: A bulging of the interatrial septum towards one side. In adults, atrial septal aneurysm can be defined as a protrusion of the aneurysm of >10 mm beyond the plane of the atrial septum as measured by transesophageal echocardiography.

hpo:HP:0012000.definizione: EEG with generalized sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec.

hpo:HP:0012001.definizione: EEG with repetitive generalized sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec.

hpo:HP:0012014.definizione: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the central region.

hpo:HP:0012015.definizione: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the frontal region.

hpo:HP:0012016.definizione: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the occipital region.

hpo:HP:0012017.definizione: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the parietal region.

hpo:HP:0012018.definizione: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the temporal region.

hpo:HP:0012019.definizione: Complete dislocation of the lens of the eye.

hpo:HP:0012020.definizione: Aorta descends on right instead of on the left.

hpo:HP:0012024.definizione: The concentration of galactose in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0012038.definizione: Corneal guttata are droplet-like accumulations of non-banded collagen on the posterior surface of Descemet's membrane. The presence of focal thickenings of Descemet's membrane histologically named guttae. Cornea guttata can be easily diagnosed in vivo and ex vivo by means of specular microscopy as it gives dark areas where no endothelial cells are visible.

hpo:HP:0012043.definizione: Rhythmic, involuntary sinusoidal oscillations of one or both eyes. The waveform of pendular nystagmus may occur in any direction.

hpo:HP:0012046.definizione: Inability to elicit tendon reflexes in the upper limbs.

hpo:HP:0012047.definizione: A visual defect characterized by the inability to see as clearly in bright light as in dim light. The word hemeralopia literally means day blindness.

hpo:HP:0012049.definizione: A form of focal dystonia that affects the vocal cords, associated with involuntary contractions of the vocal cords causing interruptions of speech and affecting the voice quality and often leading to patterned, repeated breaks in speech.

hpo:HP:0012050.definizione: An extreme form of generalized edema with widespread and massive edema due to effusion of fluid into the extracellular space.

hpo:HP:0012052.definizione: The concentration of calcitriol in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0012071.definizione: Any deviation from the normal concentration of fatty acylcarnitine in the blood circulation.

hpo:HP:0012098.definizione: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on the back of the feet.

hpo:HP:0012100.nome: Concentrazione anormale di creatinina in circolo
hpo:HP:0012100.definizione: An abnormal concentration of creatinine in the blood.

hpo:HP:0012103.definizione: An anomaly of the mitochondrion, the membranous cytoplasmic organelle the interior of which is subdivided by cristae. The mitochondrion is a self replicating organelle that is the site of tissue respiration.

hpo:HP:0012108.definizione: A type of glaucoma defined by an open, normal appearing anterior chamber angle and raised intraocular pressure,

hpo:HP:0012109.definizione: A type of glaucomatous optic neuropathy in an eye that has evidence of angle closure (i.e. significant iridotrabecular contact).

hpo:HP:0012117.definizione: The concentration of albumin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0012120.definizione: Increased concentration of methylmalonic acid in the urine.

hpo:HP:0012127.definizione: Increased concentration of uracil in the urine.

hpo:HP:0012132.definizione: Increased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.

hpo:HP:0012143.definizione: Any structural anomaly of megakaryocytes. Mature blood platelets are released from the cytoplasm of megakaryocytes, which are bone-marrow resident cells.

hpo:HP:0012156.definizione: Phagocytosis by macrophages of erythrocytes, leukocytes, platelets, and their precursors in bone marrow and other tissues.

hpo:HP:0012157.definizione: Atrophy of the cerebral subcortical white and gray matter, termed subcortical atrophy, reflects loss of nerve cells in the basal ganglia or fibers in the deep white matter.

hpo:HP:0012158.definizione: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the carotid artery wall.

hpo:HP:0012163.definizione: A dilatation (balooning or bulging out of the vessel wall) of a carotid artery.

hpo:HP:0012167.definizione: A phenomenon in which persons repetitively pull out their own hair, resulting in noticeable hair loss.

hpo:HP:0012168.definizione: Habitual striking of one's own head against a surface such as a mattress or wall of a crib.

hpo:HP:0012171.definizione: Habitual clasping and wringing of the hands in the middle of the body, similar to a hand-washing movement.

hpo:HP:0012172.definizione: Habitual repetitive movement of the entire body, front to back or side to side.

hpo:HP:0012180.definizione: A disorder of large arteries, in particular the aorta, characterized by an accumulation of basophilic ground substance in the media with cyst-like lesions associated with degenerative changes of collagen, elastin and the vascular smooth muscle cells.

hpo:HP:0012181.definizione: Malfunction of a peripheral nerve resulting from mechanical compression of the nerve roots from internal or external causes and leading to a conduction block or axonal loss.

hpo:HP:0012185.definizione: Injury to the median nerve caused by its entrapment at the wrist as it traverses through the carpal tunnel. Clinically, constrictive median neuropathy is characterized by pain, paresthesia, and weakness in the median nerve distribution of the hand.

hpo:HP:0012190.definizione: A type of lymphoma that originates in T-cells.

hpo:HP:0012204.definizione: Recurrent infection involving the vulva, vagina, and adjacent crural areas, whereby the causative agent belongs to the genus Candida.

hpo:HP:0012205.definizione: Any structural anomaly of the acrosome resulting in a round sperm head.

hpo:HP:0012207.definizione: An abnormal reduction in the mobility of ejaculated sperm.

hpo:HP:0012209.definizione: Juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML) is a lethal myeloproliferative disease of young childhood characterized clinically by overproduction of myelomonocytic cells and by the in vitro phenotype of hematopoietic progenitor hypersensitivity to granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor.

hpo:HP:0012210.definizione: Any structural anomaly of the kidney.

hpo:HP:0012211.definizione: An abnormal functionality of the kidney.

hpo:HP:0012213.definizione: An abnormal reduction in the volume of fluid filtered out of plasma through glomerular capillary walls into Bowman's capsules per unit of time.

hpo:HP:0012232.definizione: Decreased time between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).

hpo:HP:0012240.definizione: An abnormal increase in intracellular lipid droplets In a muscle. The number and size of these drops can increase with somd disorders of lipid metabolism affecting muscle. See PMID 20691590 for histological images.

hpo:HP:0012246.definizione: Reduced ability to control the movement of the eye associated with damage to the third cranial nerve (the oculomotor nerve).

hpo:HP:0012249.definizione: An electrocardiographic anomaly of the ST segment, which is the segment that connects the QRS complex and the T wave. The ST segment normally has a duration of 80 to 120 ms, is flat and at the same level (isoelectric) as the PR and TP segment.

hpo:HP:0012251.definizione: An electrocardiographic anomaly in which the ST segment is observed to be located superior to the isoelectric line.

hpo:HP:0012262.definizione: Any anomaly of the normal motility of motile cilia. Evaluation of ciliary beat frequency and ciliary beat pattern requires high-speed videomicroscopy of freshly obtained ciliary biopsies that are maintained in culture media under controlled conditions.

hpo:HP:0012266.definizione: A periodic beat-to-beat variation in the amplitude or shape of the T wave in an EKG.

hpo:HP:0012292.definizione: A congenital defect with an abnormal joining of the gums of the upper and lower jaw.

hpo:HP:0012304.definizione: Underdevelopment of the arch of aorta.

hpo:HP:0012332.nome: Fisiologia anomala del sistema nervoso autonomo
hpo:HP:0012332.definizione: A functional abnormality of the autonomic nervous system.

hpo:HP:0012366.definizione: Projection of the tip of the dens more than 5 mm above a line joining the hard palate to the posterior lip of the foramen magnum (Chamberlain's line) or the tip of the dens is greater than 7 mm above McGregor's line (the back of the hard palate to the lowest point of the occipital squama).

hpo:HP:0012368.definizione: Absence of concavity or convexity of the face when viewed in profile.

hpo:HP:0012370.definizione: Large or prominent malar surface of the zygomatic bone of the skull, which is convex and forms the prominence of the 'cheek bones'.

hpo:HP:0012372.definizione: A structural anomaly of the globe of the eye, or bulbus oculi.

hpo:HP:0012382.definizione: Pattern of blood flow in the heart that deviates from the normal circuit of the circulatory system from the left side of the heart to the right.

hpo:HP:0012389.definizione: Muscular hypotonia of one or more limbs.

hpo:HP:0012391.definizione: Reduced intensity of muscle tendon reflexes in the upper limbs. Reflexes are elicited by stretching the tendon of a muscle, e.g., by tapping.

hpo:HP:0012395.definizione: An allergy experienced at a particular time of year when trees or grasses pollinate and elicit an allergic reaction.

hpo:HP:0012405.definizione: A lower than normal concentration of citrate(3-) in the urine.

hpo:HP:0012407.definizione: A type of spastic paraparetic gait in which the muscle tone in the adductors is marked. It is characterized by hypertonia and flexion in the legs, hips and pelvis accompanied by extreme adduction leading to the knees and thighs hitting, or sometimes even crossing, in a scissors-like movement. The opposing muscles (abductors) become comparatively weak from lack of use.

hpo:HP:0012408.definizione: The deposition of calcium salts in the parenchyma of the renal medulla (innermost part of the kidney).

hpo:HP:0012412.definizione: Onset of adrenarche at an earlier age than usual.

hpo:HP:0012413.definizione: The presence of a V-shaped indentation (notch) in the primary central incisor.

hpo:HP:0012420.definizione: Amniotic fluid containing the earliest stools of a mammalian infant.

hpo:HP:0012427.definizione: An increased degree of femoral version, which is defined as the angular difference between axis of femoral neck and transcondylar axis of the knee. Thus, femoral anteversion is an inward twisting of the femur that causes the knees and feet to turn inward.

hpo:HP:0012429.definizione: Absence or underdevelopment of the cerebral white matter.

hpo:HP:0012430.definizione: Underdevelopment of the cerebral white matter.

hpo:HP:0012432.definizione: Subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation that persists for six months or longer.

hpo:HP:0012433.definizione: An abnormality of actions or reactions of a person exhibited during social interactions with other individuals.

hpo:HP:0012447.definizione: Any anomaly in the process by which myelin sheaths are formed and maintained around neurons.

hpo:HP:0012450.definizione: Constipation for longer than three months with fewer than 3 bowel movements per week, straining, lumpy or hard stools, and a sensation of anorectal obstruction or incomplete defecation.

hpo:HP:0012452.definizione: An irresistible urge to move the legs, usually accompanied by unpleasant sensations deep within the limbs. Symptoms typically begin or worsen during periods of rest or inactivity, are most pronounced in the evening or at night, and are temporarily relieved by movement such as walking or stretching. The disturbance often interferes with the initiation or maintenance of sleep.

hpo:HP:0012453.nome: Contrattura bilaterale della flessione del polso
hpo:HP:0012453.definizione: A chronic loss of wrist joint motion on the right and left sides.

hpo:HP:0012463.definizione: An above normal level of saturation of serum transferrin with iron.

hpo:HP:0012464.definizione: A below normal level of saturation of serum transferrin with iron.

hpo:HP:0012465.nome: Elevata concentrazione di ferro nel fegato
hpo:HP:0012465.definizione: An increased level of iron in liver tissues.

hpo:HP:0012466.definizione: Longstanding impairment in ventilation such that the partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PaCO2) is elevated above the upper limit of the reference range (more than 45 mm Hg), with a normal or near-normal pH secondary to renal compensation and an elevated serum bicarbonate levels.

hpo:HP:0012469.definizione: Infantile spasms represent a subset of "epileptic spasms". Infantile Spasms are epileptic spasms starting in the first year of life (infancy).

hpo:HP:0012471.definizione: Increased width of the skin of vermilion border region of upper lip.

hpo:HP:0012472.definizione: A turning outward of the lip or lips, that is, eversion of the lips.

hpo:HP:0012474.definizione: Complete obstruction of a carotid artery.

hpo:HP:0012478.definizione: Bony fusion of the mandibular condyle to the base of the skull, resulting in limitation of jaw opening.

hpo:HP:0012484.definizione: Defective structure, size or content of dense granules, platelet organelles that contain granules proaggregatory factors such as adenosine diphosphate (ADP), adenosine triphosphate (ATP), ionized calcium, histamine and serotonin.

hpo:HP:0012492.definizione: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of a cerebral artery.

hpo:HP:0012499.definizione: A separation of the layers within the wall of the descending aorta. Tears in the intimal layer result in the propagation of dissection (proximally or distally) secondary to blood entering the intima-media space.

hpo:HP:0012502.definizione: An anomaly of the internal capsule, which is an area of white matter in the brain that separates the caudate nucleus and the thalamus from the putamen and the globus pallidus.

hpo:HP:0012506.definizione: An abnormally decreased size of the pituitary gland.

hpo:HP:0012507.definizione: Reduced strength of the orbicularis oculi, the circumorbital muscle in the face that closes the eyelid.

hpo:HP:0012511.definizione: A pale yellow discoloration of the temporal (lateral) portion of the optic disc.

hpo:HP:0012512.definizione: A pale yellow discoloration of the entire optic disc.

hpo:HP:0012514.definizione: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the leg.

hpo:HP:0012520.definizione: Increased dimensions of the Virchow-Robin spaces (also known as perivascular spaces), which surround the walls of vessels as they course from the subarachnoid space through the brain parenchyma. Perivascular spaces are commonly microscopic, and not visible on conventional neuroimaging. This term refers to an increase of size of these spaces such that they are visible on neuroimaging (usually…

hpo:HP:0012523.definizione: Reluctance or refusal of a child to be breastfed or eat, manifested as gagging, vomiting, turning head away from food, or avoidance of sensation in or around the mouth (i.e. toothbrushing or face-washing).

hpo:HP:0012528.definizione: A deviation from the normal count of alpha granules per thrombocyte.

hpo:HP:0012544.nome: Elevata concentrazione di aldolasi in circolo
hpo:HP:0012544.definizione: Concentration of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0012548.definizione: Muscle fibers degeneration resulting in fatty replacement of skeletal muscle fibers

hpo:HP:0012573.definizione: A type of proximal renal tubulopathy characterized by resorption defects leading to glycosuria, aminoaciduria, tubular proteinuria, renal hypophosphatemia, and urate tubular hyporeabsorption with bicarbonate loss and resulting acidosis.

hpo:HP:0012574.definizione: Increased numbers of mesangial cells per glomerulus, defined as more than 3 nuclei fully surrounded by matrix in one or more mesangial areas, not including perihilar region, on a standard 3-micron-thick tissue section, best evaluated on periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) stain.

hpo:HP:0012579.definizione: The presence of minimal changes visible by light microscopy but flattened and fused podocyte foot processes on electron microscopy in a person with nephrotic range proteinuria.

hpo:HP:0012583.definizione: One sided hypoplasia of the kidney.

hpo:HP:0012584.definizione: Two sided hypoplasia of the kidney.

hpo:HP:0012587.definizione: Hematuria that is visible upon inspection of the urine.

hpo:HP:0012604.definizione: An abnormally decreased sodium concentration in the urine.

hpo:HP:0012606.definizione: An abnormally increased sodium concentration in the urine in the presence of hyponatremia.

hpo:HP:0012608.definizione: An increased concentration of magnesium the urine.

hpo:HP:0012623.nome: Insufficienza renale cronica al primo stadio
hpo:HP:0012623.definizione: A type of chronic kidney disease with normal or increased glomerular filtration rate.

hpo:HP:0012624.nome: Insufficienza renale cronica al secondo stadio
hpo:HP:0012624.definizione: A type of chronic kidney disease with mildly reduced glomerular filtration rate.

hpo:HP:0012625.nome: Insufficienza renale cronica al terzo stadio
hpo:HP:0012625.definizione: A type of chronic kidney disease with moderately reduced glomerular filtration rate.

hpo:HP:0012626.nome: Insufficienza renale cronica al quarto stadio
hpo:HP:0012626.definizione: A type of chronic kidney disease with severely reduced glomerular filtration rate.

hpo:HP:0012632.definizione: An anomaly in the amount of force per unit area exerted by the intraocular fluid within the eye.

hpo:HP:0012637.definizione: High urine calcium in the presence of hypocalcemia.

hpo:HP:0012650.definizione: Polymicrogyria (an excessive number of small gyri or convolutions) that is maximal in perisylvian regions (the regions that surround the Sylvian fissures), which may be symmetric or asymmetric and may extend beyond perisylvian regions. The Sylvian fissures often extend posteriorly and superiorly.

hpo:HP:0012675.definizione: An abnormal build up of iron (Fe) in brain tissue.

hpo:HP:0012683.definizione: A glial uniloculated or multiloculated fluid-filled sac that either reside within or completely replace the pineal gland.

hpo:HP:0012692.definizione: A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the thalamus.

hpo:HP:0012697.definizione: Decreased size of the basal ganglia.

hpo:HP:0012703.definizione: Abnormality in the space in the meninges beneath the arachnoid membrane and above the pia mater that contains the cerebrospinal fluid.

hpo:HP:0012704.definizione: An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater.

hpo:HP:0012712.definizione: A mild form of hearing impairment (26-40 dB) in which individuals can hear speech at a normal volume from about one meter away but may struggle with softer sounds, such as whispers or quiet conversations. Understanding speech in noisy environments can also be challenging.

hpo:HP:0012714.definizione: A severe form of hearing impairment (61-80 dB) in which individuals can only hear a few words spoken at a high volume and experience significant difficulty perceiving speech at normal levels.

hpo:HP:0012725.definizione: A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints, or a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits that lies significantly distal to the flexion crease that overlies the metacarpophalangeal or metatarsophalangeal joint of the adjacent digits.

hpo:HP:0012731.definizione: Abnormal anatomic location of the anterior pituitary gland.

hpo:HP:0012734.definizione: Low blood glucose is accompanied by elevated levels of ketone bodies in the body.

hpo:HP:0012741.definizione: Absence of a testis from the scrotum on one side owing to failure of the testis or testes to descend through the inguinal canal to the scrotum.

hpo:HP:0012745.definizione: Distance between the medial and lateral canthi is more than 2 SD below the mean for age (objective); or, apparently reduced length of the palpebral fissures.

hpo:HP:0012753.nome: Gangli della base ipointensi in T2
hpo:HP:0012753.definizione: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia. This term refers to a diffuse hypointensity affecting all of the basal ganglia.

hpo:HP:0012758.definizione: Neurodevelopmental delay (NDD) refers to delays in the maturation of the brain and central nervous system; infants and young children with NDD may experience delays in the development of one or more skills including gross motor abilities, fine-motor coordination, language abilities and ability to solve increasingly complex problems.

hpo:HP:0012759.definizione: A deviation from normal of the neurological development of a child, which may include any or all of the aspects of the development of personal, social, gross or fine motor, and cognitive abilities.

hpo:HP:0012760.definizione: A reduced ability to participate in the back-and-forth flow of social interaction appropriate to culture and developmental level, which is normally characterized by an influence of the behavior of one person on the behavior of another person. This results in difficulty interacting with others through emotional, physical, or verbal communication.

hpo:HP:0012762.definizione: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the cerebral white matter.

hpo:HP:0012766.definizione: An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater in the region surrounding the cerebrum.

hpo:HP:0012771.definizione: Increased length of the arm span (length from one end of an individual's arms measured at the fingertips to the other when raised parallel to the ground at shoulder height at a one-hundred eighty degree angle).

hpo:HP:0012785.definizione: Chronic loss of joint motion in a finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.

hpo:HP:0012786.definizione: Repeated infections of the urinary bladder.

hpo:HP:0012795.definizione: A morphological abnormality of the optic disc, i.e., of the portion of the optic nerve clinically visible on fundoscopic examination.

hpo:HP:0012798.definizione: Infiltration of smooth muscle-like cells in lymph vessels as well as the lung (pleura, alveolar septa, bronchi, pulmonary vessels and lymphatics as well as lymph nodes, especially in posterior mediastinum and retroperitoneum). Focal emphysema can develop because of airway narrowing, and the thoracic duct may be obliterated. Pulmonary lymphangiomyomatosis may lead to multiple small cysts with a…

hpo:HP:0012804.definizione: Disruption of the epithelial layer of the cornea with involvement of the underlying stroma.

hpo:HP:0012805.definizione: Transmission of light through the iris as visualized upon slit lamp examination or infrared iris transillumination videography. The light passes through defects in the pigmentation of the iris.

hpo:HP:0012806.definizione: A fleshy, tube-like structure usually located in the midline of the face or just to one side of the midline.

hpo:HP:0012810.definizione: Increased distance between the attachments of the alae nasi to the face.

hpo:HP:0012811.definizione: Increased width of the nasal ridge.

hpo:HP:0012847.definizione: Epilepsia partialis continua (also called Kojevnikov's or Kozhevnikov's epilepsia) is a type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repeated stereotyped simple motor manifestations such as jerks, typically of a limb or the face, recurring every few seconds or minutes for extended periods (days or years).

hpo:HP:0012852.definizione: Hepatic fibrosis that reaches from a portal area to another portal area.

hpo:HP:0012865.nome: Morfologia anomala della testa degli spermatozoi
hpo:HP:0012865.definizione: A structural abnormality of the sperm head.

hpo:HP:0012896.definizione: An anomaly identified by motor evoked potentials (MEPs). MEPs are measured following single-pulse or repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation and can be used for the assessment of the excitability of the motor cortex and the integrity of conduction along the central and peripheral motor pathways.

hpo:HP:0020036.definizione: A lack of coordination of arm movement manifested by undershoot or overshoot of the intended position of the arm.

hpo:HP:0020045.definizione: A manifest or latent ocular deviation in which one or both eyes tends to deviate nasally.

hpo:HP:0020073.definizione: A white or lighter patch of skin that may appear anywhere on the body and are caused by decreased skin pigmentation.

hpo:HP:0020081.definizione: A type of erythrocyte inclusion characterized by basophilic stippling of erythrocytes, that is, by numerous very small coarse or fine blue granules within the cytoplasm with the additional stipulation that the stippled particles are due to iron granules (demonstrable by the Prussian blue stain).

hpo:HP:0020086.definizione: Local or regional infection with Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination.

hpo:HP:0020087.definizione: Distant, or disseminated infection with Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination associated with failure to contain thebacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination leading to spread of BCG to many sites in the body. The tuberculosis vaccine BCG contains live attenuated Mycobacterium bovis.

hpo:HP:0020102.definizione: An opportunistic disease caused by invasion of unicellular fungus Pneumocystis jirovecii. Transmission of P. jirovecii cysts takes place through the airborne route, and usually, its presence in lungs is asymptomatic. However, people with impaired immunity, especially those with CD4+ T cell count below 200/microliter, are still at risk of the development of Pneumocystis pneumonia due to P.…

hpo:HP:0020106.definizione: An unusually severe infection due to Giardia lamblia, also called Giardia duodenalis or Giardia intestinalis, which is a protozoan parasite of the small intestine that causes extensive morbidity worldwide.

hpo:HP:0020128.definizione: Aplasia (congenital absence) of the olfactory tract, which causes anosmia, a complete loss of the sense of smell.

hpo:HP:0020132.definizione: Increase in thickness of the basement membrane of the tubulus of the kidney.

hpo:HP:0020151.definizione: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against double-stranded DNA.

hpo:HP:0020152.definizione: Lack of stability of a distal joint (e.g., finger).

hpo:HP:0020180.definizione: The concentration of haptoglobin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0020181.definizione: The concentration of haptoglobin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

hpo:HP:0020203.definizione: Streaming or smearing of the Z band, which is then no longer confined to a narrow zone which bisects the I band. The Z disk may extend across the I band or the entire sarcomere in a zigzag manner. Focal thickening, smudging, and blurring of the Z band takes place concurrently. Myofibrillar disorganization is a frequent but not invariable accompanying change.

hpo:HP:0020206.definizione: The pinna has fewer folds and grooves than usual.

hpo:HP:0020217.definizione: A type of focal motor seizure in which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.

hpo:HP:0020221.definizione: A clonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterized by sustained rhythmic jerking, that is regularly repetitive.

hpo:HP:0020222.definizione: A decreased concentration of homocysteine in the blood.

hpo:HP:0025019.definizione: Sudden breakage of an artery leading to leakage of blood from the circulation.

hpo:HP:0025039.definizione: Swelling within the basal ganglia due to the accumulation of fluid.

hpo:HP:0025044.definizione: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in lung parenchyma, which leads to a cavity, and after formation of bronchopulmonary fistula, can manifest as an air-fluid level inside the cavity.

hpo:HP:0025066.definizione: A reduction from normal of the mean corpuscular volume, or mean cell volume (MCV) of red blood cells (usually defined as an MCV below 80 femtoliters).

hpo:HP:0025092.definizione: Diffuse hypertrophy or thickening of the stratum spinosum of the epidermis (prickle cell layer of the skin).

hpo:HP:0025097.definizione: Marked, involuntary jerking of the eyelids.

hpo:HP:0025101.definizione: Structural abnormality of the hippocampus related to defective development.

hpo:HP:0025114.definizione: Hypergranulosis is an increased thickness of the stratum granulosum.

hpo:HP:0025116.definizione: An intrauterine state characterized by suboptimal values in the fetal heart rate, oxygenation of fetal blood, or other parameters indicative of compromise of the fetus. Signs of fetal distress include repetitive variable decelerations, fetal tachycardia or bradycardia, late decelerations, or low biophysical profile.

hpo:HP:0025159.definizione: Decreased amount of autofluorescence in the retina as ascertained by fundus autofluorescence imaging.

hpo:HP:0025160.definizione: Temper tantrums are brief episodes of extreme, unpleasant, and sometimes aggressive behaviors in response to frustration or anger, which are a normal part of development in toddlers. Temper tantrums that occur more frequently in a given time and/or are more severe in symptomatology and/or longer in duration and/or inappropriate for the given age compared to a temper tantrum that naturally occurs…

hpo:HP:0025161.definizione: Temper tantrums that occur more frequently compared to the temper tantrums that are a part of the normal developmental process.

hpo:HP:0025162.definizione: Temper tantrums, which occur with more severe symptomatology compared to a temper tantrum that occurs as a part of normal developmental process.

hpo:HP:0025168.definizione: Abnormal function of the left ventricule during left ventricular relaxation and filling.

hpo:HP:0025169.definizione: Abnormality of left ventricular contraction, often defined operationally as an ejection fraction of less than 40 percent.

hpo:HP:0025179.definizione: On chest radiographs, ground-glass opacity appears as an area of hazy increased lung opacity, usually extensive, within which margins of pulmonary vessels may be indistinct. On CT scans, it appears as hazy increased opacity of lung, with preservation of bronchial and vascular margins. It is caused by partial filling of airspaces, interstitial thickening, partial collapse of alveoli, increased…

hpo:HP:0025193.definizione: A posterolateral defect in the diaphragm, commonly referred to as a Bochdalek hernia, which is often accompanied by herniation of the stomach, intestines, liver, and/or spleen into the chest cavity.

hpo:HP:0025235.definizione: A parasomnia that occurs during non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep.

hpo:HP:0025258.definizione: A sensation of tightness in the neck when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity. Neck stiffness often involves soreness and difficulty moving the neck, especially when trying to turn the head to the side.

hpo:HP:0025278.definizione: Sweating provoked by cold temperature rather than by heat.

hpo:HP:0025289.definizione: Enlarged lymph nodes in the neck.

hpo:HP:0025300.definizione: An erythematous (red), flat facial rash that affects the skin in the malar area (over the cheekbones) and extends over the bridge of the nose.

hpo:HP:0025321.definizione: An anomalous build up of copper (Cu) in the liver.

hpo:HP:0025331.definizione: A limitation of the ability to direct one's gaze above the horizontal meridian.

hpo:HP:0025336.definizione: A failure to achieve the ability to sit at an appropriate developmental stage. Most children sit with support at 6 months of age and sit steadily without support at 9 months of age.

hpo:HP:0025343.definizione: Presence of lupus anticoagulant (LA) autoantibodies. LA represent a heterogeneous group of autoantibodies, IgG, IgM, or a mixture of both classes, that interfere with standard phospholipid-based coagulant tests (this is only an in vitro phenomenon, LA do not cause reduction of coagulation in vivo). The antibodies are directed against plasma proteins which also bind to phospholipid surfaces.

hpo:HP:0025373.definizione: Interictal refers to a period of time between epileptic seizures. Electroencephalographic (EEG) patterns are important in the differential diagnosis of epilepsy, and the EEG is almost always abnormal during a seizure. Some persons with seizures may show EEG abnormalities between seizures, while others do not. In some cases, multiple interictal EEGs must be recorded before an abnormality is…

hpo:HP:0025379.definizione: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against thyroid peroxidase.

hpo:HP:0025383.definizione: An area of fat accumulation at the back of the neck in the form of a hump.

hpo:HP:0025387.definizione: A type of resting tremor characterized by simultaneous rubbing movements of thumb and index fingers against each other.

hpo:HP:0025388.definizione: A nodular lesion that develops in the thyroid gland. The term "thyroid nodule" refers to any abnormal growth that forms a lump in the thyroid gland.

hpo:HP:0025401.definizione: An abnormality in which the eyes are held permanently wide open.

hpo:HP:0025403.definizione: A habitual positioning of the body with the head and upper back bent forward.

hpo:HP:0025404.definizione: Any anomaly in the process of ocular fixation, which is the maintaining of the visual gaze on a single location.
